evidenceSummary: Primary species descriptions support the diagnosis and a regional Hettangian sample. Broader global distribution and detailed swimming performance remain provisional composites or inferences.

title.en: Hettangian specimens from Somerset
title.zh: 萨默塞特的赫塘期样本

text.en: The Ichthyosaurus account focuses on diagnosable Hettangian specimens from Somerset in the Lower Jurassic. It is a regional sample of named material, not an undifferentiated map of every global occurrence.
text.zh: 这份档案聚焦下侏罗统赫塘期、英格兰萨默塞特的可鉴定 Ichthyosaurus 标本。它是一个地区性具名材料样本，不是全球所有出现记录的合并地图。

title.en: Character combinations in the Somerset sample
title.zh: 萨默塞特样本中的性状组合

text.en: The selected Hettangian Somerset specimens have cranial and postcranial character combinations used to distinguish the included species. The account records a streamlined body, large orbit, elongated rostrum and paddle-like limbs in this material; these observations remain sample-bounded.
text.zh: 所选赫塘期萨默塞特标本的颅骨与颅后性状组合用于鉴别纳入的物种。流线型体形、大眼眶、细长吻部和桨状肢体均是这批材料中的记录，不外推为整个属的特征。

title.en: Possible fish remains in one gullet
title.zh: 一具个体的消化道中可能有鱼类遗骸

text.en: One Ichthyosaurus communis individual preserves probable fish remains in its gullet. This documents feeding evidence for that specimen; it does not describe the diet of every species or the genus as a whole.
text.zh: 一具 Ichthyosaurus communis 个体的消化道内保存了可能属于鱼类的遗骸。这是该标本的取食证据，并不描述每个物种或整个属的食性。

title.en: Caudal-fluke propulsion is inferred
title.zh: 尾鳍推进方式属于推断

text.en: Comparative vertebral anatomy supports caudal-fluke propulsion, but detailed swimming performance is not observed or measured in the fossil sample.
text.zh: 比较脊椎解剖支持以尾鳍推进的解释，但化石样本中没有直接观察或测量详细的游泳表现。

readerLimitations.en: The selected marine specimens are a Hettangian Somerset sample, not the genus's complete geographic range. The prey record is one I. communis individual, and locomotion remains a comparative inference; neither defines genus-wide ecology or body size.

traitsZh: 较大的眼眶和细长的吻部。

overview: Plesiosauria is represented here by diagnostic Rhaetian body-fossil anatomy in Rhaeticosaurus. Older Bobosaurus appears as an uncertain candidate, so it does not extend the group’s plotted range.

ecology.diet: Marine predator
ecology.habitat: Coastal to open marine
ecology.bodySize: Small to very large

traits: Four flippers interpreted as hydrofoil-like underwater paddles
Neck and skull proportions vary widely across the group
evidenceSummary: Rhaeticosaurus supplies articulated diagnostic anatomy and histology. Bobosaurus is older but less securely placed, and swimming performance comes from models rather than direct observation.

title.en: Rhaeticosaurus and the uncertain older candidate
title.zh: Rhaeticosaurus 与年代较早但位置未定的材料

text.en: Plesiosauria is represented here by diagnostic Rhaetian body-fossil anatomy in Rhaeticosaurus. Older Bobosaurus appears as an uncertain candidate, so it does not extend the group’s plotted range.
text.zh: 这里将 Plesiosauria 的确定记录系于 Rhaeticosaurus 的瑞提阶诊断性身体化石解剖。较老的 Bobosaurus 是不确定的候选材料，因此不把显示范围向前延伸。

title.en: Flippers and body proportions in the sample
title.zh: 鳍肢水下运动与样本中的身体差异

text.en:
Researchers interpret four flippers as hydrofoil-like paddles and test that idea with water-channel models using prescribed movements; the experiment does not observe a plesiosaur swimming.

The compared fossils also show a compact trunk, while neck and skull proportions differ among forms.
text.zh: 研究者把四个鳍肢解释为水下推进结构，并用预设鳍肢运动的水槽模型检验这一假说；实验没有观察蛇颈龙游泳。相关化石显示躯干紧凑，所比较形态间的颈部和头骨比例则有所不同。

title.en: Marine life and modelled swimming
title.zh: 海洋生活与模型化游泳方式

text.en: The cited fossils come from marine settings. Four-flipper underwater motion is a modelled swimming method: the experiment prescribed flipper movement in a water channel rather than observing an animal swim.
text.zh: 所引化石来自海相环境。四肢鳍状肢的水下运动方式来自模型实验：研究在水槽中预设鳍肢运动，而不是观察动物游泳。

title.en: What this evidence can establish
title.zh: 证据能说明什么

text.en: Rhaeticosaurus supplies articulated diagnostic anatomy and histology. Bobosaurus is older but less securely placed, and swimming performance comes from models rather than direct observation.
text.zh: Rhaeticosaurus 提供了关节相连的诊断性骨骼和组织学材料。Bobosaurus 年代更早，但系统位置不够确定；游泳性能来自模型，而非直接观察。

title.zh: A Triassic plesiosaurian skeleton and bone histology inform on evolution of a unique body plan

scope.zh: Bobosaurus 兼有幻龙类和蛇颈龙类特征；其与蛇颈龙类的亲缘关系仍不确定。

title.en: The four-flipper swimming method of plesiosaurs enabled efficient and effective locomotion
title.zh: The four-flipper swimming method of plesiosaurs enabled efficient and effective locomotion

scope.en: A water-channel experiment with prescribed flipper models tests swimming efficiency; it does not directly observe plesiosaur swimming.
scope.zh: 水槽实验使用预设鳍肢模型检验游泳效率；它没有直接观察蛇颈龙游泳。

traitsZh: 四个鳍肢被解释为类似水翼的水下桨状肢。
该类群内部的颈部和头骨比例差异很大。

geography: Every continent; fossil record extremely patchy
overview: Pterosaurs are extinct flying archosaurs often placed near dinosaurs; their precise origin and flight performance depend on phylogenetic and biomechanical analyses.
overviewZh: 翼龙是已灭绝的飞行主龙类，通常被置于鸟跖类、靠近恐龙；其精确起源和近亲取决于系统发育分析。具名化石记录蛋、体表组织和翼部骨骼，飞行与起飞表现则来自模型。

ecology.diet: Pterosaur lineages did not share one diet. The available profile evidence describes varied feeding guilds, so a diet proposed for one form should not be applied to the entire order.
ecology.habitat: Pterosaur fossils are reported from every continent, but the record is very patchy. The evidence includes aerial and coastal settings; a fossil locality or depositional label does not by itself identify where an animal fed or spent most of its life.
ecology.locomotion: Pterosaur anatomy supports powered flight, and biomechanical studies test how animals could launch from the ground. Those studies model performance from preserved proportions and stated assumptions; fossils do not preserve the motion of a takeoff.
ecology.bodySize: The radiation ranged from very small forms to giants. This order-wide span is not a size estimate for any particular species.
ecology.guild: Pterosaurs occupied varied aerial feeding roles. “Aerial consumer” describes a broad ecological grouping, not one diet or way of life shared by every lineage.
ecology.dietZh: 翼龙各谱系并非共享一种食性。现有档案证据描述了多种摄食生态类群，因此不能把为某一类群提出的食性套用于整个翼龙目。
ecology.habitatZh: 翼龙化石见于各大洲，但化石记录十分零散。证据涵盖空中和海岸环境；化石产地或沉积环境标签本身不能指出动物在哪里觅食或度过大部分生命。
ecology.locomotionZh: 翼龙解剖特征支持其具有主动飞行能力；生物力学研究则检验动物可能如何从地面起飞。这些研究依据保存下来的身体比例及明示的假设建立模型；化石并未保存起飞动作本身。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 翼龙演化辐射中既有极小型，也有巨型类群。这个目级范围并非任何特定物种的体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 翼龙占据多种空中取食生态位。“空中取食者”是宽泛的生态分组，并非所有支系共有的单一食性或生活方式。

traits: The flight membrane was supported mainly by an elongated fourth finger. This is a distinctive skeletal support for the wing; the membrane itself is rarely preserved.
Many pterosaurs had pneumatic bones containing air spaces. The extent and distribution of this feature varied among skeletons.
Quadrupedal ground launch has been tested with biomechanical models. It is a reconstruction from anatomy and assumptions, not a preserved behavior.
evidenceSummary: Fossils document eggs, integument and wing anatomy; flight and launch results are models bounded by specimens and assumptions.
evidenceSummaryZh: 具名化石记录蛋、体表组织和翼部骨骼；飞行与起飞结果来自受标本和假设限制的模型，并非保存下来的运动。

traitsZh: 翼膜主要由延长的第四指支撑。这是翼部独特的骨骼支撑结构；翼膜本身极少保存。
许多翼龙具有内部含气腔的气腔化骨骼；这一特征的程度和分布因骨骼而异。
研究通过生物力学模型检验了四足起跳。这是依据解剖结构和模型假设所作的重建，并非保存下来的行为。

title.en: An archosaur branch near dinosaurs
title.zh: 主龙类中接近恐龙的一支

text.en: Expanded anatomical analyses place pterosaurs within Ornithodira, on the archosaur branch close to dinosaurs. Their exact origin and closest relatives remain dependent on the characters and analyses used; this placement does not identify a direct dinosaur ancestor.
text.zh: 扩展解剖特征的系统分析将翼龙置于鸟跖类，属于接近恐龙的主龙类支系。但其确切起源和最近亲仍随所选特征与分析方法而变化；这种位置判断并未指出某个恐龙是翼龙的直接祖先。

title.en: A worldwide record with large gaps
title.zh: 全球都有记录，但缺口很大

text.en: The redescription of Carniadactylus documents a Norian pterosaur sample from the Late Triassic, but one dated locality does not establish the group’s first global appearance. A separate analysis of 108 pterosaur taxa reported remains from every continent while emphasizing severe gaps in where and when fossils are known. Geographic patterns therefore depend on an uneven, time-sensitive record.
text.zh: Carniadactylus 的重新描述记录了晚三叠世诺利期的翼龙材料，但一个有年代依据的地点不能确定翼龙类在全球的最早出现。另一项包含 108 个翼龙分类单元的分析报告称各大洲均有化石，同时强调已知记录在空间与时间上都有严重缺口。因此，地理格局解释受不均匀且随时间变化的化石记录影响。

title.en: What particular fossils preserve
title.zh: 特定化石究竟保存了什么

text.en: One Hamipterus block preserves many eggs, including embryo-bearing eggs, giving a direct fossil record of reproduction in that deposit. In a separate Crato Formation specimen, melanosome geometry in preserved integument was used to assess a possible signalling role. These are specific fossil cases; behavioral readings and feather-homology claims remain interpretations, not observations of living pterosaurs.
text.zh: 一块 Hamipterus 化石板保存了多枚卵，其中有些含胚胎，为该沉积地点提供了直接的翼龙繁殖化石记录。另一件来自 Crato 组的标本，其保存体表组织中的黑素体形态被用于评估可能的信号展示功能。这些结论属于特定化石案例；行为解释和“羽毛”同源判断仍是研究者的解释，不是对活体翼龙的直接观察。

title.en: Testing flight with explicit assumptions
title.zh: 用明确假设检验飞行能力

text.en: Biomechanical studies use reconstructed body mass, wing dimensions, muscle power and launch kinematics to test whether giant pterosaurs could fly and launch quadrupedally. Their outputs are feasibility results conditioned on those inputs, not preserved motions or measurements that apply uniformly across the pterosaur radiation.
text.zh: 生物力学研究以重建的体重、翼部尺寸、肌肉功率和起飞运动学为输入，检验巨型翼龙能否飞行及以四足方式起飞。其结论是在这些输入条件下得到的可行性结果，不是保存下来的动作，也不能一概推广到所有翼龙类群。

title.zh: Haliskia：骨骼观察与重建的界线
title.en: Haliskia: observations and reconstruction

text.zh: Haliskia peterseni 的 KK F1426 部分骨架提供一个比较入口：先看地层与保存部位，再看牙列和细长舌骨；约 4.6 米翼展是比较估计，摄食解释缺少直接内容物证据。属级导读把这些证据类型分开。它可与本页既有卵、体表和飞行模型研究对读，但不能把其他翼龙的观察移作 Haliskia 的事实；PBDB 补充目录路径也不代表唯一系统树。
text.en: Partial skeleton KK F1426 of Haliskia peterseni offers a comparison route: read the horizon and preserved elements before the teeth and elongated hyoid bones. Its approximately 4.6 m span is estimated comparatively, while feeding interpretations lack direct preserved contents. The genus guide separates these evidence types. Compare them with the egg, integument and flight-model studies already introduced here, retaining taxon-specific observations. A supplementary PBDB directory path does not represent a uniquely resolved phylogeny.

title.en: Organize fossil records by source classification
title.zh: 按来源分类组织化石记录

text.zh: Pterosauria 是本批 PBDB 路径中的 order 分类名称。其下本批可读 252 个固定工作名录物种的出现导读；这里使用数据库记录的父级路径编排资料，不以资料条目数量评定类群演化重要性，也不把这一路径视为唯一系统发育方案。
text.en: Pterosauria is recorded at rank order in this batch’s PBDB path. This route offers occurrence guides for 252 species in the fixed working roster. Recorded database parents organize the material; entry counts do not establish evolutionary importance, and this path is not treated as the only phylogenetic scheme.

title.en: Compare collections, strata and age brackets
title.zh: 从采集地、地层和年代对读

text.zh: 可以从 Seazzadactylus venieri、Kunpengopterus sinensis、Kunpengopterus antipollicatus、Eotephradactylus mcintireae、Ikrandraco avatar 开始，对照各页具名采集记录和原引文。本路线所含的全部本批物种合计有 405 条所选出现记录、277 个采集记录，地层名示例为 Dolomia di Forni、Tiaojishan、Chinle、Jiufotang。先读每个采集地自己的年代区间和鉴定限定，再看不同地点之间是否可比；出现、采集和物种数量不能混用为古种群规模。
text.en: Start with Seazzadactylus venieri, Kunpengopterus sinensis, Kunpengopterus antipollicatus, Eotephradactylus mcintireae, Ikrandraco avatar and compare each page’s named collections and original reference links. Across all species included in this group’s guide, there are 405 selected occurrences from 277 collections; example stratum names are Dolomia di Forni, Tiaojishan, Chinle, Jiufotang. Read each collection’s age bracket and identification qualifications before comparing sites. Occurrence, collection and species counts cannot be exchanged for ancient population size.

title.en: Baron (2021), The origin of Pterosaurs
title.zh: Baron（2021），翼龙的起源

scope.en: Systematic review and expanded anatomical phylogenetic analyses; supports an ornithodiran placement while retaining uncertainty over pterosaur origins and closest relatives.
scope.zh: 系统综述与扩展解剖系统分析支持将翼龙置于鸟跖类，同时保留其起源和最近亲的不确定性。

title.en: Dalla Vecchia (2009), Carniadactylus anatomy and systematics
title.zh: Dalla Vecchia（2009），Carniadactylus 的解剖与系统分类

scope.en: Detailed redescription and phylogenetic analysis of Norian pterosaur holotype MFSN 1797 and referred specimen MPUM 6009; this locality does not establish a global first appearance.
scope.zh: 对诺利期翼龙正模 MFSN 1797 与归入标本 MPUM 6009 的详细再描述和系统分析；该地点不能确定全球最早出现时间。

title.en: Upchurch et al. (2015), pterosaurian biogeography
title.zh: Upchurch 等（2015），翼龙地理分布分析

scope.en: Quantitative analysis of 108 pterosaur taxa; reports an every-continent record while emphasizing severe spatial and temporal patchiness and sampling-sensitive biogeographic inference.
scope.zh: 对 108 个翼龙分类单元进行定量分析；报告各大洲均有记录，同时指出时空分布极不均匀，地理推断受采样影响。

title.en: Wang et al. (2017), Hamipterus eggs and embryos
title.zh: Wang 等（2017），Hamipterus 的卵与胚胎

scope.en: Reports exposed Hamipterus eggs and embryo-bearing specimens from one fossil block; behavioral and hatchling-flight interpretations remain distinct from preserved evidence.

title.en: Cincotta et al. (2022), pterosaur melanosomes and signalling

readerLimitations.en: This is a selective route through studies of pterosaur relationships, fossils, geography and flight biomechanics. The fossil record remains uneven: one dated locality or specimen cannot set the order’s complete range or life history. The cited studies do not establish a uniform diet or flight capability for all pterosaurs, and modelled launch results depend on each study’s specimens, inputs and assumptions.
readerLimitations.zh: 本页精选了翼龙亲缘关系、具名化石、地理记录和飞行力学研究。化石记录分布不均；单一地点或标本不能确定翼龙目的完整年代范围或生活史。所引研究不能为全目建立统一食性或飞行能力，模型结果受各研究所用材料、数据和假设限制。

geography: South Majiashan Quarry, Chaohu, Anhui, China
overview: Early Triassic maternal specimen AGM I-1 from south Majiashan Quarry preserves two embryos and an adjacent neonate. Its delayed ossification, dental and vertebral characters, and hypophalangeal flippers support assignment to Chaohusaurus, though species-level taxonomy can change.

ecology.diet: Diet is not preserved by this maternal specimen.
ecology.habitat: The animal is associated with the marine Majiashan depositional setting; its habitual habitat is not directly resolved.
ecology.locomotion: Paddle-like flippers are preserved, but gait and swimming performance were not measured.
ecology.bodySize: AGM I-1 records an adult with embryos; it does not establish a genus-wide size range.
ecology.guild: Predatory role is not directly observed in this specimen.
ecology.dietZh: 这件孕体标本没有保存食性证据。
ecology.habitatZh: 该动物与马家山海相沉积环境相关，但其惯常栖地没有被直接确定。
ecology.locomotionZh: 化石保存了桨状鳍肢，但没有测定步态或游泳表现。
ecology.bodySizeZh: AGM I-1 记录了一只带胚胎的成年个体，不能代表全属体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 这件标本没有直接记录捕食角色。

traits: The maternal skeleton preserves two embryos and an adjacent neonate.
Carpals and tarsals are less ossified than the metacarpals, metatarsals and phalanges.
Flipper proportions, teeth and vertebral characters contribute to the genus assignment.
evidenceSummary: The primary study documents AGM I-1 from the Spathian Nanlinghu Formation. Embryo orientation and a terrestrial origin for live birth are comparative interpretations, not observed behavior or an ancestral state for all ichthyosaurs.
overviewZh: 早三叠世的孕体标本 AGM I-1 出自马家山南采石场，保存了两具胚胎和一具相邻的新生个体。骨化延迟、牙齿与椎骨特征，以及指骨数较少的鳍肢支持将其归入 Chaohusaurus；种级分类仍可能修订。
traitsZh: 孕体骨架保存了两具胚胎和一具相邻的新生个体。
腕骨和跗骨的骨化程度低于掌骨、跖骨和指骨。
鳍肢比例、牙齿和椎骨特征共同用于属级鉴定。
evidenceSummaryZh: 原始研究记录了来自斯帕斯期 Nanlinghu 组的 AGM I-1。胚胎朝向及胎生起源于陆地的说法属于比较解释，不是直接观察到的行为，也不能代表所有鱼龙的祖先状态。

geography: Clay pit #3 of Lücking brick company, 1 km north of Bonenburg, Warburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
Rhaetian dark marine mudstones of the Exter Formation
overview: A small-bodied Late Triassic plesiosaurian represented by holotype LWL-MFN P 64047; its articulated anatomy and phylogenetic analysis extend the sampled plesiosaurian record into the Rhaetian without making the specimen a direct ancestor.

ecology.diet: Diet and prey are not directly preserved by the partial holotype
ecology.habitat: Marine mudstone depositional setting in the Rhaetian Exter Formation; habitual microhabitat remains unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Four similar flippers and a short tail support plesiosaurian hydrofoil and paraxial-locomotion comparisons, not a measured gait
ecology.bodySize: The subadult holotype has an estimated total length of 237 cm; a genus-wide size range is not inferred
ecology.guild: Marine predatory ecology is a broad plesiosaurian interpretation, not a directly observed feeding record

traits: Partial articulated skeleton preserving occiput, lower jaw, vertebral column, girdles and left limbs
Ventrally concave V-shaped neurocentral sutures in anterior and middle cervical vertebrae
Foreshortened zeugopodials and highly vascularized humeral and femoral bone tissue
evidenceSummary: The Exter Formation holotype documents anatomy and histology; basal placement and physiological implications remain analysis-dependent.

title.en: One skeleton gives a bounded portrait
title.zh: 一具骨架勾勒出有限的身体画像

text.en: Rhaeticosaurus mertensi is known from the subadult holotype LWL-MFN P 64047, a partly articulated skeleton from a Rhaetian bed in Germany's Exter Formation. It preserves the back of the skull, lower jaw, spine, shoulder and hip girdles, and left limbs. The published total-length estimate is 237 cm; it describes this individual, not a size range for the genus. The specimen extends the sampled plesiosaur record into the Rhaetian, but it is not identified as an ancestor of later plesiosaurs.
text.zh: Rhaeticosaurus mertensi 目前由亚成体正模 LWL-MFN P 64047 代表。这具部分关节相连的骨架出自德国 Exter 组瑞替期地层，保存枕部、下颌、脊柱、肩带与骨盆，以及左侧肢骨。论文估计该个体全长 237 厘米；这不是整个属的体型范围。它把已采样的蛇颈龙类化石记录延伸到瑞替期，但没有证据表明它是后来蛇颈龙的直接祖先。

title.en: A matrix position and a swimming comparison
title.zh: 矩阵位置与游泳方式比较

text.en: In a published analysis of 35 taxa and 270 characters, the species falls within Plesiosauria as a basal member of Pliosauridae. That is the result of one character matrix, not a visible family relationship in the rock. Four similar flippers and a short tail invite comparisons with underwater hydrofoils and paraxial swimming; neither a swimming gait nor speed is measured from the fossil. The partial skeleton also gives no direct evidence of a particular prey or diet.
text.zh: 在一项包含 35 个分类单元和 270 项性状的分析中，本种被恢复在蛇颈龙目内、作为基干上龙科成员。这是一次性状矩阵分析的结果，并非化石中能直接看到的亲缘关系。四个相似鳍肢和短尾可以与水下水翼及轴旁游泳方式作比较，但化石没有记录实际步态或速度。残缺骨架也没有直接说明特定猎物或食谱。

title.en: What the bone tissue can and cannot show
title.zh: 骨组织能说明什么，又不能说明什么

text.en: The sampled humerus and femur contain highly vascularized bone tissue, which the study uses to discuss growth and physiology. Histology informs an interpretation; it does not directly record metabolism or behavior. The holotype comes from a named clay pit and a specific Exter Formation bed, 21 m below the Triassic–Jurassic boundary. That documented horizon is a locality record, not a complete global range or a precise date for the individual.
text.zh: 研究检查的肱骨和股骨样本具有血管丰富的骨组织，据此讨论生长和生理。组织切片能为解释提供线索，却没有直接记录代谢或行为。正模来自具名黏土坑和 Exter 组特定地层，位置在三叠纪—侏罗纪界线以下 21 米。这个层位证明一处采集记录，不是全球完整分布，也不是对该个体的精确定年。

overview: The 2024 description names Haliskia peterseni from holotype KK F1426, now housed at Kronosaurus Korner in Richmond, Queensland. The partial skeleton preserves the front of the skull, lower jaw, both ceratobranchials of the hyoid apparatus, and parts of the spine, ribs and limbs; the paper lists 43 teeth. Major upper-arm and forearm bones are missing. Its measurements describe this individual, not the full variation of the species. The name honours Kevin Petersen, who recovered and prepared it.

ecology.diet: Not assessed as a complete taxon diet; see specimen-level interpretations.
ecology.habitat: Locality context is described in the reader sections.
ecology.bodySize: Specimen-based estimates are discussed where available.

evidenceSummary:
This account combines the holotype description and its comparative analyses with one PBDB collection. The estimated wingspan and proposed feeding function depend on incomplete bones and comparison; matrix placement is less resolved below Anhangueria. Neither the burial setting nor database occurrence count establishes the species’ full ecology, behaviour or geographic range.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.en: A species anchored by a partial skeleton
title.zh: 一件部分骨架固定的物种

text.zh: 2024 年描述以正模 KK F1426 命名 Haliskia peterseni；标本现存于昆士兰 Richmond 的 Kronosaurus Korner。它是部分骨架，保存头骨前部、下颌、两根角鳃骨及部分脊柱、肋骨和四肢，论文列出 43 枚牙齿。上臂和前臂的主要长骨缺失，因此尺寸首先描述这一件标本，而非整个物种的变异范围。种名纪念发现并清理标本的 Kevin Petersen。
text.en: The 2024 description names Haliskia peterseni from holotype KK F1426, now housed at Kronosaurus Korner in Richmond, Queensland. The partial skeleton preserves the front of the skull, lower jaw, both ceratobranchials of the hyoid apparatus, and parts of the spine, ribs and limbs; the paper lists 43 teeth. Major upper-arm and forearm bones are missing. Its measurements describe this individual, not the full variation of the species. The name honours Kevin Petersen, who recovered and prepared it.

title.en: The marine context of the Toolebuc Formation
title.zh: Toolebuc 组的海相背景

text.zh: 标本于 2021 年 11 月采自 Richmond 西北的 Dig Site 3，来自 Toolebuc 组阿尔布期地层。孢粉生物地层用于约束层位，并非对骨骼直接测年。该 Eromanga 盆地地层的石灰岩和油页岩记录海侵背景，伴生材料包括双壳类及未定种辐鳍鱼类遗骸。埋藏环境说明化石保存背景，不能证明本种终生在海上活动或完整分布范围。
text.en: The fossil was collected in November 2021 at Dig Site 3, northwest of Richmond, from Albian strata of the Toolebuc Formation. Spore and pollen biostratigraphy constrains the horizon; it is not a direct date on the bones. Limestone and oil shale in the Eromanga Basin unit record a marine-transgression setting, and associated remains include bivalves and indeterminate ray-finned fishes. This burial context does not establish lifelong marine activity or the species’ full range.

title.en: Teeth, crests and elongated hyoid bones
title.zh: 牙列、头冠和细长舌骨

text.zh: 鉴别特征来自牙齿组合：第四、第五对小于第三、第六对；第二、第五对齿槽又小于第三至第四对和第六至第八对。前颌和下颌都有冠，但冠形单独不足以区分近缘分类单元；部分结构受挤压或发掘损伤。完整左角鳃骨长 280 mm，下颌长 400 mm，比例为 0.70。论文有时称其为舌骨／头骨比；这里明确采用实际列出的角鳃骨与下颌测量。该比例不直接测量软组织舌长。
text.en: The diagnosis relies on a tooth pattern: the fourth and fifth pairs are smaller than the third and sixth, while the second and fifth alveolar pairs are smaller than pairs three to four and six to eight. Both the premaxilla and lower jaw carry crests, but crest shape alone does not separate related taxa; crushing and excavation damage affect some bones. The complete left ceratobranchial is 280 mm long and the mandible is 400 mm, a ratio of 0.70. Although the paper calls this a hyoid-to-skull ratio in places, these are the two measurements used here; the ratio is not a direct measure of the soft-tissue tongue.

title.en: How the approximately 4.6 m wingspan was estimated
title.zh: 约 4.6 米翼展如何得出

text.zh: 作者将乌喙骨、第四掌骨和第一翼指节等长度与骨骼成熟的近缘种比较，估计翼展约 4.60 m。肱骨、尺骨和桡骨缺失，后续翼指骨也不完整；因此这是针对该标本的比较复原，不是完整翼展的直接测量、个体最大尺寸或物种范围。作者也指出，依据其他澳大利亚翼龙的部分下颌推算巨大翼展，会受到比较对象选择影响。
text.en: The authors estimate a wingspan of about 4.60 m by comparing the coracoid, fourth metacarpal and first wing-finger phalanx with mature relatives. The humerus, ulna and radius are absent, and later wing-finger bones are incomplete. This is a comparative reconstruction for the specimen, not a directly measured full span, a maximum individual size or a species-wide range. Comparator choice also affects large spans proposed for other Australian pterosaurs from partial jaws.

title.en: Relationships depend on matrices and unstable taxa
title.zh: 近缘关系受矩阵和不稳定分类单元影响

text.zh: 两套性状矩阵分别只能编码约 30.7% 和 27.6% 的标本性状。两套分析都将 Haliskia 放在 Anhangueria 内，但更细的关系不同，包括移除不稳定分类单元后的结果。讨论把它与 Ferrodraco 的关系表示为姐妹群，或与 Mythunga 一同构成多分支关系；没有一项结果指定直接祖先。PBDB 2026-10-02 的路径将本种接入 Haliskia 和 Anhangueridae，这是数据库分类，不自动等同于固定的 COL26.8 概念。
text.en: Two character-matrix analyses score about 30.7% and 27.6% of the specimen’s characters. Both place Haliskia within Anhangueria, but finer relationships differ, including results after unstable taxa are removed. The discussion places it near Ferrodraco either as its sister taxon or in a group also containing Mythunga. Neither result names a direct ancestor. PBDB’s 2 October 2026 path connects the species to Haliskia and Anhangueridae; it is a database classification, separate from pinned COL26.8 concepts.

title.en: Feeding hypotheses derived from anatomy
title.zh: 从骨骼提出的摄食假说

text.zh: 标本没有保存能直接说明食物的喉部或胸腔内容物。作者提出，细长舌骨、弯曲牙齿和腭部形态可能帮助控制滑溜猎物；少量牙齿磨耗也被用于讨论头足类等软体猎物。这些是功能与食性解释，不是观察到捕鱼或测得猎物比例。论文提醒，舌骨形态单独不能确定食物偏好；翼龙之间的生态位差异还需要更可靠的年代和独立证据。
text.en: The specimen preserves no throat or chest contents that directly reveal food. The authors propose that elongated hyoid bones, curved teeth and palate shape might help restrain slippery prey; limited tooth wear also informs a hypothesis of soft-bodied prey such as cephalopods. These are functional and dietary interpretations, not observed fishing or measured prey proportions. The paper cautions that hyoid form alone cannot determine food preference; proposed niche differences among pterosaurs also need firmer age control and independent evidence.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
PBDB 将 Haliskia peterseni 记为 Haliskia 属下的物种。所选样本有 1 条出现记录，来自 1 个采集地并关联 1 条引文；这些是数据库数量，不是化石或动物个体数。

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh:

overview: The holotype of Ferrodraco lentoni is AODF 876, nicknamed Butch, held by the Australian Age of Dinosaurs museum. The 2019 description records the front of the skull and mandible, five incomplete cervical vertebrae, and partial shoulder and wing elements. It is not a complete skeleton. Matching matrix around adjacent bones indicates articulation after fossilization, followed by fragmentation through erosion and soil disturbance before excavation. The genus name’s ferrum refers to ironstone preservation; the species honors Graham Thomas “Butch” Lenton’s support for Winton and the museum.

The collection locality, broad age range, environmental setting and preservation labels describe this record; they do not establish the species full range, exact origin or extinction time, habitat, abundance or the condition of every fossil. The 2019 holotype description supplies specimen anatomy, while the database record and later comparisons retain their own evidence scopes.

title.en: AODF 876: a partial skeleton in ironstone
title.zh: AODF 876：铁质岩中的部分骨架

text.zh: Ferrodraco lentoni 的正模为澳大利亚恐龙时代博物馆收藏的 AODF 876，昵称 Butch。2019 年原始描述记录头骨与下颌前部、五件不完整颈椎、部分肩带及翼肢材料；不是一具完整骨架。若干相邻骨骼的包裹岩石仍能拼接，说明化石形成后曾保持连接，但侵蚀和土壤扰动在发掘前使其碎裂。属名中的 ferrum 指铁，说明铁质岩保存背景；种名纪念支持 Winton 社区与博物馆的 Graham Thomas “Butch” Lenton。
text.en: The holotype of Ferrodraco lentoni is AODF 876, nicknamed Butch, held by the Australian Age of Dinosaurs museum. The 2019 description records the front of the skull and mandible, five incomplete cervical vertebrae, and partial shoulder and wing elements. It is not a complete skeleton. Matching matrix around adjacent bones indicates articulation after fossilization, followed by fragmentation through erosion and soil disturbance before excavation. The genus name’s ferrum refers to ironstone preservation; the species honors Graham Thomas “Butch” Lenton’s support for Winton and the museum.

title.en: The Winton horizon and a possible late survival
title.zh: Winton 组层位与晚存续解释

text.zh: 标本于 2017 年 4 月发现于昆士兰州 Winton 的 Belmont Station，模式地点为 AODL 245。描述将其归入 Winton 组的森诺曼期至早土仑期范围。作者据区域碎屑锆石研究讨论该组北部可能晚至早土仑期的沉积，但同时明确本种模式地点仍缺少精细年龄约束。因此，可能较晚存续是待进一步约束的解释，不是正模直接测得的精确年龄，也不足以单独确认澳大利亚是这一支翼龙的避难所。
text.en: The specimen was found in April 2017 at Belmont Station near Winton, Queensland; the type locality is AODL 245. The description assigns it to the Cenomanian–early Turonian range of the Winton Formation. Regional detrital-zircon studies motivate discussion of potentially early Turonian deposition in the northern formation, but the authors explicitly note that this type locality lacks refined age constraints. Possible late survival remains an interpretation requiring better stratigraphy, rather than a precise date measured directly from the holotype or proof of an Australian refugium.

title.en: Tooth-size combinations and incomplete crests
title.zh: 牙齿大小组合与保存不全的冠

text.zh: 描述的两项主要鉴别特征是：前颌骨与下颌的第一对牙齿小于其他前部牙齿；第四至第七对小于第三与第八对。保存材料还显示头冠、下颌冠的残部以及相对突起的齿槽边缘。头冠后部不完整，下颌冠的完整高度也不能由残部直接量出。CT 数据帮助识别腭脊、下颌沟和位于功能牙远端及舌侧的替换牙；这些观察属于 AODF 876，不能仅凭冠形或单枚离散牙给所有未定种材料重新命名。
text.en: The two principal diagnostic features are first premaxillary and mandibular tooth pairs smaller than the other anterior teeth, and fourth through seventh pairs smaller than the third and eighth. Preserved material also shows a cranial crest, remnants of a mandibular crest and raised alveolar margins. The cranial crest is incomplete posteriorly, and the complete mandibular-crest height cannot be measured from its remnant. CT data reveal a palatal ridge, mandibular groove and replacement teeth distal and lingual to functional teeth. These observations concern AODF 876; a crest or isolated tooth alone cannot rename all indeterminate material.

title.en: The approximately four-metre span is estimated
title.zh: 约四米翼展是比较估计

text.zh: 2019 年论文根据正模测量与其他 Anhangueria 翼龙比较，估计翼展约 4 m。许多表列骨长标有不完整保存符号；部分尺骨、桡骨、第四掌骨和第一翼指节还受挤压或变形。骨架复原的缺失部分依据比较对象补配，因此约四米不是完整翼膜或整翼的直接测量。它也不建立本种最大体型、年龄范围或飞行性能；与其他论文的翼展数字比较时，应先比较保存材料和重建方法。
text.en: The 2019 paper estimates a wingspan of approximately 4 m from holotype measurements and comparison with other anhanguerians. Many tabulated lengths are marked as incomplete; parts of the ulna, radius, fourth metacarpal and first wing phalanx are crushed or distorted. Missing portions in the skeletal reconstruction rely on comparators, so the span is not a direct measurement of a complete wing or membrane. It does not establish maximum species size, an age range or flight performance. Comparisons with estimates in other papers should begin with preservation and reconstruction methods.

title.en: Evidence for skeletal maturity
title.zh: 骨骼成熟判断及其边界

text.zh: 作者依据肩胛骨与喙骨融合，以及第一翼指节伸肌腱突骨化，认为正模个体骨骼发育已成熟；但 CT 显示腕骨尚未缝合。两类状态均保留在描述中，不将某一融合状态转换成精确年龄、性别或繁殖阶段。标本没有覆盖幼体至成体的成长序列，因此也不能用这一件骨架推断本种的发育速度或寿命。
text.en: Fusion of the scapulocoracoid and ossification of the extensor tendon process on the first wing phalanx led the authors to interpret the individual as ontogenetically mature. CT scans nevertheless show unsutured carpals. Both observations remain part of the account; neither is converted into an exact age, sex or reproductive stage. A single skeleton supplies no juvenile-to-adult series from which to infer species growth rate or lifespan.

title.en: Two 2019 analyses and later catalogue names
title.zh: 2019 年两套分析与后来的目录名

text.zh: 2019 年研究采用两套矩阵：一套将 Ferrodraco 与 Mythunga 配成姐妹群，另一套则将 Ferrodraco 放在含 Anhanguera、Coloborhynchus 和 Ornithocheirus 的多分支之外，并因不稳定性剪除 Mythunga。论文沿用 Ornithocheiridae 等名称；本页 PBDB 2026-10-02 目录父链为 Anhangueridae—Tropeognathinae—Ferrodraco。Haliskia 的 2024 年研究另行比较 Ferrodraco，不能把这些有不同样本和定义的结果拼成唯一祖先序列。目录路径用来存放与导航，保留各论文原有分类范围。
text.en: The 2019 study uses two matrices: one pairs Ferrodraco with Mythunga, whereas the other places Ferrodraco outside a polytomy containing Anhanguera, Coloborhynchus and Ornithocheirus, pruning Mythunga because of instability. The paper uses names including Ornithocheiridae; the PBDB directory chain recorded on 2 October 2026 is Anhangueridae–Tropeognathinae–Ferrodraco. The 2024 Haliskia study compares Ferrodraco separately. Results based on different samples and definitions cannot be assembled into a unique ancestor sequence. The directory supports storage and navigation while retaining each publication’s taxonomic scope.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
PBDB 将 Ferrodraco lentoni 列为 Ferrodraco 属下的一个种。所选种级出现记录关联 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现记录、采集记录和引文编号是不同的数据库单位，不代表化石标本或动物个体数。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
Ferrodraco lentoni 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:399804。这份存档导读包含 1 条选取的出现记录，关联 1 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 1 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
PBDB lists Ferrodraco lentoni under the genus Ferrodraco. The selected species-level occurrence record links it to one collection and one reference. Occurrence, collection and reference counts describe different database units; they are not counts of fossils or animals.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Ferrodraco lentoni is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:399804. This archived guide contains 1 selected occurrence rows, linked to 1 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 1 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh:
采集记录 Pterosaur site, Belmont Station (AODL 0245)（Queensland），地区代码 AU，地层名称 Winton；数据库年代范围 100.5–89.8 Ma，早端地质时段 Middle Cenomanian、晚端时段 Early Turonian。地点名、地区代码和地层名按来源保留；这不是整个物种的分布清单，地区出现也不证明其他地区缺席。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
存档导读包含 1 条出现记录，以下列出全部记录。每个 occ: 编号标识一条出现记录；col: 标识其关联的采集记录。

- 出现记录 occ:1669830；PBDB 采集记录 col:236853。 地点字段 cnm=Pterosaur site, Belmont Station (AODL 0245)；地点分区字段 cc2=AU，stp=Queensland。 记录年代界：eag 100.5 Ma; lag 89.8 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Middle Cenomanian，oli=Early Turonian。 地层字段 sfm=Winton。 记录署名 Pentland et al. 2019；PBDB 引文编号 ref:71099。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Tucker et al. 2013 and Tucker et al. 2016 detrital zircon analysis suggest a maximum depositional age of 94–92Ma for the Winton Formation. The underlying upper Mackunda Formation had a maximum depositional age of 104–102Ma, suggesting that the base of the Winton Formation could be no older than Latest Albian.

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Pterosaur site, Belmont Station, near Winton
text.en:
Collection Pterosaur site, Belmont Station (AODL 0245) (Queensland), region code AU, stratum name Winton; database age bracket 100.5–89.8 Ma, early interval Middle Cenomanian and late interval Early Turonian. Locality names, region codes and stratigraphic names retain the source wording. This is not a complete species distribution list, and presence in one region does not prove absence elsewhere.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 100.5–89.8 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。

text.en:
Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 100.5–89.8 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Across these selected PBDB rows, the largest recorded eag=100.5 Ma in occ:1669830; the smallest recorded lag=89.8 Ma in occ:1669830. These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

title.en: Ferrodraco’s type species and preserved skeleton
title.zh: Ferrodraco 的模式种与保存骨架

text.zh: Ferrodraco lentoni 是模式种，依据为 AODF 876 部分骨架。属名指向铁质岩保存，种名用于纪念一人；名称来源本身不能说明食性或行为。PBDB 所记录的分类层级将 Ferrodraco 置于 Tropeognathinae 之内。
text.en: Ferrodraco lentoni is the type species, based on partial skeleton AODF 876. The genus name refers to ironstone preservation, while the species name honors an individual; neither name establishes diet or behavior. The recorded PBDB hierarchy places Ferrodraco within Tropeognathinae.

title.en: Ferrodraco and Haliskia: preserved material and span estimates
title.zh: Ferrodraco 与 Haliskia：保存材料与翼展估计

text.zh: Ferrodraco lentoni 的翼展估计约为四米，但化石没有保存可直接测量的完整翼。Haliskia peterseni 保存的骨骼不同，翼展同样来自重建，不能据此排列完整体型。2019 年和 2024 年系统发育分析使用不同矩阵和分类定义；分析结果不建立直系祖先关系，也不能把一个物种的舌骨或食性假说套到另一个物种。
text.en: A wingspan of about four metres is reconstructed for Ferrodraco lentoni; the fossil does not preserve a complete wing for direct measurement. Haliskia peterseni has a different set of preserved bones, and its span is also reconstructed, so the two estimates do not rank complete body size. The 2019 and 2024 phylogenetic analyses use different matrices and taxon definitions. Their results do not establish direct ancestry, and one species' hyoid anatomy or feeding hypotheses cannot be assigned to the other.

overview: The PBDB supplementary directory currently places Haliskia and Ferrodraco within Anhangueridae, with Ferrodraco nested in Tropeognathinae. The 2019 Ferrodraco description uses Ornithocheiridae, while the 2024 Haliskia study discusses analyses with different matrices and clade definitions. These records document distinct classification choices; they do not combine into one uncontested family tree.

evidenceSummary: This is a selected path through two holotype studies and comparative material, not a complete family review. Published studies use different specimens and taxonomic definitions, and the selected species pages do not form a complete descendant catalogue. Occurrences, collections, and species are different counting units. Database age bounds do not give exact origin or extinction times, and the record set does not supply a shared ecological account for Anhangueridae.

title.zh: 关联比较标本与孤立翼骨
title.en: Associated comparative specimen and isolated wing bones

text.zh: 除澳大利亚材料外，Tropeognathus mesembrinus 的大型比较标本也提供了另一条阅读线索。MN 6594-V 保存相连的头部与身体材料；MCT 1838-R 只有肱骨远端，MPSC R 1395 是部分翼部，后两件仅鉴定为科级归属未定的翼龙。它们是三件保存状态不同的标本，不能视为归入同一物种的三个个体。
text.en: Alongside the Australian material, the large comparative specimen Tropeognathus mesembrinus provides another route into the evidence. MN 6594-V preserves associated skull and body material. MCT 1838-R is a distal humerus, and MPSC R 1395 is part of a wing; both are identified only as pterosaurs of uncertain family. These are three differently preserved specimens, not three individuals assigned to one species.

title.zh: 重建图、组织切片与翼展回答不同问题
title.en: Reconstructions, histology and span estimates answer different questions

text.zh: 比较研究中的照片呈现了头骨碎片，重建图以阴影标出实存部位。翼骨薄片可用于估计生长阶段；翼展数值则通过其他骨架补全缺失部分，是重建估值。不同方法回答不同问题：轮廓图完整不等于头骨保存完整，生长接近停止不等于测得成年最大体型，估算翼展也不能直接说明食性或飞行性能。
text.en: Photographs in the comparative study show preserved skull fragments, while a reconstruction shades the areas that remain. Thin sections from wing bones help estimate growth stage. Wingspan values are estimates that fill missing bones by comparison with other skeletons. Each method answers a different question: a complete drawing does not mean the skull is complete, near cessation of growth does not establish the largest adult size, and an estimated wingspan does not reveal diet or flight performance.

title.en: Taxonomic names, definitions and dates
title.zh: 分类名称、定义与年份

text.zh: PBDB 补充目录目前将 Haliskia 与 Ferrodraco 置于 Anhangueridae，且将 Ferrodraco 归在 Tropeognathinae 下。2019 年 Ferrodraco 描述使用 Ornithocheiridae 等名称；2024 年 Haliskia 研究则讨论采用不同矩阵和支系定义的分析。这些记录反映不同分类选择，并未拼合成一棵无争议的科级系统树。
text.en: The PBDB supplementary directory currently places Haliskia and Ferrodraco within Anhangueridae, with Ferrodraco nested in Tropeognathinae. The 2019 Ferrodraco description uses Ornithocheiridae, while the 2024 Haliskia study discusses analyses with different matrices and clade definitions. These records document distinct classification choices; they do not combine into one uncontested family tree.

title.en: Ferrodraco and Haliskia: two Australian holotypes
title.zh: Ferrodraco 与 Haliskia：两件澳大利亚正模

text.zh: 两个物种展示了证据的差异：本页所述 Ferrodraco lentoni 标本为 AODF 876，Haliskia peterseni 为 KK F1426。比较时可先看保存骨骼、地层、牙齿、生长证据与翼展重建，再看系统发育分析。Haliskia 的舌骨和摄食假说不是关于 Ferrodraco 的直接证据。这些例子不能证明整个科拥有同一种食性或生活方式。
text.en: Two species illustrate how the evidence differs: Ferrodraco lentoni is represented here by AODF 876, and Haliskia peterseni by KK F1426. Compare the bones that survive, the geological horizons, teeth, growth evidence, and reconstructed wingspans before comparing their phylogenetic analyses. Haliskia's hyoid bones and feeding hypotheses are not direct evidence about Ferrodraco. These examples do not establish one diet or way of life for the whole family.

title.en: Anhangueridae: PBDB classification route
title.zh: Anhangueridae：PBDB 分类路径

text.zh: 本 PBDB 路径将 Anhangueridae 记录为科级，并链接到本导读固定名录中的 14 个物种。数据库父级路径用于整理记录；它在目录中的位置不能裁定已发表系统发育分析之间的分歧。
text.en: This PBDB branch records Anhangueridae at family rank and links to 14 species in the fixed roster used for this guide. The parent path helps organize the records; its position in the database does not resolve differences among published phylogenetic analyses.

title.en: Member material linked to Anhangueridae
title.zh: 与 Anhangueridae 关联的成员材料

text.zh: 本导读包括 Haliskia peterseni、Thapunngaka shawi、Mythunga camara、Tropeognathus mesembrinus 和 Ferrodraco lentoni，并链接到各自具名的采集记录与参考文献。所选物种页合计列出 18 条出现记录、15 个采集记录。Toolebuc、Romualdo、Winton 与 Ifezouane 是其中的地层名称示例。每个采集记录有自己的年代区间和鉴定限定；这些总数不是古代动物个体数或种群规模。
text.en: The guide includes Haliskia peterseni, Thapunngaka shawi, Mythunga camara, Tropeognathus mesembrinus, and Ferrodraco lentoni, with links to their named collections and references. Across the selected species pages are 18 occurrence records from 15 collections. Toolebuc, Romualdo, Winton, and Ifezouane are examples of the recorded strata. Each collection has its own age interval and identification limits; the totals are not counts of ancient animals or population size.

Occurrences, collections, and species are different counting units. Database age bounds do not give exact origin or extinction times, and the record set does not supply a shared ecological account for Anhangueridae.

overview: The 2021 description names KKF494 as the holotype: the front portion of a crested lower jaw, with tooth sockets but no teeth preserved in place. The specimen is held at Kronosaurus Korner in Richmond.

ecology.diet: Not assessed as a complete taxon diet.
ecology.habitat: Locality evidence is described in reader sections.
ecology.bodySize: Size estimates and their limitations are discussed in reader sections.

evidenceSummary:
The holotype is a partial lower jaw, the proposed upper-jaw referral is contested, and large size estimates depend on extrapolation. The phylogenetic result is unresolved. Two selected collections do not establish a continuous range or abundance; their age bounds are not exact specimen dates. The available records do not establish diet, reproduction, or behavior.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 2 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.en: The holotype preserves part of a mandible
title.zh: 正模保存的是部分下颌

text.zh: 2021 年描述指定 KKF494 为正模：一段带冠下颌的前部，保存齿槽，但没有牙齿留在原位。标本现藏于 Richmond 的 Kronosaurus Korner。
text.en: The 2021 description names KKF494 as the holotype: the front portion of a crested lower jaw, with tooth sockets but no teeth preserved in place. The specimen is held at Kronosaurus Korner in Richmond.

title.en: Formation assignment and exact horizon
title.zh: 地层范围与精确层位

text.zh: 模式地点记为 Richmond 西北的 Wanamara Country，位于 Toolebuc 组上阿尔布期。它在该组内的精确层位未知。
text.en: The type locality is reported from Wanamara Country northwest of Richmond, in the upper Albian Toolebuc Formation. Its exact position within the formation is not known.

title.en: Why a large span is not a direct measurement
title.zh: 为何不把巨大翼展当作直接测量

text.zh: 2024 年 Haliskia 描述重新讨论了 Thapunngaka 的体型估算。较大的翼展值是由残缺下颌材料外推而来，结果会受比较物种以及下颌联合部与头骨比例假设影响。作者认为，按当时可用证据，不能支持称它为澳大利亚已知最大的翼龙。这一有明确时间背景的批评没有补出缺失的翅膀，也不能裁定所有后续标本；有争议的估值不是实测的典型体型或物种最大值。
text.en: A 2024 study describing Haliskia revisited estimates of Thapunngaka's size. The larger wingspans were extrapolated from partial jaw material, so the result depends on the comparison species and the proportions assumed between the jaw symphysis and skull. The authors argued that evidence available at that time did not support calling it Australia's largest known pterosaur. That dated criticism does not supply missing wings or decide every later specimen; the debated estimates are not a measured typical size or species maximum.

title.en: What the second specimen preserves
title.zh: 第二件标本保存了什么

text.zh: 后续论文描述 KKF600（也写作 KKF0600）：两块不完整的上颌前部材料，来自 Richmond 西北的 Cambridge Quarry，属于 Toolebuc 组上阿尔布期。它增加了上颌材料，但不是与正模个体相连的完整头骨或翅膀。
text.en: The later paper describes KKF600, also written KKF0600: two incomplete pieces from the front of an upper jaw. They came from Cambridge Quarry, northwest of Richmond, in the upper Albian Toolebuc Formation. They add upper-jaw material, not a complete skull or wings belonging to the holotype individual.

title.en: Referral evidence and the later objection
title.zh: 归属依据与质疑分别是什么

text.zh: Richards 等依据齿槽的形状和排列，以及相互吻合的咬合面，将 KKF600 归入 Thapunngaka shawi；他们也指出两件标本没有任何重叠的解剖部位。2024 年 Haliskia 研究质疑这一归属，理由包括缺乏重叠、Toolebuc 组至少有三个翼龙分类单元，以及其他地点的古魔翼龙类多样性。这个归属仍有争议，不能作为无争议的种级特征来源。
text.en: Richards and colleagues referred KKF600 to Thapunngaka shawi based on the form and arrangement of its tooth sockets and matching biting surfaces. They also noted that the two specimens share no overlapping anatomical part. The 2024 Haliskia study questioned the referral, citing that gap, at least three pterosaur taxa in the Toolebuc Formation, and anhanguerian diversity at other sites. The referral remains disputed rather than an undisputed source of species-level traits.

title.en: Mythungini as a phylogenetic hypothesis
title.zh: Mythungini 是分析提出的关系假说

text.zh: 后续研究的严格共识树将 Thapunngaka、Mythunga 与 Ferrodraco 放在一个未解析的三分支上，并命名为 Mythungini。这里记录的是该项分析结果，并未确定三者中哪一个与另一个亲缘最近。
text.en: In the later study's strict consensus tree, Thapunngaka, Mythunga, and Ferrodraco form an unresolved three-way branch named Mythungini. The result records that analysis; it does not establish which of the three is the other's closest relative.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
固定的 PBDB 翼龙名录将 Thapunngaka shawi 作为接受种，父级名称为 Thapunngaka。本导读纳入两条符合条件的种级出现记录、两个采集记录和两个引文编号。每个数字计量不同的数据库记录单位，不等于标本或动物个数。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
Thapunngaka shawi 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:478714。这份存档导读包含 2 条选取的出现记录，关联 2 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 2 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
The fixed PBDB pterosaur roster accepts Thapunngaka shawi under the parent name Thapunngaka. This guide includes two eligible species-level occurrence records, two collections, and two reference identifiers. Each count measures a different kind of database record, not specimens or animals.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Thapunngaka shawi is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:478714. This archived guide contains 2 selected occurrence rows, linked to 2 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 2 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh:
Cambridge Quarry, Morungle Station（Queensland；地区代码 AU）记录于 Toolebuc 组，年代范围为 113.2–100.5 Ma，早端时段标签为 Albian。Free Fossil Hunting Site 1（Queensland；AU）也列在 Toolebuc 组，年代范围为 106.3–100.5 Ma，早端时段标签为 Late Albian。地点、地区和地层名称沿用数据库写法。这些所选记录不能确定物种的完整分布，也不能证明其他地区没有它。

存档导读包含 2 条出现记录，以下列出全部记录。每个 occ: 编号标识一条出现记录；col: 标识其关联的采集记录。

Cambridge Quarry, Morungle Station (Queensland; region code AU) is recorded in the Toolebuc Formation with an age bracket of 113.2–100.5 Ma and an early-interval label of Albian. Free Fossil Hunting Site 1 (Queensland; AU) is also listed with Toolebuc, an age bracket of 106.3–100.5 Ma, and an early-interval label of Late Albian. title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
所选记录合并后的年代外界为 113.2–100.5 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。它由最早的早端边界与最晚的晚端边界组成，不是连续的化石记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。各采集记录保留自身较宽的年代区间；此处不改写原研究的定年解释。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
在这组 PBDB 记录中，最大记录 eag=113.2 Ma，见 occ:1638990；最小记录 lag=100.5 Ma，见 occ:1638990。这些数值是具名数据库记录的年代界，不代表两者之间存在连续记录，也不是该物种的起源、灭绝或个体寿命日期。每条记录各自的 eag 与 lag 值见上文。
text.en:
Together, the selected records have an outer age envelope of 113.2–100.5 Ma, where Ma means millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound; it is not a continuous fossil record or a measured species origin, extinction, or individual lifespan. Each collection keeps its own broader interval, and this envelope does not revise the original dating interpretations.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Across these selected PBDB rows, the largest recorded eag=113.2 Ma in occ:1638990; the smallest recorded lag=100.5 Ma in occ:1638990. These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh:
Cambridge Quarry, Morungle Station 的数据库标签为陆相、环境未定（terrestrial indet.），保存方式为实体化石（body）。Free Fossil Hunting Site 1 标为海相、环境未定（marine indet.）和实体化石（body）。这些是采集地与集合层面的数据库描述，不据此确定本种栖地或食性，也不代表每件化石的保存状态。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页区分出现记录编号、采集记录编号和材料说明。PBDB 采集记录编号不是单件标本编号。来源行提供的鉴定、材料、丰度及坐标／模型字段照录如下；采集层级的说明不被扩展成对每件化石的断言。

- occ:1638990：PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Thapunngaka shawi；材料说明字段 ocm=KKF600；丰度字段 abv=1，abu=specimens；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=142.933609，lat=-20.426111；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=139.78，pla=-66.69。
- occ:1669831：PBDB 原鉴定字段 idn=Thapunngaka shawi n. gen. n. sp.；PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Thapunngaka shawi；材料说明字段 ocm=KKF494；丰度字段 abv=1，abu=individuals；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=143.099442，lat=-20.646944；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=135.81，pla=-61.96。
text.en:
Cambridge Quarry, Morungle Station is labelled terrestrial indet. for collection environment and body for preservation mode. Free Fossil Hunting Site 1 is labelled marine indet. and body. These are database descriptions of collection settings and assemblages; they do not determine this species' habitat or diet, or describe every fossil individually.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:

overview: Holotype QM F18896 preserves an incomplete snout with an adherent mandible. Phillip Gilmore found it in 1991 at Dunluce Station near Hughenden, within a calcareous nodule from the Toolebuc Formation, assigned to the late Albian in the 2007 paper.

ecology.diet: Not assessed as a complete taxon diet.
ecology.habitat: Locality evidence is described in reader sections.
ecology.bodySize: Size estimates and their limitations are discussed in reader sections.

title.en: Start with the holotype and locality
title.zh: 从正模与产地开始

text.zh: 正模 QM F18896 是不完整吻部及相贴的下颌。Phillip Gilmore 于 1991 年在 Hughenden 附近的 Dunluce Station 发现它，材料来自 Toolebuc 组的钙质结核；2007 年论文将该产地归为晚阿尔布期。
text.en: Holotype QM F18896 preserves an incomplete snout with an adherent mandible. Phillip Gilmore found it in 1991 at Dunluce Station near Hughenden, within a calcareous nodule from the Toolebuc Formation, assigned to the late Albian in the 2007 paper.

title.en: Internal chambers do not supply a complete head
title.zh: 空腔结构不等于完整头部

text.zh: 2007 年作者观察到吻部内部的空腔、薄骨壁和支撑结构。吻端及背缘存在缺损，不能仅凭保存片段确定完整头形或骨冠。
text.en: The 2007 authors describe internal chambers, thin bone walls and supports in the snout. Missing anterior and dorsal portions constrain reconstruction of the complete head and any crest.

title.en: The preserved anterior teeth were reinterpreted
title.zh: 前部牙齿的解释后来改变

text.zh: 重描述论文的公开摘要将前部保存结构解释为一颗上颌牙的牙根及其替换牙，而不是左右对应的一对牙。因此不能继续把它们当作吻端最前一对牙。摘要还将鼻眶前孔内的骨块识别为右夹板骨。本批只使用摘要可支持的修订，未取得该论文完整正文。
text.en: The public reappraisal abstract identifies the anterior preserved structures as a maxillary tooth root and its replacement, rather than contralateral teeth. They therefore cannot establish the anteriormost tooth pair. It also identifies the bone in the nasoantorbital fenestra as the right splenial. These are abstract-supported revisions; the complete article was not obtained in this batch.

title.en: Relationships depend on material and matrices
title.zh: 关系假说随材料与矩阵变化

text.zh: 重描述摘要把 Mythunga 置于 Anhangueria，但该支系多数关系未解析。Thapunngaka 第二件标本研究将 Mythunga、Thapunngaka 与 Ferrodraco 置于名为 Mythungini 的未解析三分支。Haliskia 的 2024 年研究在一套分析中把 Mythunga 与 Thapunngaka 识别为不稳定单元并在分析后排除。因此，本页分别记录研究结果，不给 Mythunga 指定一个已获一致确认的最近姐妹群，也不把数据库存储位置当作这些争论的裁决。
text.en: The reappraisal abstract places Mythunga in Anhangueria with much of that clade unresolved. The second-specimen Thapunngaka study groups Mythunga, Thapunngaka and Ferrodraco in an unresolved trichotomy named Mythungini. One analysis in the 2024 Haliskia study identifies Mythunga and Thapunngaka as unstable and excludes them a posteriori. These results are recorded separately; no agreed nearest sister group is assigned, and database storage placement does not adjudicate the debate.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
Mythunga camara 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Mythunga。本页导读 1 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
Mythunga camara 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:148341。这份存档导读包含 1 条选取的出现记录，关联 1 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 1 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
Mythunga camara is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Mythunga. This guide uses 1 eligible species-level occurrence record from 1 collection and 1 reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:

This archived guide contains 1 selected occurrence rows, linked to 1 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 1 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 106.3–100.5 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
在这组 PBDB 记录中，最大记录 eag=106.3 Ma，见 occ:818232；最小记录 lag=100.5 Ma，见 occ:818232。这些数值是具名数据库记录的年代界，不代表两者之间存在连续记录，也不是该物种的起源、灭绝或个体寿命日期。每条记录各自的 eag 与 lag 值见上文。
text.en:
Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 106.3–100.5 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Across these selected PBDB rows, the largest recorded eag=106.3 Ma in occ:818232; the smallest recorded lag=100.5 Ma in occ:818232. These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat

title.zh: 形态证据与名称注册
title.en: Anatomical evidence and name registration

text.zh: I. avatar 是 Ikrandraco 的模式种。2014 年研究描述解剖并提出摄食假说；2020 年更正讨论电子出版物及 ZooBank 注册是否使该名称具备命名可用性。两份出版物分别讨论解剖与命名问题。
text.en: I. avatar is the type species of Ikrandraco. The 2014 study describes anatomy and proposes feeding hypotheses; a 2020 correction addresses whether the electronic work and ZooBank registration make the name available. The two publications address anatomy and nomenclature, respectively.

title.zh: 两件扁压标本与摄食假说
title.en: Two flattened specimens and feeding hypotheses

text.zh: I. avatar 导读 介绍两件标本及其未知的确切层位、下颌骨冠与牙齿，再讨论成熟度、亲缘关系、短暂贴近水面掠水取食的假说和喉囊假说。任何一件标本都不代表完整种群，骨骼解剖也不直接显示摄食行为。同期地层的其他翼龙提供比较背景，但没有据此测出生态位分隔。
text.en: The I. avatar guide describes two specimens, their unknown exact horizons, the mandibular crest and teeth, then considers maturity, phylogeny, a hypothesis of briefly skimming the water surface to feed, and a possible throat pouch. Neither specimen represents a complete population, and skeletal anatomy does not directly show feeding behavior. Other formation-level pterosaurs provide context, not a measured division of niches.

evidenceSummary: The reading path draws on selected text, tables and captions from studies published in 2008, 2021 and 2023. The eleven MIC-V55 histology sections are samples from one specimen. Claims about tooth attachment, replacement generations, diet and sexual maturity remain interpretations with stated limits; the 2021 flight models depend on their published assumptions and correction. The PBDB occurrence counts, ages and parent chain describe database entries and remain separate from the anatomical studies.

title.zh: 过滤牙齿、成长与飞行模型
title.en: Filtering teeth, growth and flight models

text.zh: 沿 P. guinazui 先读细丝牙齿、MIC-V55 的薄片与附着限制，再读 2008 年多骨生长研究，最后接到已有的 2021 年幼体飞行模型。下颌薄片、生长周期和跨标本飞行输入分别回答不同问题；它们没有直接串成同一只动物从孵化到死亡的记录。
text.en: Follow P. guinazui through filamentous teeth, MIC-V55 sections and attachment limits, then the 2008 multi-bone growth study and existing 2021 hatchling-flight models. Jaw sections, growth cycles and composite flight inputs address different questions; they do not form a record of one animal from hatching to death.

title.zh: 各项研究的材料范围
title.en: Material scope across the studies

text.zh: 本属入口仍只有固定名录中的 P. guinazui 种页。2023 年一件下颌的十一张薄片、2008 年多骨多大小样本，与下方两条数据库出现记录分别保留各自单位。牙齿的特殊组织结构不能推广为所有翼龙的共同特征；生长研究的性成熟推断也不替代直接繁殖证据。
text.en: This genus route retains one species entry, P. guinazui, in the fixed roster. Eleven sections of one jaw in 2023, multiple bones and sizes in 2008, and the two database occurrences below retain their separate units. Specialized dental histology does not describe all pterosaurs, and inferred sexual maturity does not replace direct reproductive evidence.

evidenceSummary: Published accounts differ on whether FSAC-KK 26 is a lower jaw or upper rostrum and on the Xericeps type horizon. Possible synonymy and finer clade placement remain unresolved. Body material without diagnostic association is not treated here as a confirmed Alanqa specimen.

title.zh: 按年份整理正模解释与标本归入
title.en: Type interpretations and specimen referrals by year

text.zh: 已发表的研究对 2010 年正模 FSAC-KK 26 有不同解释：原论文将其视为下颌，2020 年重分析则辨认为上颌吻部。2023 年研究对读成对骨突与单个中央突起，但这些孤立颌骨不能构成完整骨架。
text.en: Published accounts interpret the 2010 type FSAC-KK 26 differently: the original paper treated it as a lower jaw, while a 2020 reanalysis identified it as an upper rostrum. A 2023 study compares the paired projections and single median boss, but these isolated jaw elements do not make a complete skeleton.

title.zh: 一件正模标本的两种形态解释
title.en: Two anatomical interpretations of one type specimen

text.zh: FSAC-KK 26 仍是同一件正模，但 2010 与 2020 年的研究对其颌骨归属不同。这一差异会影响颌部复原和比例比较。归入的颌骨与未定种颈椎仍应分开看待，不能合并成一具关联骨架。
text.en: FSAC-KK 26 remains the same type specimen, but its jaw assignment changes between the 2010 and 2020 accounts. That difference affects jaw reconstruction and proportional comparisons. Referred jaws and undetermined cervical bones remain separate; they do not together form one associated skeleton.

title.zh: 更多颌部材料仍不等于完整生物学
title.en: Additional jaw material does not complete the biology

text.zh: 无齿、笔直颌缘和腭面突起是解剖观察，不能构成完整食谱或飞行模型。与 Xericeps 可能互为异名以及更细的支系位置仍未解决；未定种身体材料不视为已确认的 Alanqa 标本。
text.en: Toothlessness, straight jaw margins and a palatal boss are anatomical observations, not a complete diet or flight model. Possible synonymy with Xericeps and finer clade placements remain unresolved; indeterminate body material is not treated as confirmed Alanqa material.

evidenceSummary: The 2005 description and 2011 account add jaws and updated type-number links, while the referred postcranial bones remain distinct material. The papers’ Azhdarchidae placement is retained here without claiming to settle later revisions or reproduce their analyses.

title.zh: 正模下颌与后续上颌材料
title.en: Type mandible and later upper-jaw material

text.zh: 可先看 B. galaczi 中正模标本和馆藏号的对应关系。该物种页再介绍下颌横嵴、2011 年描述的上颌，以及至今未知的角质覆盖；分离骨骼的归属与翼展估计、食性假说分开讨论。2005 和 2011 年作者将 Bakonydraco 归入 Azhdarchidae，但这里不把这一分类说成对所有后续分析的复核。
text.en: Begin with the type specimen and collection-number links on B. galaczi. That species account follows the jaw ridge, the upper jaw described in 2011 and the still-unknown keratinous covering, then separates isolated-bone referrals from wingspan and feeding hypotheses. The 2005 and 2011 authors place Bakonydraco in Azhdarchidae; that placement is not a review of every later analysis.

title.zh: 山名、类型产地与搬运后的化石
title.en: The mountain name, type locality and transported fossils

text.zh: Bakonydraco 的属名由 Bakony 山地与拉丁语 draco 组成；种加词 galaczi 纪念 András Galácz。正模产地位于匈牙利西部 Iharkút 的 Csehbánya Formation。2005 年论文依据所引孢粉研究将其归入 Santonian，并描述河流洪泛平原沉积：流水把骨骼搬运并集中到化石富集处。PBDB 为一个采集记录给出 85.7–83.6 Ma 的年代范围。这些沉积线索说明埋藏背景，不代表动物全部的生活环境；数据库记录数也不是骨片或个体数。
text.en: Bakonydraco combines the Bakony Mountains with Latin draco; galaczi honours András Galácz. The type locality is the Csehbánya Formation at Iharkút in western Hungary. The 2005 paper assigns it to the Santonian using cited palynological work and describes river floodplain deposits where flowing water carried bones into fossil pockets. PBDB gives one collection an age bracket of 85.7–83.6 Ma. These depositional clues describe how remains were buried, not the animal’s entire habitat; the database count is not a count of fragments or individuals.

overview: The Keresdrakon holotype is associated with long jaws and air-filled (pneumatic) skeletal features, alongside two tissue samples. A 2019 study interprets Keresdrakon, Caiuajara and Vespersaurus as repeatedly occurring in the same bed. Compare the evidence for Keresdrakon vilsoni, Caiuajara dobruskii and Vespersaurus paranaensis. Shared burial does not make the three animals one species or one feeding group.

evidenceSummary: This comparison combines selected anatomical and growth evidence from Keresdrakon and other animals found in the same bed. Association has stratigraphic support, while the proposed feeding relationships remain hypotheses. Database counts and parent paths do not supply a complete fauna or a single settled tree.

title.zh: Keresdrakon 与共同骨床
title.en: Keresdrakon and the shared bonebed

text.zh: Keresdrakon 正模与长颌、气腔化骨骼相伴，另有两件组织样本。2019 年研究将 Keresdrakon、Caiuajara 和 Vespersaurus 的重复出现解释为同一骨床中的关联。可分别对读 Keresdrakon vilsoni、Caiuajara dobruskii 和 Vespersaurus paranaensis 的证据。共同埋藏不表示三者是同一物种或同一取食类群。
text.en: The Keresdrakon holotype is associated with long jaws and air-filled (pneumatic) skeletal features, alongside two tissue samples. A 2019 study interprets Keresdrakon, Caiuajara and Vespersaurus as repeatedly occurring in the same bed. Compare the evidence for Keresdrakon vilsoni, Caiuajara dobruskii and Vespersaurus paranaensis. Shared burial does not make the three animals one species or one feeding group.

title.zh: 成长与生态问题各自的材料边界
title.en: Material boundaries across growth and ecology questions

text.zh: 两种翼龙和恐龙没有共用一套完整成长样本，三条所选数据库出现行也不等于三个个体。Vespersaurus 的年龄估计取决于反推假设，不同后肢骨还存在分歧。对翼龙而言，关联证据和捕食假说回答的是不同问题。
text.en: The pterosaurs and dinosaur do not share a complete growth sample, and three selected database occurrence rows do not count three individuals. Vespersaurus age estimates depend on retrocalculation assumptions, with disagreement between hind-limb elements. For the pterosaurs, evidence of association and proposals about predation answer different questions.

title.zh: 关联骨架、成长与共存
title.en: Associated skeleton, growth and coexistence

text.zh: 种页从正模与孤立材料开始，再介绍长而无齿的颌部、气腔化骨骼、骨骼融合及两件组织学样本。一条数据库出现行可以链接到描述多件标本的研究；出现行数量不等于骨骼或动物个体数。
text.en: The species account begins with the holotype and isolated material, then describes long toothless jaws, pneumatic anatomy, skeletal fusion and two histological samples. One database occurrence row can link to research describing multiple specimens; the row count does not count bones or animals.

title.zh: 共同骨床不等于确定食物网
title.en: A shared bonebed does not establish a food web

text.zh: 2019 年研究支持同一骨床中反复关联的解释。食腐、捕食和独居仍是生态假说。与 Caiuajara 和 Vespersaurus 出现在同一地点，不能证明彼此是最近亲。
text.en: The 2019 study supports repeated association in one bed. Scavenging, predation and solitary behavior remain ecological hypotheses. A shared locality with Caiuajara and Vespersaurus does not establish that they were one another’s closest relatives.

title.en: Keresdrakon: PBDB classification route
title.zh: Keresdrakon：PBDB 分类路径

text.zh: PBDB 将 Keresdrakon 记录为一个属，并关联一个物种条目；原始描述指定 Keresdrakon vilsoni 为模式种。数据库父级用于整理记录，原始亲缘分析和后续分类方案各自有其适用范围。
text.en: PBDB records Keresdrakon as a genus with one species entry; the original description names Keresdrakon vilsoni as the type species. Database parents organize these records, while the original relationship analysis and later classification schemes have their own scopes.

text.en: The selected PBDB guide contains one occurrence row from one collection, with stratum name Goio-Erê. That row count is not an individual count. The linked species account separately presents the paper’s stratigraphic and age discussion.

title.zh: 义县组材料与九佛堂比较
title.en: Yixian material and Jiufotang comparisons

text.zh: 属级叙述将固定目录中的 E. lii 记录与 2023 年对 BPV 078 的重评及中国翼龙复合群进行比较。较早的义县组材料有助于讨论解剖与亲缘，但不能建立全属生态或完整成长序列。
text.en: The genus account compares the fixed E. lii record with the 2023 reassessment of BPV 078 and the Sinopterus complex. Earlier Yixian material informs the anatomy and relationship discussion, but it does not establish a genus-wide ecology or complete growth sequence.

title.zh: 头骨鉴定、比较与假说
title.en: Skull identification, comparisons and hypotheses

text.zh: Eopteranodon lii 一页讨论颌骨鉴定与比例；S. dongi 一页则分别处理成长与分类。两者的比较不能证明直接祖先关系、这些名称是否代表同一演化谱系的先后阶段，也不能证明共同食性；出现记录与解剖、分类论证属于不同证据。
text.en: The Eopteranodon lii account discusses jaw identification and proportions; the S. dongi account treats growth and taxonomy separately. Their comparison does not demonstrate direct ancestry, whether the names mark successive portions of one evolutionary lineage, or a shared diet. Occurrence records are separate from the anatomical and taxonomic arguments.

Upper- and lower-jaw referrals, maturity, relationships, probing and sensory ability remain separate hypotheses. The selected database record does not provide a complete jaw or species history.

title.zh: 两段颌骨与探食假说
title.en: Two jaws and the probing hypothesis

text.zh: 从 L. begaaensis 的正模与副模开始：先区分保存段和推算缺失段，再比较上颌中央嵴与下颌沟、截面和骨孔。随后阅读成熟推断、亲缘分析与探食假说；喙尖缺失使远距触觉仍待检验。两件归入同种的材料不等于一个关联个体，也没有提供完整动物复原。
text.en: Start with the holotype and paratype in L. begaaensis: distinguish preserved fragments from estimated missing tips, then compare the upper-jaw ridge, lower-jaw groove, cross sections and foramina. Continue to maturity, relationships and the probing hypothesis. Missing bill tips leave remote touch open to testing. Two fragments referred to one species are not one associated individual or a complete animal reconstruction.

title.zh: 产层、假说与数据库计数
title.en: Horizons, hypotheses and database counts

text.zh: 原始描述把材料来源记为摩洛哥 Aferdou N’Chaft 的上部 Ifezouane Formation，并保留 ?Albian—lower Cenomanian；2023 年介绍仍保留存疑的 Albian—Cenomanian 表述。下方数据库的 100.5–93.9 Ma 是固定采集行的宽范围，不把它当作对正模的精确测年。河流沉积标签与探食假说分别阅读；一条数据库出现记录不能替代文献中的两件类型标本或种群数量。
text.en: The original description records Aferdou N’Chaft, Morocco, upper Ifezouane Formation, retaining ?Albian–lower Cenomanian. The 2023 account likewise retains an uncertain Albian–Cenomanian formulation. The 100.5–93.9 Ma bracket below belongs to the fixed database collection row rather than precise dating of the type. Read the fluvial setting separately from the probing hypothesis; one database occurrence is neither the two type specimens described in the paper nor a population count.

Read preservation and specimen attribution before considering functional hypotheses. evidenceSummary: The associated skeleton described for T. navigans is one individual, and T. imperator has missing body scores in the cited matrices. The analyses leave branching within Tapejarinae unresolved, and the proposed sexual-dimorphism explanation is not established. The Table 4 wing-phalanx side discrepancy remains unresolved; exact locality coordinates for GP/2E 9266 are not available in the cited collection records.

title.zh: 把骨骼观察与亲缘分析分开读
title.en: Read skeletal observations and relationship analyses separately

text.zh: 先在 [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.zh.md) 阅读关联骨架，再看 64／65 单元矩阵、多棵最简树与严格共识。两套分析都留下 Tapejarinae 内部的未解分叉；[T. imperator](Tupandactylus_imperator/page.zh.md) 的缺失身体编码不能由 navigans 补齐，也不能用来证实性二型。CT 模型帮助观察隐埋骨骼，亲缘树则来自性状矩阵，两者的证据范围不同。
text.en: Start with the associated skeleton in [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.en.md), then read the 64/65-unit matrices, multiple shortest trees and strict consensus. Both analyses retain unresolved branching within Tapejarinae. Missing body scores for [T. imperator](Tupandactylus_imperator/page.en.md) cannot be supplied from navigans or used to confirm sexual dimorphism. CT models help reveal embedded bones; relationship trees derive from character matrices and answer a different question.

title.zh: 先读身体比例，再比较头部估计
title.en: Read body proportions before skull-based estimates

text.zh: [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.zh.md) 的关联骨架研究介绍肩带、骨盆和后肢，并讨论骨架尺寸与保存差异；可对读 [Europejara](../../../../Europejara/Europejara_olcadesorum/page.zh.md) 的头部比例估计。T. imperator 的具名出现记录和属级未定材料分别阅读，不把 navigans 的身体材料归给另一种。
text.en: The [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.en.md) account describes shoulder, pelvic and hindlimb anatomy alongside dimensions and preservation differences in its associated skeleton. Compare skull-based estimates in [Europejara](../../../../Europejara/Europejara_olcadesorum/page.en.md). Read T. imperator occurrences and genus-level material separately; observations from the navigans skeleton do not automatically apply to another species.

title.zh: 从一件关联骨架进入 Tupandactylus
title.en: Enter Tupandactylus through an associated skeleton

text.zh: 2021 年的一项 [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.zh.md) 关联骨架研究描述头冠、喙部角质鞘、颈背骨骼和翼指。先看保存状况与标本归属，再读功能假说；可对照 [T. imperator](Tupandactylus_imperator/page.zh.md) 的出现记录，但不能把前者的骨骼观察直接移给另一种。
text.en: A 2021 study of an associated [T. navigans](Tupandactylus_navigans/page.en.md) skeleton describes its crest, beak sheath, neck and back anatomy, and wing finger. Read preservation and specimen attribution before considering functional hypotheses. Compare the [T. imperator](Tupandactylus_imperator/page.en.md) occurrence guide without extending those skeletal observations to that species.

title.zh: 两种入口与属级材料分别阅读
title.en: Read the two species and genus-level material separately

text.zh: 论文提出但未解决两种的性二型解释；MN 6588-V 也只归属到 Tupandactylus sp.。两种的记录与属级材料应分开阅读：关联骨架、较早的出现记录和未定种材料不合并成一个标本计数。所引采集记录没有 GP/2E 9266 的精确地点坐标。
text.en: The paper raises, but does not resolve, sexual dimorphism as an explanation for the two species; MN 6588-V is assigned only to Tupandactylus sp. Keep species records and genus-level material separate: an associated skeleton, older occurrences and indeterminate material do not form a single specimen count. The cited collection records do not provide exact coordinates for GP/2E 9266.

title.en: Organize fossil records by source classification
title.zh: 按来源分类组织化石记录

text.zh: 古生物学数据库（PBDB）在 Tupandactylus 属下列出两个物种。关联骨架研究与出现记录属于不同证据，各自保留来源；数据库父级路径用于整理记录，不裁决亲缘关系。
text.en: The Paleobiology Database (PBDB) lists two species beneath Tupandactylus. The associated-skeleton study and occurrence records provide different kinds of evidence, each with its own source attribution; the database path organizes records but does not settle relationships.

title.en: Compare collections, strata and age brackets
title.zh: 从采集地、地层和年代对读

text.zh: 出现导读涵盖 Tupandactylus navigans 与 Tupandactylus imperator。所选 PBDB 样本有 3 条出现记录、涉及 2 个采集记录，记录的地层包括 Crato 组。各条目保留自己的年代范围和鉴定信息；这些数量不代表古代种群规模。
text.en: The occurrence guide covers Tupandactylus navigans and Tupandactylus imperator. The selected PBDB sample contains 3 occurrences from 2 collections, including records in the Crato Formation. Each entry keeps its own age bracket and identification; these counts do not measure a prehistoric population.

evidenceSummary: This route brings two catalogue entries together with a 2023 taxonomic revision. The paper proposes that S. gui is a synonym of S. dongi and assigns another morphotype to Huaxiadraco corollatus; these are published interpretations. Juvenile crest size does not establish sex, morphological clustering does not show genealogy, and the very young Nemicolopterus remains unassigned. The guide does not assemble every specimen account, the original 2003 descriptions, all anatomical variation or a complete ecological history. The occurrence totals and broad age bounds do not measure populations or exact origin and extinction times; published matrices and specimens are not independently remeasured here.

title.zh: 两个目录入口与一项修订
title.en: Two catalogue entries and one revision

text.zh: 目录列有 S. dongi 与 S. gui 两项。2023 年修订把 S. gui 视为 S. dongi 的异名，并将另一形态群命名为 Huaxiadraco corollatus。因此，数据库条目数与修订中的分类解释不是同一件事；两行记录本身不能决定认可多少个生物种。
text.en: The catalogue contains entries for S. dongi and S. gui. A 2023 revision treats S. gui as a synonym of S. dongi and names the other morphotype Huaxiadraco corollatus. The database entries and the revision’s interpretation therefore count different things; two catalogue rows do not by themselves settle how many biological species are recognized.

title.zh: 骨骼成长、名称与飞行研究对象
title.en: Skeletal growth, names and flight subjects

text.zh: S. dongi 页面介绍未成熟正模、性状组合和研究方法；S. gui 页面讨论保存情况与异名。幼体冠饰较小不能判定性别，形态聚类也不是亲缘树。Nemicolopterus 的极幼体目前还不能有把握地归入任一物种。
text.en: The S. dongi account follows the immature holotype, its character combination and the study methods; S. gui covers preservation and the proposed synonymy. A small crest in a juvenile does not identify sex, and a cluster of similar measurements is not a family tree. The very young Nemicolopterus specimen cannot yet be assigned confidently to either species.

text.en: The PBDB parent path lists Sinopterus as a genus with two catalogue entries. The 2023 paper separately interprets those names, including the proposed synonymy and Huaxiadraco assignment.

text.en: The two listed names, Sinopterus dongi and Sinopterus gui, connect to three selected occurrence rows from two collections; Jiufotang is the recorded stratum example. Each row keeps its own collection, age bracket and reference link. The total counts database records, not animals or population size.

The selected occurrence rows point to member records, not a taxon-wide account of anatomy or ecology.

evidenceSummary: Studies of the bonebed, later histology, and the skull address different samples and questions. Growth and behavior claims remain interpretations rather than direct observations. The comparative route also draws on a 2019 shared-bonebed study and a 2020 Vespersaurus histology study; their specimens and models apply to the taxa each examined, and do not complete the site's fauna or all developmental evidence.

title.zh: Caiuajara 与共同骨床
title.en: Caiuajara and the shared bonebed

text.zh: Caiuajara dobruskii 来自包含多只个体材料的骨床，相关研究据此讨论成长、冠饰和身体比例。本阅读路径也链接到 Keresdrakon 与 Vespersaurus；它们是同一区域记录中分别研究的类群。2019 年研究报道了反复出现的同层关联，但这不表示三者属于同一生态或解剖类群。
text.en: Caiuajara dobruskii is known from a bonebed with multiple individuals and material used to discuss growth, crests, and body proportions. The reading route also points to Keresdrakon and Vespersaurus, two separately studied taxa from the same regional record. A 2019 study reports repeated same-bed association; that does not make the three animals one ecological or anatomical group.

title.zh: 成长与生态问题各自的材料边界
title.en: Material boundaries across growth and ecology questions

text.zh: 比较时分开三个问题：骨骼代表一只还是多只个体；哪些组织或形态支持成长估计；哪些行为属于化石推断？Caiuajara 与 Keresdrakon 没有一套共同且完整的成长样本。Vespersaurus 年龄估计取决于反推前提，且不同后肢骨给出的结果有分歧。共同保存本身不能证明捕食关系。
text.en: Keep three questions separate: do the bones represent one individual or several; which tissues or shapes support growth estimates; and which behaviors are inferred from the fossils? Caiuajara and Keresdrakon do not share a complete growth sample. Vespersaurus age estimates depend on retrocalculation assumptions and differ between hind-limb elements. Shared preservation alone does not demonstrate predation.

title.zh: 骨床样本、成长与头骨变异
title.en: Bonebed sample, growth and cranial variation

text.zh: 先读正模与 Caiuajara 骨床样本的范围，再看成长过程中报道的冠饰和身体骨骼变化，最后对照 2022 年头骨研究。骨床关联、成长和幼体飞行假说依据不同证据。
text.en: Begin with the holotype and the limits of the Caiuajara bonebed sample. Then follow reported crest and postcranial changes through growth before comparing the 2022 cranial study. Bonebed association, growth, and proposed juvenile flight behavior rely on different evidence.

title.zh: 数据库行与多标本样本
title.en: Database rows and multi-specimen samples

text.zh: 固定 PBDB 路径为 Caiuajara 保留一个工作名录物种入口和一条所选出现记录。论文中的骨床包含多个标本，但不会因此变成多条数据库出现记录；研究估算的最少个体数又是另一种计数。
text.en: The fixed PBDB route has one working-roster species entry and one selected occurrence row for Caiuajara. The paper's bonebed includes multiple specimens, but those do not become separate database occurrences; its minimum-individual estimate is a different count again.
