title.zh: 同一正模的三种颌骨解释
title.en: One holotype, three interpretations of its jaw

text.zh: 三篇研究讨论的都是同一件正模 FSAC-KK 26。2010 年描述将它视作下颌；2020 年改释为上颌吻部；Smith 等人在 2023 年又暂定采用下颌解释。他们把正模后端解释为一对前方未相接的突起，并与具有单个中央突起的 FSAC-KK 5204、5205 对照，后两件被视作上颌。横截面、骨孔和两侧夹角都参与这一比较。这是同一标本的不同解读，不是三件正模。
text.en: FSAC-KK 26 is the same type specimen in all three accounts. The 2010 description reads it as a lower jaw; a 2020 study reinterprets it as an upper-jaw rostrum; Smith and colleagues tentatively return to a lower-jaw reading in 2023. They distinguish its paired rear projections, which do not meet at the front, from the single central boss on FSAC-KK 5204 and 5205, which they identify as upper jaws. Cross-sections, foramina and the angle of the sides all contribute to the comparison. These are changing interpretations of one specimen, not three type fossils.

title.zh: 颌部碎片与孤立身体骨骼的归属不同
title.en: Jaw fragments and isolated body bones have different certainty

text.zh: 2023 年综述扩展了归入 Alanqa 的颌骨比较，也重看早期归属。作者将 FSAC-KK 28 列为 Azhdarchoidea 未定的颌部形态型 A。三段曾归入 Alanqa 的颈椎——CMN 50801、LINHM 014 和 FSAC-KK 5077——在该讨论中仍只是未定种的 Azhdarchidae；肱骨 CMN 50814 则为未定种的 Azhdarchoidea。没有关联骨骼，孤立的身体骨骼不能可靠归到以颌骨命名的属或种。UOP-PAL KK 0006 与 FSAC-KK 5213 是同一件私人收藏化石的两种三维打印模型，不是两只动物。
text.en: The 2023 review expands the comparison of jaws attributed to Alanqa and revisits earlier referrals. It calls FSAC-KK 28 an indeterminate Azhdarchoidea jaw of morphotype A. Three neck vertebrae once referred to Alanqa—CMN 50801, LINHM 014 and FSAC-KK 5077—remain indeterminate azhdarchids in that discussion; humerus CMN 50814 is indeterminate Azhdarchoidea. Without bones found in association, these body fragments cannot be securely attached to a genus or species named from jaws. UOP-PAL KK 0006 and FSAC-KK 5213 are two 3D printed models of one privately held fossil, not two animals.

title.zh: 分开的骨突改变颌部比较
title.en: A split ridge changes how jaws are compared

text.zh: 2023 年作者认为，正模后端的两条骨突向前延伸时彼此分开；这与把它们当作一条 V 形嵴的比较不同。该研究仍将 Alanqa 放在 Azhdarchidae，并回顾早期系统发育分析如何把正模解释为上颌或下颌。2020 和 2023 年对某项较早分析采用何种标本身份的叙述不一致；仅凭论文转述，无法确定其矩阵中实际使用的性状编码。颌部形态会影响分类比较，但单独不能解决亲缘关系。
text.en: The 2023 authors argue that the type’s two rear projections remain separate toward the front. That challenges comparisons which treated them as one V-shaped ridge. The study keeps Alanqa in Azhdarchidae, while reviewing how earlier phylogenetic analyses interpreted the type as either an upper or lower jaw. The 2020 and 2023 accounts differ in their description of the specimen identity used in one earlier analysis, so the published summaries do not by themselves settle how its matrix coded the character. The jaw comparison informs classification, but does not settle the family tree.

title.zh: 一件正模，先后被读作下颌和吻部
title.en: The same type was read as a jaw and a rostrum

text.zh: Alanqa saharica 正模 FSAC-KK 26 收藏于摩洛哥卡萨布兰卡 Université Hassan II 的 Faculté des Sciences Ain Chock。2010 年命名论文把它描述为近完整的下颌联合；2020 年 Kem Kem 研究则将同一化石解释为上颌吻部，并记载它于 2008 年在 Aferdou N’Chaft 原位采集。论文改变了解剖解释，标本本身没有改变。
text.en: The holotype, FSAC-KK 26, is housed at the Faculté des Sciences Ain Chock, Université Hassan II, in Casablanca, Morocco. The 2010 naming paper describes it as an almost complete lower-jaw symphysis; the 2020 Kem Kem study reads the same fossil as a rostrum and reports that it was collected in place at Aferdou N’Chaft in 2008. The jaw identity changed between papers; the specimen did not.

title.zh: 三块碎片仍缺失部分颌骨
title.en: Three fragments preserve only part of the jaw

text.zh: 2010 年描述的正模由三块相接的橙褐色碎片组成，保存长度合计 344 毫米。前端缺失，中间碎片的腹面也有一部分损坏。作者延长保存边缘并比较近缘类群后，估计缺失的前端最多可能约 80 毫米；这只是复原长度，不是化石保存长度。碎片保留立体形态和薄骨壁，但不是完整头骨或头身相连的骨架。
text.en: The 2010 description records three adjoining orange-brown fragments with 344 mm of preserved length. The front tip is missing, as is part of the underside of the middle fragment. Extending the margins and comparing related jaws led the authors to estimate that as much as 80 mm of the tip may be absent; this is a reconstruction, not measured fossil. The fragments retain three-dimensional shape and thin bone walls, but they are not a complete skull or an associated skeleton.

title.zh: 无齿颌缘与有争议的中央突起
title.en: Toothless margins and a disputed central boss

text.zh: 2010 年作者依据归入本种的五件颌部材料均无齿槽，将 Alanqa 描述为无齿，并指出颌缘笔直、形体细长，横截面由近三角形转为 Y 形。正模后端的突起起初被解释为下颌联合上的 V 形中线结构。2020 年改读为上颌吻部后，它成为腭面的突起，与下颌咬合面相对应。骨孔和沟槽可提示喙鞘可能的血管与神经供应，却没有保存完整喙鞘，也不能确定食谱。
text.en: The 2010 authors called Alanqa toothless because five jaws assigned to it lack tooth sockets. They described straight jaw edges, a slender outline and a cross-section that changes from nearly triangular to Y-shaped. They first interpreted the type’s rear prominence as part of a V-shaped lower-jaw structure. Under the 2020 upper-jaw interpretation, it becomes a boss on the palate, compared with surfaces that met it on the lower jaw. Foramina and grooves suggest how blood vessels and nerves may have reached a beak sheath, but they do not preserve the whole sheath or reveal the animal’s diet.

title.zh: 其他归入碎片来自不同地点
title.en: Other referred fragments come from separate places

text.zh: 2010 年论文还把 BSP 1996 I 36、FSAC-KK 31、BSP 1993 IX 338 和 FSAC-KK 27 归入本种。FSAC-KK 31 出自 Boumerade，FSAC-KK 27 出自 Aferdou N’Chaft；两件 BSP 标本的来源仅记作“可能在 Taouz 附近”。这些归属依据形态和大小比较。插图把正模和另一件吻部材料拼成颌部复原图，但这不表示材料来自同一个体。正模后来被改读，也会影响如何理解旧的上下颌配对。
text.en: The 2010 paper also refers BSP 1996 I 36, FSAC-KK 31, BSP 1993 IX 338 and FSAC-KK 27 to the species. FSAC-KK 31 came from Boumerade and FSAC-KK 27 from Aferdou N’Chaft; the BSP fossils have only the tentative provenance “possibly near Taouz.” The referrals rely on comparisons of shape and size. In one figure, the type is paired with a separate rostrum to reconstruct a jaw, not because the pieces are known to come from one animal. Their fit also depends on which way the type is interpreted.

title.zh: 一段颈椎尚未归到具体种
title.en: A neck vertebra remains unassigned to species

text.zh: FSAC-KK 34 是一段颈椎后端，2010 年系统描述将它列为未定种的 Azhdarchidae，并没有正式归入 Alanqa saharica。两侧突起之间的保存宽度为 83 毫米。与 Quetzalcoatlus 比较使作者推测其对应大型翼展，但这不是由 Alanqa 完整翼骨量出的结果。2020 年研究还指出 Kem Kem 有另一个已命名类群 Xericeps，因此当地的零散颈椎不能自动归入 Alanqa。
text.en: FSAC-KK 34 is a rear neck-vertebra fragment that the 2010 account lists as an indeterminate azhdarchid, not as Alanqa saharica. It is 83 mm wide across its projections. Comparing it with Quetzalcoatlus led the authors to suggest a large wingspan, but no complete Alanqa wings are present to measure. The 2020 study also names another Kem Kem pterosaur, Xericeps, so a loose neck bone from the region cannot automatically be assigned to Alanqa.

title.zh: 体型估算借用了其他翼龙的比例
title.en: Size estimates borrow proportions from other pterosaurs

text.zh: 2010 年作者以 Quetzalcoatlus 下颌联合的比例推算正模下颌长约 0.675 米。这个估算依赖正模为下颌的解释，也借用了另一属的比例。2010 年摘要与 2020 年讨论都给正模个体约 3–4 米的翼展估计，同样不是完整翼骨的直接测量。常见的约 6 米说法来自一段更大的颈椎材料，但它没有正式归到本种，不能作为 Alanqa 已确认的最大翼展。改把正模读作上颌吻部，并不会自动重算颌长或翼展。
text.en: The 2010 authors estimated a lower-jaw length of about 0.675 m by scaling from Quetzalcoatlus. That estimate depends on reading the type as a lower jaw and borrowing another animal’s proportions. The 2010 abstract and 2020 discussion give an estimated 3–4 m wingspan for the type individual, also by comparison rather than direct measurement of complete wings. A frequently repeated estimate of about 6 m concerns larger neck bones not formally assigned to this species, so it is not a confirmed maximum for Alanqa. Reading the type as an upper jaw does not itself recalculate either estimate.

title.zh: 翼龙科级位置与可能异名仍有争议
title.en: Azhdarchid placement and possible synonymy remain debated

text.zh: 2020 年研究回顾了一项把 Alanqa 放入 thalassodromid 的分析，并指出该分析假定正模是下颌联合；该研究自己的比较支持 Azhdarchidae。作者也提出 Alanqa 或许与 Xericeps 近缘，甚至可能是其异名，但认为必须有更完整的化石才能检验。这些是论文提出的解释和假说，尚未解决。
text.en: The 2020 study reviews an earlier analysis that placed Alanqa among thalassodromids while treating the type as a lower-jaw symphysis. Its own comparisons support Azhdarchidae. The same study raises a possible relationship—or even synonymy—with Xericeps, but says more complete fossils are needed to test it. These remain interpretations and hypotheses attributed to the cited studies, not a settled classification.

title.zh: 从正模解剖读到其他材料
title.en: Follow the type from anatomy to locality

text.zh: 正模的两种解剖读法为其他颌部碎片的比较提供背景。颈椎属于另一批材料，其中一些未能确定到具体种。再看地点和年代记录时，应将每条采集信息与这些骨骼的解剖解释分开；孤立骨骼本身不能直接显示飞行或食性。
text.en: The type’s changing jaw interpretation helps make sense of the other jaw fragments. The neck material is a separate set of remains and includes pieces not assigned to species. The locality and age records then show where the database places these fossils. Neither isolated jaws nor an unattached neck bone directly records flight or feeding.

title.en: Three selected records, three collections
title.zh: 三条所选记录，三个采集地

text.zh:
固定 Paleobiology Database（PBDB）翼龙名录接受 Alanqa saharica，数据库父级为 Alanqa。本页使用三条可用种级出现记录，关联三个采集地和一个数据库引文编号。出现、采集和引文计数不同，不是化石或动物个体数。

text.en:
The fixed Paleobiology Database (PBDB) pterosaur roster accepts Alanqa saharica beneath the database parent Alanqa. This guide draws on three eligible species-level occurrences from three collections, linked to one database reference identifier. Occurrences, collections and citations are different units; they do not count fossils or individual animals.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Alanqa saharica is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:167135. This archived guide contains 3 selected occurrence rows, linked to 3 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 1 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Three localities in Drâa-Tafilalet
title.zh: Drâa-Tafilalet 的三个具名地点

text.zh:
三条采集记录分别是 Hamada du Guir pterosaurs (BSPG)、Boumerade, Lake Maider 和 Aferdou N'Chaft，地点均记在摩洛哥 Drâa-Tafilalet，地区代码 MA。三条记录的数据库年代范围都是 100.5–93.9 Ma，较老端归入 Early Cenomanian。数据库地点名称帮助识别所选记录，但不构成本种的完整分布图。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
存档导读包含 3 条出现记录，以下列出全部记录。每个 occ: 编号标识一条出现记录；col: 标识其关联的采集记录。

- 出现记录 occ:819572；PBDB 采集记录 col:90076。 地点字段 cnm=Hamada du Guir pterosaurs (BSPG)；地点分区字段 cc2=MA，stp=Drâa-Tafilalet，cny=Errachidia。 记录年代界：eag 100.5 Ma; lag 93.9 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Early Cenomanian。 记录署名 Ibrahim et al. 2010；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32662。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
See revised palaeontology and geology of the Kem Kem beds in Ibrahim et al. 2020

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Based on the nearby town Taouz. Specimens were collected privately so locality information is unavailable. Ibrahim et al. (2010) suggest that this material might be collected from their Aferdou N'Chaft locality.

- 出现记录 occ:867574；PBDB 采集记录 col:96222。 地点字段 cnm=Boumerade, Lake Maider；地点分区字段 cc2=MA，stp=Drâa-Tafilalet，cny=Errachidia。 记录年代界：eag 100.5 Ma; lag 93.9 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Early Cenomanian。 记录署名 Ibrahim et al. 2010；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32662。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Fossils were collected from an "approximately 2m thick horizon"; age of the Kem Kem is poorly constrained, but a Cenomanian age is supported by vertebrate biostratigraphy
See revised palaeontology and geology of the Kem Kem beds in Ibrahim et al. 2020

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Boumerade locality is near Lake Maider; longitude coordinates are given in the text as east, but this appears to be an error

- 出现记录 occ:867575；PBDB 采集记录 col:96223。 地点字段 cnm=Aferdou N'Chaft；地点分区字段 cc2=MA，stp=Drâa-Tafilalet，cny=Errachidia。 记录年代界：eag 100.5 Ma; lag 93.9 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Early Cenomanian。 记录署名 Ibrahim et al. 2010；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32662。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Fossils were collected from an "approximately 2m thick horizon"; age of the Kem Kem is poorly constrained, but a Cenomanian age is supported by vertebrate biostratigraphy
See revised palaeontology and geology of the Kem Kem beds in Ibrahim et al. 2020

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
near the village of Begaa and 10 km north-east of Taouz; longitude coordinates are given in the text as east, but this appears to be an error
text.en:
The three collections are Hamada du Guir pterosaurs (BSPG), Boumerade, Lake Maider and Aferdou N'Chaft, all recorded in Drâa-Tafilalet, Morocco (region code MA). Each has the database age bracket 100.5–93.9 Ma and an Early Cenomanian older bound. Their database names and locations identify selected records, not the species’ complete range.

The account summarizes selected sections from studies published in 2010, 2020 and 2023, not a complete monograph or inspection of every specimen, image, supplement or later analysis. Those sources disagree about whether the type is an upper or lower jaw, how one earlier phylogenetic analysis treated it, and the reported horizon of the Xericeps type. The 2023 jaw interpretation is tentative, and the possible relationship or synonymy with Xericeps remains unresolved. Database records organize selected occurrences but do not settle these anatomical or taxonomic questions.

Together they do not give a complete range, exact origin or extinction, species-wide habitat, population size or the preservation state of every specimen. This is a guide to selected records, not a full account of the species biology.

evidenceSummary:
The 2005 description and 2011 new-material paper document the jaws, specimen numbers and isolated postcranial bones summarized here. They do not join those bones into one skeleton. The wingspans come from comparisons, and the proposed foods remain functional hypotheses; no direct feeding evidence or complete keratinous beak is preserved. title.zh: 正模下颌与后来更新的馆藏号
title.en: The type mandible and its updated collection number

text.zh: 2005 年命名 Bakonydraco galaczi 时，正模 MTM Gyn/3 是近完整、无齿的下颌；副模 MTM Gyn/4 包含 21 段齿骨联合碎片，收藏于布达佩斯的匈牙利自然历史博物馆。2011 年把正模号对应为 MTM 2007.110.1、副模号对应为 MTM 2007.111.1，并另外归入 22 段下颌联合碎片 MTM V 2010.74.1–22。这些更新号不是额外发现的正模，碎片数也不是已确定的个体数。
text.en: When Bakonydraco galaczi was named in 2005, holotype MTM Gyn/3 was a nearly complete toothless mandible; paratype MTM Gyn/4 comprised 21 dentary symphyseal fragments, held at the Hungarian Natural History Museum, Budapest. The 2011 paper maps the holotype to MTM 2007.110.1 and the paratype to MTM 2007.111.1, and refers another 22 symphyseal fragments, MTM V 2010.74.1–22. Updated numbers do not represent an additional holotype, and fragment counts are not established individual counts.

title.zh: 约 29 厘米的下颌保留哪些形状
title.en: What the approximately 29 cm mandible preserves

text.zh: 原始描述记录下颌长约 29 厘米，前部联合约占下颌支长度的一半。俯视轮廓呈三角形，联合前部尖而侧向压扁；其背面向后上方弯起，在后方结束于一条横嵴，并带两列裂隙状骨孔。作者还描述未分成内外两窝的关节窝。下颌支有轻度背腹压缩，侧壁破碎、骨缝不可辨；骨形描述不能消除这些保存限制。
text.en: The original description records a mandible about 29 cm long, with the symphysis extending approximately half the ramus length. Its dorsal outline is triangular, and the anterior symphysis is pointed and laterally compressed. The dorsal surface curves posterodorsally to a transverse ridge and bears two rows of slit-like foramina. The authors also describe a glenoid fossa not divided into medial and lateral cotyles. Slight dorsoventral compression has crushed ramus walls and obscured sutures; anatomical descriptions retain these preservation limits.

title.zh: 2011 年补入的上颌吻部
title.en: The upper-jaw rostrum added in 2011

text.zh: 2011 年归入本种的 MTM V 2010.80.1 是保存长 114 毫米的无齿前上颌片段。作者根据较钝的侧缘、背侧骨脊而非头冠、尖端侧面夹角、单一中央通道和骨孔分布，将它与下颌联合区分。保存段没有矢状冠迹象，后部受压，鼻眶前孔前缘位置不清。114 毫米是片段长度；没有完整头骨或同一个体上下颌连接的证据。
text.en: The 2011 paper refers MTM V 2010.80.1, a toothless premaxillary fragment preserving 114 mm, to this species. The authors distinguish it from mandibular symphyses using blunter lateral edges, a dorsal keel rather than a crest, tip angle, a single median canal and foraminal distribution. The preserved portion shows no sagittal crest; posterior crushing leaves the anterior margin of the nasoantorbital fenestra uncertain. The 114 mm measurement is a fragment length, without a complete skull or evidence joining both jaws in one individual.

title.zh: 骨质上下颌之间的空隙与未知的角质喙鞘
title.en: Bony jaw gaps and the unknown keratinous covering

text.zh: 2011 年将上颌片段与下颌对比复原时，发现较直的上颌咬合面与带弯曲和横嵴的下颌前部不能严密相合。作者认为表面营养孔间接支持角质喙鞘，但喙鞘的厚度、切缘结构、前伸长度和准确范围未知。因此，骨质表面间的不规则接触不能直接给出活体闭嘴形状、咬合效率或某一种取食动作；这种复原仍依赖分离材料的比较。
text.en: Matching the upper-jaw fragment to the mandible in the 2011 reconstruction reveals that the straighter upper occlusal surface does not closely fit the curved, transversely ridged anterior mandible. The authors interpret nutritive foramina as indirect support for a keratinous rhamphotheca, but its thickness, cutting edges, anterior extension and exact extent remain unknown. Irregular contact between bony surfaces therefore establishes neither the living closed-beak outline nor biting efficiency or one feeding action. This reconstruction relies on comparison of isolated material.

title.zh: 同地颈椎和翼骨保留未定种归属
title.en: Local neck and wing bones retain indeterminate species referrals

text.zh: 2005 年把分离颈椎与若干肢骨放在 Azhdarchidae indet. 下，并明确没有直接证据将它们归入 B. galaczi。作者认为同地可能属于本种，但没有关联骨架。2011 年新增材料继续区分本种颌部、Azhdarchidae indet. 和 Pterodactyloidea indet.；多数新增颅后骨的科级归属也依靠比较，而非独有诊断。原先暂作第二或第三翼指骨的 MTM Gyn/453，在 2011 年改释为尺骨远端，号为 MTM V 2010.75.1。同地来源与相近尺寸不足以把这些骨拼成一只完整动物。
text.en: The 2005 paper places isolated cervicals and several limb elements under Azhdarchidae indet., explicitly finding no direct evidence that they belong to B. galaczi. The authors consider a local referral possible, without an associated skeleton. The 2011 material continues to separate species-level jaws, Azhdarchidae indet. and Pterodactyloidea indet.; most new postcranial family referrals likewise rely on comparison rather than unique diagnostic features. MTM Gyn/453, tentatively a second or third wing phalanx in 2005, is reinterpreted in 2011 as a distal ulna, MTM V 2010.75.1. Shared locality and similar size do not assemble these bones into one complete animal.

title.zh: 3.5–4 米翼展来自颌长比较
title.en: The 3.5–4 m wingspan comes from jaw-length comparison

text.zh: 2005 年作者把下颌长度与 Quetzalcoatlus、Zhejiangopterus 作比较，估计本种翼展约 3.5–4 米。另据同地未定种颈椎得到约 3–3.5 米的估计。两者接近是作者讨论骨骼可能同种的线索，不是同一骨架实测翼展，也不能证明颈椎属于本种。本页保留方法与材料区分，不把估计变成固定成年尺寸。
text.en: The 2005 authors compare mandibular length with Quetzalcoatlus and Zhejiangopterus to estimate a wingspan of about 3.5–4 m. Separately, they estimate about 3–3.5 m from local cervicals of indeterminate species. Similar estimates inform their discussion of a possible common taxon; they are neither a measured wingspan from one skeleton nor proof of cervical referral. Methods and material remain separate, without turning an estimate into a fixed adult size.

title.zh: 鱼、果实与小动物都是讨论中的可能食物
title.en: Fish, fruit and small animals remain possible foods

text.zh: 2005 年根据尖而无齿的下颌，讨论抓取小鱼、食果与多样食物的可能性，并反对把它解释为掠水取食。2011 年加入上颌后强调咬合和喙鞘的不确定性，讨论类似鹳或地犀鸟的泛食，以及食果等不同策略。这些是形态比较与功能假说，没有本种胃内容物或直接取食证据；不能据此确认鱼食、食果或具体菜单。原论文中排除掠水取食的判断也保留为当时作者的解释。
text.en: The 2005 paper uses the pointed toothless mandible to discuss small-fish capture, frugivory and varied foods, while arguing against skim feeding. With an upper jaw added, the 2011 paper emphasizes uncertain occlusion and keratinous covering and discusses alternatives including stork-like or ground-hornbill-like generalism and frugivory. These are morphological comparisons and functional hypotheses, without stomach contents or direct feeding evidence for this species. They establish neither piscivory, frugivory nor a specific menu. The original rejection of skimming likewise remains the authors’ dated interpretation.

2005 年描述和 2011 年新增材料论文记录了本页讨论的上下颌、标本号和分离颅后骨，但没有把这些骨骼连接成一具骨架。翼展来自比较估计，可能食物仍是功能假说；没有直接取食证据，也没有保存完整角质喙鞘。所选数据库记录代表一个有年代和地点的样本，不是完整分布，也不是对单个个体的直接定年。后续分类研究、喙鞘确切外形和动物的许多生活细节仍未确定。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页导读的是 2026-10-02 快照中的 1 条 PBDB 选取出现记录，不是物种专论。地点和年代区间描述的是数据库记录，不能据此推出完整地理分布、连续存在的时间范围、生态、行为或种群大小。采集记录编号、出现记录编号、标本说明及来源明确给出的丰度单位彼此区分。地点坐标字段与古坐标／模型字段仍按不同来源字段保留。所列引文署名不代表已完成全文审读。
readerLimitations.en:
The 2005 description and 2011 new-material paper document the jaws, specimen numbers and isolated postcranial bones summarized here. They do not join those bones into one skeleton. The wingspans come from comparisons, and the proposed foods remain functional hypotheses; no direct feeding evidence or complete keratinous beak is preserved. The selected database record gives a dated locality sample, not a complete range or a direct age for an individual. Later taxonomic work, the exact beak outline and much of the animal's biology remain unresolved.

evidenceSummary:
This account follows the 2012 description and a dated PBDB record for one collection. The incomplete skull and jaws do not preserve a full wing or upper crest, so wingspan and crest shape are reconstructions. Toothlessness and jaw form motivate dietary hypotheses but do not directly establish a menu or seed-dispersal behavior; the earliest known locality also does not determine the species' geographic origin.

title.zh: 欧洲记录从一件不完整头骨开始
title.en: The European record begins with an incomplete skull

text.zh: 2012 年原始描述以西班牙 Las Hoyas 的 MCCM-LH 9413 建立 Europejara olcadesorum，报告当时欧洲首个古神翼龙科成员。它把这个类群的具名记录扩展到伊比利亚，不证明所有早白垩世欧洲地点都有本种。“最早已知”无齿翼龙和欧亚起源论述按该研究当时取样阅读，未改称已核对全部后续发现的现行结论。
text.en: The 2012 description names Europejara olcadesorum from MCCM-LH 9413 at Las Hoyas, Spain, reporting the first European tapejarid then known. It extends the named record to Iberia without establishing presence at every Early Cretaceous European site. Claims of the oldest known toothless pterosaur and Eurasian origin retain the study’s dated sampling context, without a comprehensive check of later discoveries.

title.zh: 主板与对板保存头部，没有完整身体
title.en: Part and counterpart preserve cranial material rather than a whole body

text.zh: 正模包含上下颌和后眶头骨元素，保存于主板、对板；上颌及头骨不完整、压碎且背腹向压扁，下颌侧向保存。后眶骨移位，一些小骨在酸处理时移出基质。没有保存皮肤或角质喙，遗址集合的软组织标签不能移植给这件正模。
text.en: The holotype comprises jaws and postorbital skull elements on part and counterpart slabs. The upper jaw and skull are incomplete, crushed and dorsoventrally flattened, while the mandible lies in lateral view. Postorbital bones are displaced and some small elements were removed during acid preparation. No skin or keratinous beak is preserved; a site-level soft-tissue label does not apply automatically to this specimen.

title.zh: 向后弯曲的下颌冠参与鉴别
title.en: A backward-curving mandibular crest informs diagnosis

text.zh: 作者鉴别的组合包括向后弯曲、背腹方向较深的齿骨骨冠，冠高与下颌支高比约四，以及内侧背缘的隆起和浅凹。骨冠估高约 90 毫米、下颌支高 22 毫米，都是这件材料的描述或估计。大冠的功能没有确定，不用它单独指认性别、求偶方式或全种成长阶段。
text.en: Diagnosis combines a backward-curving, dorsoventrally deep dentary crest, a crest-height/mandibular-ramus-height ratio near four, and a medial dorsal bulge with shallow depressions. An estimated crest height near 90 mm and a 22 mm ramus height describe this material. Crest function remains uncertain; size alone does not establish sex, courtship or a species-wide growth stage.

title.zh: 无齿下颌与保存的腭部各有边界
title.en: Toothless jaws and the preserved palate have separate limits

text.zh: 下颌保存长约 230 毫米，完整长度估约 255 毫米；联合部背缘呈阶梯状、略 S 形，切缘无齿。腭部背面可见两条狭长内鼻孔与薄犁骨，其他骨缝不清。舌骨器保存细长棒状骨，却不是舌头软组织。原文的骨骼名称按 2012 年解释保留，未当作后续 CT 骨缝重评。
text.en: The mandible preserves about 230 mm, with total length estimated near 255 mm. Its symphyseal dorsal edge is step-like and slightly sigmoid, with toothless cutting edges. Dorsal palatal exposure shows two narrow choanae and a thin vomer, while other sutures are poorly visible. Slender hyoid rods are preserved rather than tongue soft tissue. Bone names retain the 2012 interpretation without implying a later CT-based reassessment.

title.zh: 两米翼展和上颌冠是不同层次的复原
title.en: Two-metre wingspan and an upper crest are different reconstructions

text.zh: 论文约两米翼展来自其他古神翼龙亚科成员的比例，正模没有可直接量翼展的完整翼骨。较高前上颌冠及可能后弯的轮廓，则由下颌冠和近亲比较推断；头部复原部分借用 Tapejara。它们不是保存完整的上颌冠或实测全翼，也不是本种成体最大值、确定体重或飞行速度。
text.en: A roughly two-metre wingspan is scaled from other tapejarines; the holotype lacks complete wing elements for direct span measurement. A high premaxillary crest and possibly backward-curving outline are inferred from the mandibular crest and relatives, with parts of the head reconstruction based on Tapejara. These are not an intact preserved upper crest or measured complete wing, nor maximum adult size, established mass or flight speed.

title.zh: Las Hoyas 的环境不等于本种全部生活史
title.en: Las Hoyas context does not define the species’ entire life history

text.zh: 正模来自 La Huérguina 地层上巴列姆阶纹层石灰岩。作者描述低起伏喀斯特背景中的亚热带湿润、森林和水域环境，遗址有大量水生生物；翼龙材料较少。这是保存地环境与集合背景，不把本种确定为水生、只住森林或以遗址某种植物为唯一食物；数据库宽年代也不是个体寿命。
text.en: The holotype comes from upper Barremian laminated limestone of the La Huérguina Formation. The authors describe subtropical wet, forested and aquatic settings over low-relief karst, with abundant aquatic organisms and rare pterosaur material. This is depositional and assemblage context, without establishing aquatic habits, exclusive forest residence or one local plant as its sole food; the database age bracket is not an individual lifespan.

title.zh: 早期亲缘结果不能确定地理起点
title.en: An early phylogenetic result does not establish geographic origin

text.zh: 2012 年等权、无序性状分析得到 135 棵同等简约树，严格共识支持古神翼龙亚科归属，但其内部位置仍分辨不足。欧亚起源与随后向巴西扩展是作者把地层先后、分布与亲缘合读的提议；他们也指出取样不均会造成表面缺席。最早保存地点本身不能确定真正起源。
text.en: The 2012 analysis uses equal-weight, unordered characters and obtains 135 equally parsimonious trees. Strict consensus supports tapejarine affinity but leaves relationships within that group poorly resolved. Eurasian origin and later expansion to Brazil are proposals combining stratigraphic succession, distribution and phylogeny; uneven sampling can also produce apparent absences. The earliest preserved locality does not directly establish true origin.

title.zh: 果实与种子传播仍缺直接食性证据
title.en: Fruit feeding and seed dispersal lack direct dietary evidence

text.zh: 无齿喙形及类比促使作者讨论食果、食种子或杂食，以及传播早期被子植物种子的可能。论文明确缺少胃内容等直接证据，地理和时间重合也不足以确认相互作用或共同演化。本种没有在此获得确定菜单、某种果实关系或已证传播行为；无齿本身不等于已经证实植食。
text.en: Toothless jaw form and analogies motivate discussion of fruit, seed or mixed feeding and possible early-angiosperm seed dispersal. The paper explicitly lacks direct evidence such as gut contents; temporal and geographic congruence does not establish interaction or coevolution. No definitive menu, particular fruit association or demonstrated dispersal behavior is assigned here, and toothlessness alone does not prove herbivory.

title.zh: 把欧洲下颌与中国材料对读
title.en: Compare the European mandible with Chinese material

text.zh: 阅读 Eopteranodon lii 的上下颌重识别，再看 Sinopterus dongi 的成长、冠饰和分类比较。2012 年欧洲描述与 2023 年中国材料重评是两项不同研究，不能拼成确定祖先链；现有证据也没有提供完整成长序列或直接食性证据。
text.en: Read the revised jaw identification in Eopteranodon lii, then growth, crests and taxonomy in Sinopterus dongi. The 2012 European description and 2023 Chinese reassessment remain separate studies, not an established ancestor chain. Their evidence does not provide a complete growth series or direct dietary evidence.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:

readerLimitations.en:
This account follows the 2012 description and a dated PBDB record for one collection. The incomplete skull and jaws do not preserve a full wing or upper crest, so wingspan and crest shape are reconstructions. Toothlessness and jaw form motivate dietary hypotheses but do not directly establish a menu or seed-dispersal behavior; the earliest known locality also does not determine the species' geographic origin.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

evidenceSummary:
The described anatomy and measurements follow the 2019 article, including its text, measurement table and captions. Images, physical thin sections, the cited matrix and later research have not been independently assessed here. Isolated-bone assignments, the minimum of three individuals, juvenile-to-subadult stages, the approximate three-metre wingspan and ecological proposals retain the limits of the study that produced them. The broad PBDB age bracket does not resolve disagreement about formation or age. Links to Caiuajara and Vespersaurus concern separate taxa and sources; they do not complete the local fauna or either animal’s full growth history.

title.zh: 沿头骨与孤立骨鉴别回看 Caiuajara
title.en: Return to Caiuajara through cranial and isolated-bone comparisons

text.zh: 将 Keresdrakon 与 Caiuajara dobruskii 并读：Caiuajara 的吻部向下弯并有冠饰，Keresdrakon 的吻部更长；后者头骨不完整，后部冠饰是否存在无法判断。2019 年描述分别讨论共同骨床与鉴别性状。邻近骨骼能把材料联系到同一地点，却不能证明所有骨头属于同一种或同一个体；共同出现也不确定最近亲缘关系。
text.en: Place Keresdrakon beside Caiuajara dobruskii. Caiuajara has a downturned rostrum and crest; the Keresdrakon rostrum is longer, while the rear crest cannot be assessed from its incomplete skull. The 2019 description treats shared bonebeds and diagnostic anatomy as separate evidence. Nearby bones connect a locality, but do not make every element the same taxon or individual. Co-occurrence also does not establish closest relatives.

title.zh: 翼龙切片与恐龙年龄模型各有尺度
title.en: Pterosaur sections and dinosaur age models use different scales

text.zh: 关联的 Vespersaurus paranaensis 研究利用生长标记、骨重塑和外层组织推断成熟。Keresdrakon 的两件组织样本没有提供 Vespersaurus 那样的年龄反推序列；新生个体尺寸假设和股骨／胫骨差异属于那件恐龙的样本。比较成长或生态前，应先区分实际保存的组织与据此作出的解释。
text.en: The linked Vespersaurus paranaensis study uses growth marks, remodeling and outer bone tissue to estimate maturity. Keresdrakon has two histology samples, not the same age-retrocalculation series used for Vespersaurus. The neonatal assumptions and femoral–tibial disagreement belong to that dinosaur’s sample. Compare observed tissue with the growth interpretation before drawing ecological conclusions.

title.zh: 关联正模与散开的其他材料
title.en: An associated holotype among dispersed remains

text.zh: 2019 年描述将 CP.V 2069 指定为 Keresdrakon vilsoni 正模，藏于巴西 CENPALEO，来自 Cruzeiro do Oeste 的骨床 C。它保存头骨前部、接近完整的下颌、部分颈椎和背椎、胸骨、肩带与骨盆材料，以及不完整肢骨。除上下颌外，骨骼彼此相关但没有关节连接。多数其他归入材料是孤立骨骼。作者根据头骨和翼指第一节指骨推定至少三个个体；这既不是化石总数，也不是种群规模。
text.en: The 2019 description names CP.V 2069, held at CENPALEO in Brazil, as the Keresdrakon vilsoni holotype from bonebed C at Cruzeiro do Oeste. It preserves the front of the skull, an almost complete lower jaw, selected neck and back vertebrae, the sternum, parts of the shoulder and pelvis, and incomplete limbs. Except for the jaws, the bones were associated but not articulated. Most additional assigned fossils are isolated elements. Skulls and first wing phalanges support the authors’ minimum of three individuals; that is neither a count of all fossils nor a population estimate.

title.zh: 长而无齿的颌部与未保存的冠饰范围
title.en: Long toothless jaws and limits on crest reconstruction

text.zh: 已描述的颌部无齿。头骨较低，吻部细长且尖；闭合时，上下颌之间没有 Tapejarinae 所描述的间隙。鼻眶前孔前缘之前没有保存前上颌矢状冠，但头骨后部不完整，更后方是否有冠饰仍未知。下颌联合部下方有一枚较小而厚的齿骨冠，后上缘附近的短钝脊也纳入诊断。保存下来的吻部、缺失的头骨区域和整体头部复原应分别理解。
text.en: The described jaws have no teeth. The skull is low, with a long pointed rostrum; when the jaws close, they do not leave the gap described in tapejarines. No sagittal crest is preserved on the front of the skull before the nasoantorbital opening, but the rear skull is incomplete, so a more posterior crest remains unknown. A small, thick dentary crest lies below the jaw symphysis, and a short blunt ridge near the rear upper edge contributes to the diagnosis. The preserved rostrum, missing crest region and whole-head reconstruction have different evidential limits.

title.zh: 鉴别依靠颌部、翼指和骨盆共同特征
title.en: Diagnosis combines jaw, wing-finger and pelvic features

text.zh: 原始诊断还列出第四指第一节指骨近端关节腹面前半部的开孔，以及坐骨外侧面的开孔。其他比较性状包括颈椎侧面较大的气孔、肱骨近端气孔的位置，以及乌喙骨与胸骨关节面不对称。作者提醒，较大的 Caiuajara 亚成体与较小的 Keresdrakon 幼体可能难以凭头后骨骼区分。尺寸本身不能鉴定孤立骨，挤压也可能遮住开孔。
text.en: The original diagnosis also includes a foramen on the front half of the underside of the first wing-finger joint and another on the outer surface of the ischium. Other comparisons involve large lateral air openings in the neck vertebrae, the position of openings near the upper humerus, and an asymmetric coracoid joint with the sternum. The authors caution that large subadult Caiuajara and smaller juvenile Keresdrakon can be difficult to distinguish from postcranial bones. Size alone cannot identify an isolated element, and crushing can hide openings.

title.zh: 气腔颈椎与身体材料的保存范围
title.en: Pneumatic cervical vertebrae and the preserved body

text.zh: 部分中段颈椎较长，神经棘高，侧面有较大开孔。一枚破损椎骨显示中空内部，神经管被骨小梁支撑的骨管包围。正模还包括薄胸骨板、细长腹肋、骨盆和不完整股骨、胫骨。归入的翼指第一节指骨略弯，没有融合的伸肌腱突；其中一些来自不同个体。这些材料可以用于解剖比较，但不能显示完整颈椎数量、软组织翼面、飞行速度或确切步态。
text.en: Some middle neck vertebrae are long, with tall neural spines and large openings at the sides. A broken vertebra shows a hollow interior and a neural canal enclosed in a bony tube supported by trabeculae. The holotype also includes a thin sternal plate, slender gastralia, pelvis and incomplete thigh and shin bones. Assigned first wing phalanges are slightly curved and lack a fused extensor tendon process; some came from different individuals. This material supports anatomical comparisons but does not reveal the full neck count, soft-tissue wing outline, flight speed or exact gait.

title.zh: 骨骼融合支持尚未完全成熟
title.en: Skeletal fusion supports incomplete maturity

text.zh: 正模的前上颌骨、部分颌骨，以及保存中段颈椎的椎体和神经弓已经融合；肩胛骨与乌喙骨、右肱骨远端及骨盆仍未融合。2019 年作者把标本置于其翼龙发育框架的 OS2 与 OS3 之间，并解释为较晚幼体或亚成体。这些比较阶段不能换算为实际岁数、性别或性成熟，也不能由一件正模代表全种成体骨架。
text.en: The holotype has fused premaxillae, some jaw bones and the centra and neural arches of the preserved middle neck vertebrae. Its scapula and coracoid, the end of the right humerus and pelvic bones remain unfused. The 2019 authors place the specimen between OS2 and OS3 in their pterosaur growth framework, interpreting it as a late juvenile or subadult. Those comparative stages do not give an age in years, sex or reproductive maturity, and one holotype cannot stand for the adult skeleton of the species.

title.zh: 两件骨切片揭示生长而非完整年龄表
title.en: Two bone samples reveal growth without a complete age series

text.zh: 研究对尺骨 CP.V 2077 和不完整的 CP.V 2374 取骨干切片；后者暂被解释为第一翼指骨。两者主要由纤维板层骨构成，骨膜侧开放血管通道且缺少成熟重塑，显示仍在生长。尺骨被解释为幼体但非新生个体，另一残段保存一条深部生长标记。作者认为组织与较快生长相符，但不能只凭血管排列比较 Keresdrakon 与 Caiuajara 的成长速度。两件样本不足以建立生长曲线，单条标记也不是确定年龄。
text.en: The study sampled the shafts of ulna CP.V 2077 and incomplete CP.V 2374, tentatively identified as a first wing phalanx. Both are mainly fibrolamellar bone; open canals near the outer bone surface and little advanced remodeling indicate continued growth. The ulna is interpreted as juvenile but not neonatal, while the second fragment preserves one deep growth mark. The authors relate the tissue to rapid growth, but vascular arrangement alone cannot rank growth rates in Keresdrakon and Caiuajara. Two samples do not make a growth curve, and one mark is not a definite age.

title.zh: 约三米翼展为比较估计
title.en: An approximately three-metre wingspan is comparative

text.zh: 作者把肱骨长度与 Tupuxuara、Caupedactylus 等材料比较，估计翼展约三米。这不是由完整保存的双翼直接量得，且标本被解释为尚未成熟。因此，三米不能代表物种的最大成体尺寸，也不能推出飞行距离或猎物大小上限。
text.en: Comparing humerus length with material from Tupuxuara and Caupedactylus led the authors to estimate a wingspan of about three metres. The span is reconstructed rather than measured from a complete preserved wing, and the fossils are interpreted as immature. It therefore does not give the species’ maximum adult size, flight range or prey-size limit.

title.zh: 反复同层关联支持共存解释
title.en: Repeated same-bed association supports coexistence

text.zh: 2019 年研究报告 Keresdrakon、Caiuajara 与 Vespersaurus 的材料共同出现在骨床 A、B、C。相同骨床中反复发现这几类材料，支持作者关于它们曾在同一地区共存的解释。多数骨骼已经散开，论文据此提出在绿洲附近死亡、暴露，随后由高能事件掩埋的模型。共同骨床比同属一个地层组提供更具体的地点关联，却不能证明同一时刻死亡、捕食关系或所有邻近骨骼属于同一个体。
text.en: The 2019 study reports Keresdrakon, Caiuajara and Vespersaurus together in bonebeds A, B and C. Repeated finds in the same beds support the authors’ interpretation that the animals coexisted in the area. Most bones are disarticulated, so the paper proposes deaths and exposure near an oasis followed by burial during high-energy events. Shared beds give a closer locality link than simply belonging to one formation, but do not prove deaths at the same moment, predation or that nearby bones belong to one individual.

title.zh: 食腐、捕食与独居保留为假说
title.en: Scavenging, predation and solitary behavior remain hypotheses

text.zh: 细长侧扁的吻部、稀少化石和同地动物群促使作者提出：Keresdrakon 可能机会性捕食或食腐，也可能不像 Caiuajara 那样群居。摄食尸体、卵或幼体属于生态假说，不是保存下来的胃内容物或直接行为观察。化石稀少也可能受采集、鉴定和埋藏过程影响；复原食物网不能单独证明独居或专性食腐。
text.en: The long, flattened rostrum, sparse fossils and animals found at the site prompted hypotheses that Keresdrakon scavenged or opportunistically hunted small animals and was less gregarious than Caiuajara. Eating carcasses, eggs or young animals is proposed ecology, not preserved gut content or observed behavior. The small sample may also reflect collection, identification and burial processes. A reconstructed food web cannot by itself show solitary living or obligate scavenging.

title.zh: 亲缘结果与地层争议各保留出处
title.en: Relationships and stratigraphic disputes retain their sources

text.zh: 把 Keresdrakon 加入既有性状矩阵后，2019 年分析得到六棵最简树，将它恢复为 Tapejaridae 的姐妹类群，即 Tapejaromorpha 中的非 Tapejaridae 分支。这是特定分析的结果，不是本页重算或后续研究的统一共识。同一论文主张地点属于 Goio-Erê 的局部出露，讨论其与地图所示 Rio Paraná 归属的分歧，并保留早、晚白垩世两种年代可能。PBDB 父级路径和宽年代区间应与这些论文解释分开阅读。
text.en: When Keresdrakon was added to an existing character matrix, the 2019 analysis recovered six most-parsimonious trees and placed it as sister to Tapejaridae: a non-tapejarid branch within Tapejaromorpha. This is the result of that analysis, not a rerun or a consensus across later studies. The same paper argues for a local Goio-Erê exposure, discusses disagreement with a mapped Rio Paraná assignment, and retains both Early and Late Cretaceous age possibilities. The PBDB parent path and broad age bracket are separate from those published interpretations.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
在所选 PBDB 翼龙记录中，Keresdrakon vilsoni 列在数据库父级 Keresdrakon 之下。本组资料含 1 条种级出现记录，来自 1 个采集记录，并关联 1 个引文编号。出现记录、采集记录和引文数分别统计不同对象，不能据此判断化石或个体多寡。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
Keresdrakon vilsoni 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:401469。这份存档导读包含 1 条选取的出现记录，关联 1 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 1 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
Keresdrakon vilsoni appears under the database parent Keresdrakon in the selected PBDB pterosaur records. The set contains 1 occurrence record, drawn from 1 collection and linked to 1 reference identifier. These counts describe database records, collection groups and citations; they do not measure the number of fossils or animals.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Keresdrakon vilsoni is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:401469. This archived guide contains 1 selected occurrence rows, linked to 1 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 1 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh:

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
所选记录的年代外界为 121.4–72.2 Ma；Ma 指百万年前。它合并了所选记录中最早的早端与最晚的晚端，并不表示整个跨度里每个时段都有化石，也不是对物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命的直接测定。采集地仍保留自己的宽区间；本页不会将其缩成精确标本年龄，也不改写来源中的测年解释。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
在这组 PBDB 记录中，最大记录 eag=121.4 Ma，见 occ:1487956；最小记录 lag=72.2 Ma，见 occ:1487956。这些数值是具名数据库记录的年代界，不代表两者之间存在连续记录，也不是该物种的起源、灭绝或个体寿命日期。每条记录各自的 eag 与 lag 值见上文。
text.en:
The selected record has an outer age interval of 121.4–72.2 Ma; Ma means millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound with the youngest late bound among the chosen records. It does not show continuous presence throughout that span or directly date the species origin, extinction or an individual lifespan. The collection retains its own broad bracket; this guide does not narrow it to a specimen age or revise the source dating interpretation.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:

These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh:
数据库为 Cemitério dos Pterossauros Quarry 记录了 interdune 采集环境和 body 实体化石保存方式。这些标签描述记录中的地点和集合分类，不能单独确定动物的日常栖地或食性，也不说明集合中每件化石的具体保存状态。

evidenceSummary:
This account summarizes the 2023 revision’s interpretation of holotype BPV 078 alongside one selected PBDB occurrence from the fixed 276-name pterosaur roster. The skull and jaw reassignment and the phylogenetic placement are interpretations attributed to that study. The proposed chronospecies relationship between E. lii and S. dongi remains a hypothesis: formation order does not prove direct ancestry. The broad database age bracket is not an exact specimen date, and a collection environment is not a species-wide habitat. The original 2005/2006 descriptions and the full range of later anatomical and ecological studies are outside this account.

title.zh: 正模 BPV 078 被重新解释为古神翼龙科
title.en: Holotype BPV 078 was re-read as a tapejarid

text.zh: 2023 年修订以正模 BPV 078 为中心重新讨论 Eopteranodon lii。该标本来自义县组，研究将它与较晚上覆九佛堂组的 Sinopterus 材料比较，同时保留本种与 S. dongi 及 Huaxiadraco corollatus 的区别。其中一项关键变化是头骨和下颌残片的识别。
text.en: The 2023 revision re-examines Eopteranodon lii through its holotype, BPV 078, from the Yixian Formation. It compares that fossil with Sinopterus from the younger, overlying Jiufotang Formation while keeping E. lii distinct from S. dongi and Huaxiadraco corollatus. One central change is the identification of the skull and jaw remains.

title.zh: 头骨与下颌的原识别发生互换
title.en: The original skull and jaw identifications were reversed

text.zh: 作者指出 BPV 078 的头骨部分和下颌部分原先被彼此调换识别。重评辨认出向下弯的吻部及前上颌骨冠，并据此支持其属于古神翼龙科。论文分别描述了主板、对板和头部细节。化石身份不变，变化的是作者对头部材料的解读。
text.en: The authors report that the skull and mandibular parts of BPV 078 had originally been identified in reverse. Their re-examination recognizes a downturned snout and a crest on the premaxilla, supporting placement among tapejarids. The account distinguishes the main slab, its counterpart and cranial details. The specimen remains the same; the revised identification is the authors’ interpretation.

title.zh: 相似特征之外还有比例差异
title.en: Similar features coexist with different proportions

text.zh: 修订指出本种与 S. dongi 有相似处：近方形眼眶、方骨向后倾约 160 度、第四颈椎最长。差异包括 E. lii 的鼻眶前孔较短而高（长高比约 2.5）、翼骨与尺骨长度比约 0.56、第四翼指节与第一节比约 0.45，以及第一跖骨短于第二跖骨。这些比例组合用于比较具名标本，不能单独鉴定所有碎片，也不测量飞行性能。
text.en: The revision notes similarities to S. dongi: a nearly quadrangular eye socket, a quadrate angled back by about 160°, and a fourth neck vertebra longer than the others. It also records differences: E. lii has a stouter nasoantorbital opening (length-to-height ratio about 2.5), a pteroid-to-ulna ratio near 0.56, a fourth-to-first wing-phalanx ratio near 0.45, and a first metatarsal shorter than the second. Together these measurements compare named specimens; no single ratio identifies every fragment or measures flight performance.

title.zh: 一项矩阵分析把三个物种放在一起
title.en: One matrix analysis places three species together

text.zh: 2023 年研究使用更新的性状矩阵、等权法和 TNT 搜索，得到三棵最短树。其严格共识树将 E. lii 与 S. dongi 归为一支，再以 H. corollatus 为姊妹种。作者区分按总体相似度聚类与依据性状证据推断亲缘关系。此前也有人提出朝阳翼龙科位置。
text.en: With an updated character matrix, equal weighting and searches in TNT, the 2023 study found three shortest trees. Their strict consensus groups E. lii with S. dongi, with H. corollatus as the sister species to that pair. The authors distinguish a cluster based on overall similarity from a phylogeny inferred from character evidence. Other placements, including an earlier chaoyangopterid affinity, have also been proposed.

title.zh: 直接祖先关系仍是假说
title.en: A direct ancestor link remains a hypothesis

text.zh: E. lii 出自较老的义县组，且在形态上接近来自较年轻九佛堂组的 S. dongi，因此作者提出两者可能是渐进演化过程中的时间种。这仍是假说，并非已证祖先—后代链。仅凭地层先后与形态相似，无法证明直接祖先关系、精确化石年代或两物种是否曾同时生活。
text.en: Because E. lii is from the older Yixian Formation and resembles S. dongi from the younger Jiufotang Formation, the authors propose that the two may be chronospecies along a gradual evolutionary sequence. This is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated ancestor–descendant chain. Stratigraphic succession and resemblance alone cannot establish direct ancestry, exact fossil ages or whether the two species ever coexisted.

title.zh: 与相关物种的比较一起阅读
title.en: Read the comparisons alongside related species

text.zh: 可将本页与 Sinopterus dongi 和 Huaxiadraco corollatus 对读，比较它们的解剖和分类。这里讨论的亲缘关系和翅膀、头骨比例应分开理解；形态相似不能确定它们食性相同。
text.en: Compare these proposed relationships with the pages for Sinopterus dongi and Huaxiadraco corollatus. Their anatomy and classification can be read alongside the differences in wing and skull proportions here. Similarity and stratigraphic order do not establish that the animals shared a diet.

evidenceSummary:
The account rests on two incomplete jaw fragments and published comparisons of their form, age, maturity and possible function. Their proposed referral to one species does not establish that they came from one individual; family placement, probing behavior and remote touch remain uncertain. Estimated missing lengths are not measurements of complete jaws, and the database age range is not a direct date for the species' origin or extinction.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. title.zh: 两段颌骨支持同种归属，不是关联头骨
title.en: Two jaw fragments support a species referral, not an associated skull

text.zh: Leptostomia begaaensis 的正模 FSAC-KK 5075 是缺少尖端的前部上颌吻部；副模 FSAC-KK 5076 是前部下颌联合的一段，也缺少尖端。两件材料存于卡萨布兰卡 Université Hassan II 的 Faculté des Sciences Aïn Chock 收藏。原始描述据相近尺寸、长低轮廓、厚壁半圆截面、骨孔分布及相对应的嵴与沟支持同种归属；2023 年明确说没有理由认为它们来自同一个体。这里没有完整头骨或关联身体骨骼。
text.en: Holotype FSAC-KK 5075 is a partial anterior rostrum missing its tip; paratype FSAC-KK 5076 is part of the anterior mandibular symphysis, also missing its tip. Both are held at the Faculté des Sciences Aïn Chock, Université Hassan II, Casablanca. The original description supports referral to one species from similar size, long low outlines, thick-walled semicircular sections, foramina and a corresponding ridge-and-groove complex. The 2023 account explicitly gives no reason to regard them as one individual. Neither a complete skull nor an associated body skeleton is available.

title.zh: 48 与 67 毫米是保存长度
title.en: 48 and 67 mm are preserved lengths

text.zh: 原始稿件与表 1 记录，上颌片段保存长 48 毫米，下颌片段保存长 67 毫米。作者假定颌部均匀收尖，分别推算前方还缺约 70 毫米、35 毫米；这两个数字是缺失段估计，不是保存长度或已经量得的完整喙长。上颌在鼻眶前孔之前折断，下颌后端未达两支分叉。下颌近尖端的弯曲还受到修补影响，不能把全部曲度当作原始形状。
text.en: The manuscript and table 1 record 48 mm of preserved rostrum and 67 mm of preserved mandible. Assuming an evenly tapering tip, the authors estimate about 70 mm and 35 mm missing anteriorly, respectively. Those are missing-length estimates, not preserved lengths or measurements of a complete beak. The rostrum breaks anterior to the nasoantorbital fenestra; the mandible stops before the rami diverge. Repair also accentuates curvature near the mandibular tip, so the entire observed curve cannot be treated as original anatomy.

title.zh: 低夹角、中央嵴与对应的下颌沟
title.en: Low angles, a median ridge and a corresponding groove

text.zh: 上颌咬合面有沿保存段延伸的中央嵴，下颌则由前部较平的表面过渡到后部浅中央沟。作者结合侧面夹角差异区分上下颌；2023 年比较给出约 2.5° 与 2.0°。两者背腹扁平、截面近半圆，厚骨壁包围较小内部空腔，并有细长裂隙状骨孔。这些是一组形态比较依据；嵴沟相配不能证明两段实物曾连接，也不直接保存取食动作。
text.en: A median ridge extends along the preserved upper-jaw occlusal surface. The lower jaw changes from a flatter anterior surface to a shallow posterior median groove. The authors distinguish upper and lower jaws partly by lateral-angle differences, given as about 2.5° and 2.0° in the 2023 comparison. Both are dorsoventrally flattened, approximately semicircular in section, and have thick cortices around reduced cavities with elongate slit-like foramina. This character combination informs comparison; a corresponding ridge and groove do not prove that the fragments were joined or directly preserve feeding behavior.

title.zh: XCT 描述的是骨内空腔与通道
title.en: XCT describes internal cavities and canals

text.zh: 作者对正模 FSAC-KK 5075 进行 X 射线计算机断层成像，并用软件去除基质、构建三维模型。稿件描述沿吻部延伸的扁平中央空腔、局部跨越空腔的薄骨小梁，以及通向外部细长骨孔的通道。图像与模型显示内部构造，不是保存的神经或感受器；骨通道也不能测出感觉表现。
text.en: The authors used X-ray computed tomography on holotype FSAC-KK 5075, digitally removing matrix and constructing a three-dimensional model. The manuscript describes a flattened central void extending along the rostrum, thin trabeculae crossing it locally, and canals opening into elongate external foramina. Imaging and models reveal internal architecture rather than preserved nerves or sensory receptors; the canals do not measure sensory performance.

title.zh: 小尺寸不等于已确定的幼体
title.en: Small size does not establish a juvenile

text.zh: 原始描述认为两件标本较平滑的骨表面支持骨骼成熟的推断。这个判断来自局部表面比较，不是精确年龄测定；材料仍然是两段颌骨，没有生长序列、完整翼部或性别证据。不能仅因保存段只有数厘米便将其写成幼体，也不能把成熟推断延伸为本种完整成年体型或固定翼展。
text.en: The original description interprets the relatively smooth surfaces of both specimens as suggesting osteological maturity. This comes from local surface comparison, not exact age determination. The material remains two jaw fragments, without a growth series, complete wings or sex evidence. Preserved lengths of only a few centimeters do not by themselves establish juveniles, and the maturity inference supplies neither complete adult proportions nor a fixed wingspan.

title.zh: 亲缘分析受少量可编码性状限制
title.en: Relationships are limited by few codable characters

text.zh: 原始稿件把无齿、细长骨孔与厚骨壁的组合视为更支持 Azhdarchoidea，同时保留科级归属未知。其系统发育分析采用既有数据集并增加五个性状；作者报告可编码性状有限、相似性状重复演化，导致无序与不同有序处理的结果未解或相互冲突，另有与 ctenochasmatids、Lonchodectes 接近的结果。2023 年介绍也保留科级位置未定。因此，已发表分析不足以把目录父链视为确定的亲缘关系结论。
text.en: The original manuscript favors Azhdarchoidea from the combination of toothlessness, elongate foramina and thick cortices, while leaving family attribution unknown. Its phylogenetic analysis adds five characters to an existing dataset. The authors report few codable characters and homoplasy, yielding unresolved or conflicting results under unordered and differently ordered treatments, including alternatives near ctenochasmatids and Lonchodectes. The 2023 account also leaves the family position indeterminate. The published analyses therefore do not support treating the directory parent chain as a settled phylogenetic result.

title.zh: 探入沉积物取食是形态支持的假说
title.en: Sediment probing is a morphological hypothesis

text.zh: 原始描述把细长、狭窄、背腹扁平的颌部与加强的骨壁，同现生探食鸟类作功能比较，提出 Leptostomia 可能把喙探入泥土或沉积物获取小型无脊椎动物。作者也认为 Kem Kem 的淡水至半咸水沉积背景与这个假说相容。鸟类类比、骨形与环境的一致性不是本种胃内容物、直接取食观察或专属足迹；文中提到的蠕虫、甲壳类、软体动物是潜在猎物，不能写成已经确认的食谱。
text.en: The original description compares the long, narrow, dorsoventrally flattened jaws and strengthened cortices with probing birds, proposing that Leptostomia inserted its beak into soil or sediment to obtain small invertebrates. The authors consider the freshwater-to-brackish Kem Kem setting compatible with this hypothesis. Bird analogies, bone form and environmental consistency are not stomach contents, direct feeding observations or tracks assigned to this species. Worms, crustaceans and molluscs discussed as potential prey cannot become a confirmed menu.

title.zh: 缺少喙尖，远距触觉仍是可检验预测
title.en: Missing tips leave remote touch as a testable prediction

text.zh: 某些探食鸟类可以借喙尖感受结构察觉隐蔽猎物引起的振动或水压变化。作者讨论这种“远距触觉”作为 Leptostomia 的可能适应，但明确指出正模与副模都没有前端，无法确定喙尖是否有集中骨孔支持这一能力，并提出可用更多标本检验这一预测。保存段的骨孔与内部通道本身不是感受器，因此远距触觉仍未得到证实。
text.en: Some probing birds detect vibrations or pressure changes from hidden prey through sensory structures near the bill tip. The authors discuss this remote-touch ability as a possible adaptation in Leptostomia but explicitly state that both type specimens lack their anterior tips, preventing assessment of concentrated tip foramina that might support it. Additional specimens could test the prediction. The preserved foramina and canals are not themselves sensory receptors, so the proposed touch ability remains unconfirmed.

overview: Beccari and colleagues’ 2021 description centers on GP/2E 9266, a largely articulated Tupandactylus navigans skeleton with skull, postcranial bones and soft-tissue traces. It is referred material, not the holotype SMNK PAL 2344. At publication, it was the first postcranial specimen unambiguously assigned to the genus, linking body anatomy to the skull-based record. That advance does not mean all referred specimens have since been rechecked.

evidenceSummary:
This page pairs a bilingual guide to selected passages of the 2021 associated-skeleton study with the fixed PBDB occurrence record. The exact specimen locality and horizon remain unknown. The paper calls the geological setting Aptian but labels the systematic horizon Albian; this internal discrepancy is retained rather than harmonized, and PBDB age brackets are not revised. This pass read previously unvisited anatomical subsections and selected headers, relevant taxon rows, character definitions and commands in both official supplements. Original descriptions, images and supplements are not fully assembled or inspected; the specimen, raw CT and matrix were not independently checked, measured or rerun. Diet, flight, sexual dimorphism and maturity remain author interpretations. The guide adds shoulder girdle, forearm, wrist/metacarpus, pelvis, legs/feet and measurement-table coverage, but does not remeasure scans; the Table 4 wing-phalanx side discrepancy remains unresolved and reader-facing delivery is pending. A complete matrix audit and tree rerun are still outstanding, so missing scores and an unresolved branching pattern are not treated as settled species relationships.

title.zh: 先区分两次分析的取样
title.en: Separate the samples in the two analyses

text.zh: 2021 年研究先用一套形态矩阵分析 64 个分类单元和 150 个离散性状，并以 GP/2E 9266 补充 T. navigans 的身体解剖。作者先把正模 SMNK PAL 2344 单独编码，称与新标本可比较的性状没有冲突，随后用新标本编码分析物种位置。第二套矩阵再把 MN 6588-V 作为独立单元加入；补充文件表头列出 65 个单元和 150 个性状。这些是用于比较的树末端，不是 T. navigans 化石数量或 Tupandactylus 种数。
text.en: The 2021 study ran a first morphological matrix with 64 taxonomic units and 150 discrete characters, using GP/2E 9266 to add body anatomy for T. navigans. Before analysis, the authors coded holotype SMNK PAL 2344 separately and reported no conflicting scores for characters shared with the new specimen; they then used the new specimen’s coding to place the species. A second matrix added MN 6588-V as its own unit; the supplement header lists 65 units and 150 characters. These are comparative tree terminals, not a count of T. navigans fossils or Tupandactylus species.

title.zh: 多棵最简树与未解分叉
title.en: Multiple shortest trees and unresolved branching

text.zh: 第一轮搜索得到 132 棵最简树，每棵 371 步；加入 MN 6588-V 后为 469 棵、各 373 步。严格共识树将 T. navigans 放在 Tapejarinae 的未解多分叉中，同组还有 T. imperator、Tapejara wellnhoferi、Europejara olcadesorum 和 Caiuajara dobruskii。第二套分析也把 MN 6588-V 放在这组未解关系中。树的数量和步数描述这次矩阵与搜索，不是种数或亲缘概率，也不证明两个 Tupandactylus 种互为最近姐妹群。
text.en: The first search returned 132 most-parsimonious trees, each 371 steps long; with MN 6588-V included, it returned 469 trees of 373 steps. In the strict consensus, T. navigans sits in an unresolved Tapejarinae polytomy with T. imperator, Tapejara wellnhoferi, Europejara olcadesorum and Caiuajara dobruskii. The second analysis adds MN 6588-V to that same unresolved grouping. Tree count and length describe this matrix and search; they are not species counts or probabilities, and they do not show that the two Tupandactylus species are closest sisters.

title.zh: 缺失编码不等于共享解剖
title.en: Missing scores do not establish shared anatomy

text.zh: 补充矩阵分别编码 T. imperator 和 T. navigans，第二套再加入 MN 6588-V。许多性状格缺少资料，尤其是 T. imperator 的头后骨骼。论文指出两个种目前可比较的编码没有差异；但缺失解剖并不能证明整副身体相同，也不能证明它们是同种的不同性别。部分性状还被设为有序，结果会受取样类群、性状定义、可编码材料和搜索设置影响。本页没有重新编码全部矩阵或重跑搜索。
text.en: The supplements code T. imperator and T. navigans separately, then add MN 6588-V in the second matrix. Many character cells are missing, especially for T. imperator’s postcranial skeleton. The paper notes no differences in the scores available for the two species; missing anatomy means this cannot establish identical whole bodies or prove they are different sexes of one species. Some characters were ordered, and the result depends on the sampled taxa, character definitions, scorable remains and search settings. This guide has not recoded the full matrix or rerun the search.

title.zh: 扫描与数字模型提供不同层次的观察
title.en: Scans and digital models provide different observations

text.zh: 研究使用医学 CT 观察仍埋在围岩中的骨骼，报告体素尺寸为 0.976 毫米、重叠为 0.33 毫米。作者分割并重采样扫描资料生成网格，再将网格平滑以便展示。数字模型无法呈现扫描未分辨的细节、补回缺骨、消除压扁或确定完整活体姿势。本页依据论文公布的扫描参数与复原，不把原始 CT 切片当作新增观察。
text.en: Medical CT was used to see bones still enclosed in rock; the reported voxel size is 0.976 mm, with 0.33 mm overlap. The authors segmented and resampled the scans into meshes, then smoothed those meshes for display. A digital model cannot show detail the scan did not resolve, restore missing bones, reverse compression or establish a complete living pose. This account follows the published parameters and reconstructions; it does not add observations from raw CT slices.

title.zh: 融合肩带仍须与裂缝区分
title.en: Fused shoulder elements require distinguishing fractures

text.zh: 两侧肩胛乌喙骨都有保存，左侧更完整，但看不到肩胛与乌喙骨之间的骨缝。作者特意把左乌喙骨近端的横向骨折与两骨之间的关节缝区分开；右肩胛还保留了连接背椎联合体的关节面。这些结构说明胸肩带支撑；骨折不等于关节未融合，融合也不能单独测出确切年龄或起飞性能。
text.en: Both scapulocoracoids are present, although the left is better preserved and no scapula–coracoid suture is visible. The authors distinguish a transverse fracture near the left coracoid’s proximal end from that joint suture; the right scapula retains an articular surface for the notarium. These bones document the pectoral support system. A fracture is not evidence of an unfused joint, and fusion alone does not give an exact age or launch performance.

title.zh: 左右肱骨保存不同，肌肉嵴不是实测肌力
title.en: Different humeral preservation does not measure muscle force

text.zh: 左肱骨受压变扁，远端缺失一部分。右肱骨较完整，但近端和三角胸肌嵴区域仍埋在围岩中，作者借助 CT 观察。论文描述较宽的肌肉附着嵴和气孔。约 0.78 的肱骨／股骨长度比属于这件标本；嵴的大小不是保存下来的肌肉体积，也不是飞行功率的直接测量。
text.en: The left humerus is flattened and partly missing at its distal end. The right is complete, but its proximal and deltopectoral regions remain partly buried and were assessed by CT. Broad muscle-attachment crests and pneumatic openings are described. The humerus-to-femur ratio, about 0.78, belongs to this specimen; crest size is not preserved muscle volume or a direct measure of flight power.

title.zh: 腕掌结构把短手指与翼指分开
title.en: Wrist and metacarpal anatomy separates small fingers from the wing

text.zh: 腕部保存近端、远端融合腕骨及翼骨。第一至第三掌骨细长，不延伸到腕部，只到第四掌骨长度的大约一半；第四掌骨支撑翼指。右翼骨则超过尺骨长度的一半。两只手的暴露程度不同，右手部分需用 CT 查看。这些关系帮助认识翼部骨架，但没有保存完整翼膜，也不能证明某种攀爬或飞行行为。
text.en: The wrist preserves proximal and distal syncarpals and the pteroid. Metacarpals I–III are slender and stop short of the wrist, reaching only about halfway along metacarpal IV, which supports the wing finger; the right pteroid is longer than half the ulna. The two hands are exposed differently, and CT was needed for parts of the right side. These bones clarify wing construction, but no complete membrane is preserved and they do not prove a particular climbing or flight behavior.

title.zh: 骨盆保留成熟线索与未完全发育的信号
title.en: The pelvis combines maturity indicators with incomplete development

text.zh: 骨盆近乎完整，但缺少耻骨前骨和少量骨片，骨缝也无法辨认。长的髂骨前突可能因侧向挤压而旋转，因此化石朝向未必就是活体姿势。作者还认为坐耻骨板看起来未完全发育。这与其他融合特征支持的成熟解释并列；仅凭看不见骨缝不能确定繁殖年龄、性别或整个类群的融合顺序。
text.en: The pelvis is nearly complete, but the prepubis and small portions are absent, and its sutures cannot be made out. Lateral compression may have rotated the long preacetabular ilium, so the fossil’s orientation need not match the living posture. The authors also describe the ischiopubic plate as apparently incompletely developed. This sits alongside maturity inferred from other fused bones; invisible sutures alone cannot establish reproductive age, sex or a fusion sequence for the whole clade.

title.zh: 长后肢与四趾足不是奔跑速度记录
title.en: Long hindlimbs and a four-digit foot do not record running speed

text.zh: 胫骨约为股骨长度的 1.5 倍，腓骨较短。四个足趾保存了趾节，爪比手爪短，右足末端则不完整。这些比例可用于讨论支撑和运动假说，不是速度或食性的测量。腓骨／胫骨比和趾节式都不能解决更广泛的形态争议。
text.en: The tibiae are about one and a half times the femoral length, while the fibulae are shorter. Four toes preserve phalanges; their claws are shorter than the hand claws, and the right foot is incomplete at its tip. These proportions inform hypotheses about support and movement, not measured speed or diet. Neither the fibula-to-tibia ratio nor the toe formula resolves wider morphological disputes.

title.zh: 2.7 米翼展属于这件骨架的估计
title.en: The 2.7 m wingspan is a specimen estimate

text.zh: 作者根据 GP/2E 9266 的肱骨、尺骨、第四掌骨和翼指节，估计翼展约 2.7 米。表格还逐侧报告保存状况不同的骨骼尺寸，没有把它们拼成一个理想完整个体。第四翼指节的侧别在表 4 和保存描述中不一致，仍需检查图像或标本。该估计不是全种最大翼展，也不是飞行性能的直接测试。
text.en: The authors estimate a wingspan of about 2.7 m for GP/2E 9266 from the humerus, ulna, metacarpal IV and wing phalanges. Their tables also report side-specific measurements from bones with different preservation, rather than combining them into one ideal intact individual. The side reported for wing phalanx IV differs between Table 4 and the preservation account and still needs checking against the images or specimen. The estimate is not a maximum for the species or a direct test of flight performance.

title.zh: 把关联身体与孤立头部对读
title.en: Compare an associated body with isolated cranial material

text.zh: Huaxiapterus corollatus 页面可用于比较掌骨和翼指末节；Europejara olcadesorum 页面则从头骨而非关联骨架估算翼展。GP/2E 9266 因而提供肢骨比例，孤立头骨需要用相对尺度推算。两项对照都没有直接记录飞行，也不能确定飞行表现。
text.en: The linked Huaxiapterus corollatus page compares metacarpals and the terminal wing phalanges; the Europejara olcadesorum page estimates span from a skull rather than an associated skeleton. GP/2E 9266 therefore contributes limb proportions, while the isolated head requires relative scaling. Neither comparison records flight itself or establishes performance.

title.zh: 一件骨架把头冠与身体连接起来
title.en: One skeleton connects the crest with the body

text.zh: Beccari 等人在 2021 年描述的重点是 GP/2E 9266：一件大部分保持关节连接的 Tupandactylus navigans 骨架，保存头骨、头后骨骼和软组织痕迹。它是归入本种的材料，不是正模 SMNK PAL 2344。论文发表时，这是首件明确归入本属的头后骨骼材料，使身体解剖可以与已知头骨相联系；这项进展不表示所有归入材料后来都已复核。
text.en: Beccari and colleagues’ 2021 description centers on GP/2E 9266, a largely articulated Tupandactylus navigans skeleton with skull, postcranial bones and soft-tissue traces. It is referred material, not the holotype SMNK PAL 2344. At publication, it was the first postcranial specimen unambiguously assigned to the genus, linking body anatomy to the skull-based record. That advance does not mean all referred specimens have since been rechecked.

title.zh: 六块石板与不均匀的保存
title.en: Six slabs and uneven preservation

text.zh: 化石分布在六块可拼合的石灰岩板上，部分锯切线穿过骨骼和冠部组织。入藏前，一些破裂板曾用细金属条接合。保存情况不均：压扁、风化和缺失都存在，包括左侧第四翼指节缺失、右足远端不全。“近完整”指关联骨骼材料丰富，不是每处都完整无损。围岩将标本归入 Crato 组，但确切地点和层位未知；数据库中的 Nova Olinda 采集记录不等于已证实的标本精确地点。
text.en: The fossil is distributed across six matching limestone slabs, and some saw cuts cross bones and crest tissue. Before accession, thin metal bars had been used to reconnect some broken slabs. Preservation varies: compression, weathering and missing parts include the left fourth wing phalanx and the distal right foot. “Nearly complete” describes the amount of associated skeleton, not uniformly intact preservation. The matrix places it in the Crato Formation, but the exact locality and horizon are unknown; the database’s Nova Olinda collection is not proven to be this specimen’s precise site.

title.zh: 骨性支架与软组织共同形成头冠
title.en: Bone and soft tissue together form the crest

text.zh: 纤细、近乎竖直的前上颌骨上突支撑冠饰前部，后方顶骨冠短而圆；这些形态有助于鉴定为 T. navigans。保存的冠部软组织包括腹侧纤维区和较平滑的背侧区，向上高出头骨很多，但最顶端并未暴露。CT 还显示被围岩遮住的骨冠向前扩张。这些证据描述支架和组织的形态关系；化石深浅色斑可能来自氧化，不能确定活体颜色或性别。
text.en: A slender, almost vertical supra-premaxillary process supports the front of the crest; behind it, the parietal crest is short and rounded. Those shapes help identify the specimen as T. navigans. Preserved crest tissue has a fibrous ventral zone and smoother dorsal zone rising well above the skull, though its uppermost edge is not exposed. CT also shows an anterior expansion of the bony crest beneath matrix. This describes the support and tissue geometry; fossil color patches may reflect oxidation and cannot establish living colors or sex.

title.zh: 无齿颌与保存的喙鞘
title.en: Toothless jaws and a preserved beak sheath

text.zh: 上下颌无齿，吻端向下弯。组织鞘覆盖吻部和下颌前端，并延伸到深而呈刀片状的下颌冠；作者把它解释为角质喙鞘。上下喙之间的间隙限制了完全闭合状态的复原。处理小食物或较硬植物材料只是功能假说，不是已证实食谱；论文未报告胃内容物或直接取食观察。
text.en: The jaws lack teeth, and the snout turns downward. Tissue sheaths cover the front of the rostrum and lower jaw, continuing over the deep, blade-shaped dentary crest; the authors interpret them as a keratinous beak covering. A gap between upper and lower beak constrains how fully the mouth could close. Handling small food or harder plant material is a functional proposal, not a demonstrated menu: no stomach contents or direct feeding observations are reported.

title.zh: 颈椎、背椎融合与个体成熟度
title.en: Neck anatomy, fused dorsals and individual maturity

text.zh: 标本保存九枚颈椎，包括融合的寰椎—枢椎复合体。颈部中段椎骨较长，后段较短，部分关节突侧面有纵向沟槽。前五枚背椎的椎体融合为背椎联合体（notarium），但神经棘融合程度不同。作者再结合翼指伸肌腱突融合，推断个体成熟；胫跗骨未融合则提示另一种信号。现有翼手龙发育资料不足以把这些混合证据换算成确切年龄或物种生长曲线。
text.en: Nine cervical vertebrae are preserved, including a fused atlas–axis complex. The middle neck vertebrae are elongated, the posterior ones shorter, and some postzygapophyses carry lateral longitudinal grooves. The centra of the first five dorsal vertebrae form a notarium, although their neural spines are fused to different degrees. Together with fusion of the wing-extensor tendon process, this led the authors to infer maturity; the unfused tibiotarsus points the other way. Tapejarid growth is not documented well enough to convert this mixed signal into an exact age or species-wide growth curve.

title.zh: 带爪的手指与延长的翼指
title.en: Clawed fingers beside the elongated wing finger

text.zh: 左手前三指完整，指节式为 2–3–4，弯曲的爪保留了角质组织轮廓。第四指形成延长的翼指；左侧末节缺失，右侧翼指节则可以观察。爪记录了抓握结构，却不能单独证明攀树或某种取食行为。CT 分割使埋在围岩中的骨骼可见；平滑后的网格用于呈现，不能替代缺失骨片。
text.en: The first three digits of the left hand are complete, with phalangeal formula 2–3–4 and curved claws that retain a keratinous tissue outline. The fourth digit forms the elongated wing finger. Its terminal left phalanx is missing, while the right wing phalanges can be seen. The claws record grasping anatomy but do not alone prove tree climbing or a feeding behavior. CT segmentation reveals bones within the rock; smoothed meshes aid display and cannot replace missing elements.

title.zh: 飞行与地面觅食仍需力学检验
title.en: Flight and ground foraging need mechanical assessment

text.zh: 作者将背椎联合体、胸肌附着区和肢骨比例与飞行及四足起飞可能性联系起来，也讨论了地面觅食。长颈和巨大冠饰使早先把冠饰当作空气动力结构的解释更复杂。论文考虑短距离飞行，但明确需要进一步的生物力学研究。骨架没有直接测量飞行速度、航程、起飞频率，也未确立固定的地面生活方式。
text.en: The authors connect the notarium, pectoral muscle attachment area and limb proportions to flight and possible quadrupedal launch, and also discuss terrestrial foraging. The long neck and large crest complicate earlier ideas that treated the crest as an aerodynamic device. Short-distance flight is considered, but the paper calls for more biomechanical study. The skeleton does not directly measure speed, range, launch frequency or a settled ground-dwelling lifestyle.

title.zh: 种间差异与亲缘结果保留未决部分
title.en: Species differences and relationships retain uncertainty

text.zh: 2021 年矩阵将 T. navigans 放在 Tapejarinae 的未解多分叉中，与 T. imperator 等分类群同组；它没有证明两种 Tupandactylus 是最近姐妹群。作者比较冠饰方向和下颌冠形态，并提出但未检验性二型的可能。MN 6588-V 只鉴定到 Tupandactylus sp.，未可靠归入 T. navigans。因此，目录继续保留两个名录种，不把属级材料计为另一条种级出现记录。
text.en: In the 2021 matrix, T. navigans falls within Tapejarinae in an unresolved polytomy with T. imperator and other taxa; the analysis does not establish the two species as closest sisters. The authors compare crest direction and dentary-crest form, and raise—but do not test—the possibility of sexual dimorphism. MN 6588-V is assigned only to Tupandactylus sp., not confidently to T. navigans. The catalogue therefore keeps the two roster species separate and does not turn genus-level material into another species occurrence.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
在固定 PBDB 名录中，Tupandactylus navigans 是 Tupandactylus 属下的接受种。本次摘录含 1 条可用种级出现记录、1 个采集记录和 1 个引文编号；这是三种不同数据库计数，不是化石或个体数。出现行保留原鉴定或名称组合与接受名之间的对应，名称重组不另算一次发现。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
Tupandactylus navigans 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:163700。这份存档导读包含 1 条选取的出现记录，关联 1 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 1 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
Within the fixed PBDB roster, Tupandactylus navigans is accepted under Tupandactylus. This extract contains one qualifying species-level occurrence, one collection and one reference identifier; these are separate database counts, not fossils or individual animals. The occurrence row preserves the link between the original identification or combination and the accepted name, so a recombination is not counted as a second discovery.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Tupandactylus navigans is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:163700. This archived guide contains 1 selected occurrence rows, linked to 1 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 1 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh:
所选记录列出 Nova Olinda quarries（Ceara），地区代码 BR，地层 Crato；数据库年代范围为 119.57–113.2 Ma，早端区间为 Late Aptian。地点和地层按来源写法保留。这些字段标记目录记录的背景，不是物种完整分布；一处出现记录也不能证明其他地区不存在本种。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
存档导读包含 1 条出现记录，以下列出全部记录。每个 occ: 编号标识一条出现记录；col: 标识其关联的采集记录。

- 出现记录 occ:849621；PBDB 采集记录 col:77891。 地点字段 cnm=Nova Olinda quarries；地点分区字段 cc2=BR，stp=Ceara。 记录年代界：eag 119.57 Ma; lag 113.2 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Late Aptian。 地层字段 sfm=Crato。 记录署名 Frey et al. 2003；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32116。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
in the lower 20m of the section

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
from the stone quarries south of Nova Olinda
text.en:
The selected row names Nova Olinda quarries (Ceara), region code BR, and the Crato stratum; its database bracket is 119.57–113.2 Ma, with Late Aptian as the early interval. These labels follow the source wording. They locate the catalogue record, not the species’ full distribution; a recorded locality does not establish absence elsewhere.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
The archived guide contains 1 occurrence row; all are listed below. Each occ: identifier names an occurrence record, while col: identifies its linked collection record.

本页将 2021 年关联骨架研究的选段双语导读与固定 PBDB 出现记录并列。标本精确地点和层位未知；论文地质背景写 Aptian，系统描述的层位行写 Albian，因此保留这项内部矛盾，不静默统一，也不据此改动 PBDB 年代。本批补读了此前未读的解剖分节，并选看两套官方补充矩阵的表头、相关分类行、性状定义和命令。原始描述、图像与补充资料尚未完整汇集或检查；没有独立检查标本、原始 CT 或完整矩阵，没有复量或重跑分析。食性、飞行、性二型与成熟度仍是作者解释。本页补入肩带、前臂、腕掌、骨盆、腿足及尺寸表的阅读内容，但未复量扫描；表 4 翼指节侧别差异尚未解决，读者端交付仍待完成。完整矩阵审计和树搜索重跑尚未进行，因此缺失编码和未解分叉不被写成已确定的种间关系。

readerLimitations.en:
This page pairs a bilingual guide to selected passages of the 2021 associated-skeleton study with the fixed PBDB occurrence record. The exact specimen locality and horizon remain unknown. The paper calls the geological setting Aptian but labels the systematic horizon Albian; this internal discrepancy is retained rather than harmonized, and PBDB age brackets are not revised. This pass read previously unvisited anatomical subsections and selected headers, relevant taxon rows, character definitions and commands in both official supplements. Original descriptions, images and supplements are not fully assembled or inspected; the specimen, raw CT and matrix were not independently checked, measured or rerun. Diet, flight, sexual dimorphism and maturity remain author interpretations. The guide adds shoulder girdle, forearm, wrist/metacarpus, pelvis, legs/feet and measurement-table coverage, but does not remeasure scans; the Table 4 wing-phalanx side discrepancy remains unresolved and reader-facing delivery is pending. A complete matrix audit and tree rerun are still outstanding, so missing scores and an unresolved branching pattern are not treated as settled species relationships.

Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

readerLimitations.en:
This page summarizes selected PBDB records available on 2026-10-02. It belongs to a fixed 276-entry pterosaur roster and includes species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. PBDB’s accepted name and recorded parent chain organize the entry; they do not resolve specimen identifications or every taxonomic dispute, and same-name Catalogue of Life concepts remain separate. Collection sites, stratigraphic intervals, depositional settings and preservation labels describe different things. They do not establish the species’ complete range, exact origin or extinction, ecology, abundance or the condition of every specimen. The selected records do not form a full review of descriptions, revisions, morphology, diet or behavior.

evidenceSummary:
This page brings together selected findings from the 2023 revision and two PBDB collections. The synonymies and growth interpretations apply to the specimens analyzed; the morphometric sample excludes incomplete BPV-077 and a very young specimen. IVPP V-14377 remains disputed between the 2021 and 2023 assignments. The two database collections are not a complete range or a full species monograph.
