title.zh: 多件头骨共同提供腭部证据
title.en: Several skulls contribute palatal evidence

text.zh: 2020 年研究重新描述旧藏与后来采集的 Dsungaripterus weii 头骨材料，以腭部保存最完整的 IVPP V 4063 为主体，并参照 V 4064、V 4065 及多件头骨和腭部残片。V 4064 保存相连的头骨和下颌，其他材料有不同缺损或压缩。这里的组合描述来自多件标本，不能把所有结构拼成同一个体的完整骨架。
text.en: The 2020 study redescribes earlier and later-collected skull material, primarily using IVPP V 4063 for its well-preserved palate, with V 4064, V 4065 and additional skull or palatal fragments for comparison. V 4064 preserves an articulated skull and mandible; other material has different damage or compression. The combined description draws on several specimens rather than a complete skeleton belonging to one individual.

title.zh: 上翘无齿的前端与后方膨大的齿区
title.en: Upturned toothless tips and an expanded tooth-bearing region

text.zh: 头骨有显著矢状冠，眶较小、位置高；上颌和下颌前端无齿而上翘。后方上颌骨膨大区承载四至五颗牙齿，牙基宽而近椭圆。论文所列头骨大多每侧有十四至十五颗上颌牙，但 V 4065 右侧为十三颗。保存齿数的个体差异不宜压成一个全种固定值，前端无齿也不等于整个口腔无齿。
text.en: The skull has a prominent sagittal crest and relatively small, high-set orbit. The upturned anterior upper and lower jaw tips are toothless. A posterior maxillary expansion bears four or five teeth with broad, roughly oval bases. Most tabulated skulls have fourteen or fifteen upper teeth per side, but V 4065 has thirteen on the right. Observed variation should not become a fixed species-wide count, and toothless tips do not make the entire jaw edentulous.

title.zh: 磨耗与骨形支持硬物取食假说
title.en: Wear and bone shape support a hard-food hypothesis

text.zh: V 26256 的牙齿有平滑磨耗面，配合粗壮牙齿、无齿前端和可能的喙鞘，2020 年作者支持取食硬物的解释。以钳状前端探取或拨出贝类、硬壳昆虫的行为来自此前比较假说，并非直接保存的进食过程。本页没有把它写成确定食谱、专食贝类、实测咬合力或来自所有采集地的统一生态。
text.en: Smooth tooth wear surfaces in V 26256, together with robust teeth, toothless tips and a possible beak covering, support the 2020 authors’ hard-food interpretation. Probing or dislodging shellfish or hard-shelled insects with pincer-like tips comes from earlier comparative hypotheses rather than a preserved feeding event. It does not establish a fixed menu, obligate shellfish diet, measured bite force or common ecology across all collections.

title.zh: 相应的上下颌沟槽可能记录喙鞘边缘
title.en: Corresponding jaw grooves may record a horny sheath

text.zh: 上下颌外侧存在相互对应的沟槽。上颌部分沟槽位于预期骨缝附近，下颌前方沟槽却不能按同样方式解释为骨缝；作者因而提出它们可能留下角质覆盖边缘的印迹。冠基条纹、小孔和沟槽也参与比较。这些骨面迹象支持软组织假说，却没有直接保存完整喙鞘，不能确定其厚度、颜色或全部边界。
text.en: Corresponding grooves run along the outer upper and lower jaws. Some upper grooves lie near expected sutures, whereas the anterior lower groove cannot be interpreted in the same way. The authors therefore propose impressions of a horny covering’s edge, also considering crest-base striae and small foramina. These bone-surface clues do not directly preserve a complete sheath or establish its thickness, color or entire boundary.

title.zh: CT 把表面难辨的骨缝带入内部观察
title.en: CT reveals sutures obscured at the surface

text.zh: 2024 年研究扫描了 V 4063、V 26257 和 V 26258。作者在较厚腭骨内部识别出不规则、相互嵌合的骨缝边界，以区别于裂纹，并用分割重建判断骨的接触关系。这里转述的是论文报告的扫描结果；本页未查看原始切片、操作分割模型或独立核对骨缝。扫描三件材料也不等于覆盖本种所有已知标本。
text.en: The 2024 study scans V 4063, V 26257 and V 26258. Irregular interlocking boundaries inside thick palatal elements distinguish sutures from fractures, and segmented reconstructions identify contacts. This page reports the paper’s findings without inspecting raw slices, operating segmentation models or independently identifying sutures. Three scanned specimens do not cover every known specimen of the species.

title.zh: Y 形腭骨连接多块骨与多个孔窗
title.en: A Y-shaped palatine connects bones and openings

text.zh: 按 2024 年重建，腭骨有两条背腹扁平的分支，形成 Y 形。前支与上颌骨腭突接触，侧支联系腭外缘并向内变薄，与翼骨背面接触；两侧腭骨在后方相接，组成后鼻孔后缘。小腭骨孔位于与翼骨接触区域，因为腹侧受到覆盖，须从后背方向才能观察。此处的 Y 形指腭骨，不是整副下颌的外形。
text.en: In the 2024 reconstruction, two dorsoventrally flat rami form a Y-shaped palatine. The anterior ramus contacts the maxilla’s palatine process. The lateral ramus reaches the outer palate, thins medially and contacts the pterygoid dorsally. The opposing palatines meet posteriorly to form the choanal rear margin. A small palatine foramen at the pterygoid contact is hidden ventrally and visible from behind and above. This Y shape belongs to the palatine rather than the outline of the lower jaw.

title.zh: 旧称翼骨侧突的部分被重新归为外翼骨
title.en: Part of the former lateral pterygoid process becomes ectopterygoid

text.zh: 2020 年描述强调两部分组成的翼骨侧突；2024 年 CT 重建把此前这样命名的结构重新解释为外翼骨。其内侧部分扁平、弯曲并带孔，外侧部分为较细的弧形骨条，与颧骨接触，分隔后腭窗和下颞窗。形状观察与骨归属修订需要分别追溯，不能把新名称当成另一块新增骨或把两篇诊断直接混用。
text.en: The 2020 description emphasizes a two-part lateral pterygoid process. The 2024 CT reconstruction reinterprets the structure previously given that name as the ectopterygoid: an inward flat curved portion with foramina and a slender outer curved bar contacting the jugal and separating the postpalatine and subtemporal openings. Shape observations and revised element identity must be traced separately; the new name does not represent an extra bone.

title.zh: 孔窗名称随参与骨的边界修订
title.en: Opening names change with revised bone boundaries

text.zh: 2024 年把后鼻孔外侧最前方的孔窗称为上颌腭窗，理由是前缘为上颌骨、后缘为腭骨；一些旧描述将它称为 postpalatine fenestra。作者据此调整其后孔窗的名称，并把本种后鼻孔后方的小翼骨孔与其他类群较大的翼骨窗区分。阅读旧图注时，先核对位置和组成骨，避免只凭相同或不同名称比较孔的数目。
text.en: The 2024 paper calls the most anterior opening lateral to the choana the maxillopalatine fenestra because the maxilla borders it anteriorly and the palatine posteriorly; some earlier descriptions called it the postpalatine fenestra. Subsequent opening names are adjusted accordingly, and the species’ small pterygoid foramen is distinguished from larger pterygoid fenestrae in other taxa. Position and bounding bones must be checked before comparing opening counts by name.

title.zh: 头骨融合提供有限的成长线索
title.en: Skull fusion provides limited maturity evidence

text.zh: 2020 年作者因头骨骨块高度融合，将 V 4063 判断为至少亚成体，并转述旧研究对 V 4064 成体及其他标本相对成熟程度的解释。这些判断不提供实际岁数、繁殖状态或完整成长曲线。V 26256 较细的吻部曾被提出可能与性别有关，但没有本页独立性别证据，不能把它列为已经确认的雌性。
text.en: The 2020 authors interpret V 4063 as at least a subadult because its skull elements are strongly fused, while reporting earlier adult and relative-maturity interpretations for other specimens. These do not establish age in years, reproductive status or a complete growth curve. A thinner rostrum in V 26256 was proposed as possibly sex-related, but without independent sex evidence here it is not identified as a confirmed female.

title.zh: 同一地区出现尚不足以确认同层共存
title.en: Regional association does not establish same-horizon coexistence

text.zh: 论文将研究材料置于新疆 Urho–Delunshan 的早白垩世 Tugulu 群，也讨论准噶尔盆地东侧材料。Dsungaripterus 与 Noripterus 在相同地点的记录提示可能共存，但 2020 年作者明确要求进一步野外工作，以查明是否同一层位。当前数据库另有三个采集记录；不能将其与扫描材料逐件对应，也不能直接推导竞争、共食谱或同时死亡。
text.en: The study places its material in the Early Cretaceous Tugulu Group of Urho–Delunshan, Xinjiang, and discusses material from the eastern Junggar Basin. Records of Dsungaripterus and Noripterus at the same localities suggest possible coexistence, but the 2020 authors explicitly call for fieldwork to establish whether they occur in the same horizon. The three selected database collections are not matched individually to scanned specimens and do not establish competition, a shared menu or simultaneous death.

title.zh: 沿骨界修订与 Caupedactylus 对读
title.en: Compare revised bone boundaries with Caupedactylus

text.zh: Caupedactylus ybaka 也参与两篇论文的腭部比较。先看本种真正新扫描的材料，再看 Caupedactylus 从早期图像进入的比较，最后核对两种研究中翼骨孔窗及腭骨归属的措辞。2020 年相似性支持作者所引用的亲缘解释，2024 年着重修订骨界；本页没有重跑系统发育矩阵，也不把腭部相似写成已确定的姐妹群关系。
text.en: Caupedactylus ybaka contributes to both papers’ palatal comparisons. Read the newly scanned Dsungaripterus material first, then Caupedactylus comparisons based on earlier illustrations, and compare pterygoid openings and palatine identities. Similarities in 2020 support the authors’ cited relationship interpretation, while 2024 revises bone boundaries. No matrix was rerun here, and palatal resemblance is not presented as an established sister relationship.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
Dsungaripterus weii 在固定 PBDB 翼龙工作名录中为接受种，数据库父级为 Dsungaripterus。本页导读 3 条可用种级出现记录，涉及 3 个采集记录和 2 个引文编号。出现、采集和引文数量是三个层次，不等同于标本或个体数量。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
Dsungaripterus weii 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:100403。这份存档导读包含 3 条选取的出现记录，关联 3 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 2 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
Dsungaripterus weii is accepted in the fixed PBDB pterosaur working roster, with database parent Dsungaripterus. This guide uses 3 eligible species-level occurrence records from 3 collections and 2 reference identifiers. Occurrences, collections and references are different units, not specimen or individual counts.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Dsungaripterus weii is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:100403. This archived guide contains 3 selected occurrence rows, linked to 3 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 2 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
本页所选出现记录的年代外包区间为 137.05–100.5 Ma，Ma 表示百万年前。这个外界是所选记录早端最大值与晚端最小值的组合，不是所有时刻都有连续记录，也不是直接测得的物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命。每个采集记录保留自己的宽区间；本页未将宽时段压缩成精确标本年龄，未改写原研究的测年解释。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
在这组 PBDB 记录中，最大记录 eag=137.05 Ma，见 occ:487794；最小记录 lag=100.5 Ma，见 occ:487794。这些数值是具名数据库记录的年代界，不代表两者之间存在连续记录，也不是该物种的起源、灭绝或个体寿命日期。每条记录各自的 eag 与 lag 值见上文。
text.en:
Selected occurrences have an outer age envelope of 137.05–100.5 Ma, where Ma denotes millions of years ago. It combines the oldest early bound and youngest late bound among selected records, rather than a continuous record at every time or measured species origin, extinction or individual lifespan. Each collection retains its own age bracket. Broad intervals are not narrowed to precise specimen ages, and original dating interpretations are not revised here.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Across these selected PBDB rows, the largest recorded eag=137.05 Ma in occ:487794; the smallest recorded lag=100.5 Ma in occ:487794. These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh:
Wuerho, IVPP site 64041 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。Wuerho, IVPP site 64045 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。Tatal bonebed 的采集环境标签为 湖泊沉积环境，类型未定（lacustrine indet.）；集合保存方式标签为 实体化石（body）。这些是数据库对采集地和集合的记录，不据沉积环境给本种确定食性或栖地，也不把集合标签当作每件化石的保存描述。来源未填的字段继续为空。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页区分出现记录编号、采集记录编号和材料说明。PBDB 采集记录编号不是单件标本编号。来源行提供的鉴定、材料、丰度及坐标／模型字段照录如下；采集层级的说明不被扩展成对每件化石的断言。

- occ:493241：PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Dsungaripterus weii；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=85.666664，lat=46.099998；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=99.7，pla=40.28。
- occ:829169：PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Dsungaripterus weii；材料说明字段 ocm=GIN125/1010-2, right tibia and fibula; GIN125/1010-3, right wing metacarpal IV; GIN125/1010-4, cervical vertebra 4；丰度字段 abv=1，abu=individuals；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=92.595001，lat=48.758331；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=97.74，pla=43.77。

Wuerho, IVPP site 64041 has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body. Wuerho, IVPP site 64045 has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body. Tatal bonebed has collection-environment label lacustrine indet.; collection preservation-mode label body. These describe database collection settings and assemblages. A depositional setting does not determine this species’ diet or habitat, and an assemblage label does not describe every fossil individually. Unfilled source fields remain unfilled.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
The page keeps occurrence IDs, collection IDs, and material notes distinct. A PBDB collection ID is not an individual specimen ID. title.en: Follow collection records back to references
title.zh: 沿采集记录追到文献

text.zh:
Wuerho, IVPP site 64041 的数据库引文署名为 Young（1973），编号 ref:13383。Wuerho, IVPP site 64045 的数据库引文署名为 Young（1973），编号 ref:13383。Tatal bonebed 的数据库引文署名为 Lü et al.（2009），编号 ref:30777。这些是数据库中录入来源的简略署名，不是已经补齐的完整作者表，也不一定是本种原始描述。完整原行、采集 ID、接受与原鉴定名称和引文 ID 留在独立来源档案中；没有宣称已逐篇复核原论文或标本。

PBDB 出现记录补充:

- occ:829169：记录署名 Lü et al. 2009；PBDB 引文编号 ref:30777。
text.en:
Wuerho, IVPP site 64041 carries database reference attribution Young (1973), identifier ref:13383. Wuerho, IVPP site 64045 carries database reference attribution Young (1973), identifier ref:13383. Tatal bonebed carries database reference attribution Lü et al. (2009), identifier ref:30777. These are abbreviated database source attributions, not completed author lists or necessarily the original species descriptions. Full rows, collection IDs, accepted/original identifications and reference IDs remain in the independent source archive. Individual papers and specimens have not been rereviewed.

scope.en: 2020 anatomy and feeding hypotheses, with 2024 CT palatal reconstruction and reinterpretation; no independent specimen, scan, complete development or distribution review.

readerLimitations.zh:
2020 年与 2024 年研究描述了不同的头骨标本；后来的 CT 解释修订了部分骨界和骨骼身份。保存形态、软组织复原、食性、成熟度、性别及同层共存是不同的推断。数据库出现记录没有与扫描材料逐件对应。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页导读的是 2026-10-02 快照中的 3 条 PBDB 选取出现记录，不是物种专论。地点和年代区间描述的是数据库记录，不能据此推出完整地理分布、连续存在的时间范围、生态、行为或种群大小。采集记录编号、出现记录编号、标本说明及来源明确给出的丰度单位彼此区分。地点坐标字段与古坐标／模型字段仍按不同来源字段保留。所列引文署名不代表已完成全文审读。
readerLimitations.en:
The 2020 and 2024 studies describe different skull specimens; the later CT interpretation revises some bone boundaries and identities. Preserved anatomy, reconstructed soft tissues, diet, maturity, sex and same-horizon coexistence are separate inferences. Database occurrences are not matched specimen by specimen to the scanned material.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 3 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Near the town of Hjoûla located 35 km NNE of Beirut and 10 km inland from Jbail, Lebanon

The Microtuban altivolans specimen was purchased by the SMNK from a fossil dealer with local contacts and thus the exact provenance of the specimen is uncertain and worthy of discussion. The SMNK was initially told that the pterosaur originated from a quarry at Hâqel, although doubts were raised during discussions with another local dealer. We were later informed that this fossil had probably not been removed from the quarry of Hâqel but was likely from the nearby locality of Hjoûla (Roy Nohra, personal communication). As Hjoûla is only ~4 km south of Hâqel it is conceivable that the fossil dealers and middle men were uncertain as to the specimen’s exact provenance. The sediments of Hâqel, however, contain a moderate amount of bioclasts and are noticeably whiter in colouration than those of Hjoûla, which are more micritic. A comparison of the grey limestone slab with other specimens housed at the SMNK leads us to propose the Early Cenomanian locality of Hjoûla as the true provenance of this specimen. This conclusion could be further confirmed by a thin section or petrographic analysis, but these were beyond the scope of this investigation.

readerLimitations.en:
This page summarizes selected PBDB pterosaur occurrences dated 2026-10-02 from the fixed 276-name working roster. Older combinations may appear under database accepted names, but that mapping does not settle specimen identification or every taxonomic dispute. The PBDB parent chain organizes catalogue names; it is separate from COL concepts and phylogenetic trees. Collection location, age, depositional setting and preservation describe database records, not a complete range, exact origin or extinction date, species-wide ecology, abundance or the condition of every fossil.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

This page summarizes PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02 for one name in a fixed set of 276 pterosaur entries. Included rows have a matching current name, a recorded parent path to Pterosauria and a species-level occurrence without an uncertain-identification qualifier. Those rules organize the database; they do not settle the identification of an individual fossil or every taxonomic dispute, and a same-name COL entry is not merged as the same taxonomic concept. Collection site, age, depositional setting and preservation are separate kinds of information. Together they do not give a complete range, exact origin or extinction, species-wide habitat, population size or the preservation state of every specimen. This is a guide to selected records, not a full account of the species biology.

An early Cenomanian age for deposition of the Cambridge Greensand is based on an apparently autochthonous foraminiferan assemblage, but Morter and Wood (1983) could not rule out the possibility of a very late Albian age due to the presence of the bivalve Aucinella. The age of the derived vertebrates is now considered to be no older than the Callihoplites auritus ammonite subzone and most likely no younger than upper Stoliczkaia dispar Zone, and they are thus of late Albian age." (Martill & Unwin 2011, Cretaceous Research, 10.1016/j.cretres.2011.09.003).

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Remanie fauna - reworked from late Albian into early Cenomanian deposits. Faunal assemblage is late Albian in age (age used here). "Although the deposit itself is generally considered to be of late Cretaceous, Cenomanian age, its macrofossil assemblage is thought to be derived largely from the underlying early Cretaceous, Albian, Gault Formation, on the basis of derived ammonites associated with the vertebrate fossils. An early Cenomanian age for deposition of the Cambridge Greensand is based on an apparently autochthonous foraminiferan assemblage, but Morter and Wood (1983) could not rule out the possibility of a very late Albian age due to the presence of the bivalve Aucinella. The age of the derived vertebrates is now considered to be no older than the Callihoplites auritus ammonite subzone and most likely no younger than upper Stoliczkaia dispar Zone, and they are thus of late Albian age." (Martill & Unwin 2011, Cretaceous Research, 10.1016/j.cretres.2011.09.003).

readerLimitations.zh:

readerLimitations.en:
This card summarizes a 2026-10-02 PBDB snapshot within a 276-item pterosaur selection; it is an occurrence guide, not a species monograph. Accepted names and parent paths reproduce database classification: older combinations may map to the accepted name, but the mapping does not settle specimen identifications or every taxonomic dispute and remains separate from same-name COL concepts. Collection ages, environment labels and preservation modes describe database collections. They do not by themselves establish a complete range, first or last appearance, abundance, diet, habitat, behaviour or the condition of every specimen.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh:
采集地记录：Chapada do Araripe [Romualdo Fm.] (general)（Ceará），地区代码 BR，地层名称 Romualdo；年代范围 119.57–113.2 Ma，较早地质时段 Late Aptian。Ma 表示百万年前；这些是数据库目前列出的采集记录，不能据此还原物种的完整分布。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
存档导读包含 1 条出现记录，以下列出全部记录。每个 occ: 编号标识一条出现记录；col: 标识其关联的采集记录。

- 出现记录 occ:851448；PBDB 采集记录 col:92290。 地点字段 cnm=Chapada do Araripe [Romualdo Fm.] (general)；地点分区字段 cc2=BR，stp=Ceará。 记录年代界：eag 119.57 Ma; lag 113.2 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Late Aptian。 地层字段 sfm=Romualdo。 记录署名 Kellner 1984；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32255。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
In recent stratigraphic schemes (e.g. Martill 2007) the Santana Formation and the "Romualdo Member" are essentially synonyms
Santana Formation suggested to be early Albian in age by Heimhofer & Hochuli (2010) on the basis of palynomorphs
Cerqueira et al. 2021:The Romualdo Formation was recently considered as Aptian in age, based on palynomorph, foraminifera and ostracod data (Arai and Assine 2020; Melo et al. 2020).
From Melo et al. 2020: In summary, this integrated study of foraminifera, ostracodes and other microfossil data from the Romualdo Formation indicates that the local Alagoas Stage (Ostracoda Zone RT-011) can now be constrained to the Aptian. Arai and Assine 2020 also support that the Romualdo Formation and Santana Group is entirely Aptian in age.

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
unknown and unspecified localities from the Romualdo Member of the Chapada do Araripe (= Araripe Basin), S Ceará, NE Brazil
text.en:
Recorded collection: Chapada do Araripe [Romualdo Fm.] (general) (Ceará); region code BR; stratum Romualdo; age bracket 119.57–113.2 Ma, older interval Late Aptian. Ma means millions of years ago. These are the collection records represented in this sample, not a complete map of the species range.

evidenceSummary:
This page combines selected observations and models from the 2013 study with one PBDB collection. The “cf.” identification, unknown exact locality, missing bones and comparator-dependent wingspan estimates limit what can be said about this species. The paper’s functional and growth interpretations remain hypotheses from a partial specimen; this account is not a complete monograph.

This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. title.zh: 灰色保存区域与完整重建轮廓
title.en: Grey preserved regions within a complete reconstructed outline

text.zh: 2013 年研究图 1、2 将实存头骨碎片与重建轮廓分开：灰色表示实际保存的骨骼。灰色区域以外的吻端、开孔边缘和牙齿应视为复原，不是完整实存。图 3 展示骨面沟槽，图注把它们解释为血管印痕。沟槽可见，但血管来源和散热功能仍是解释；本页没有按比例尺重新测量。
text.en: Figures 1 and 2 in the 2013 study separate preserved skull fragments from the reconstructed outline: grey marks the bones actually present. Treat the rostral tips, openings and teeth outside those grey areas as reconstructed, not fully preserved. Figure 3 shows surface grooves interpreted in its caption as vascular impressions. The grooves are visible; their vascular origin and proposed cooling role are interpretations. No measurements were taken from the scale bars.

title.zh: 大型标本为何仍用 cf. 限定
title.en: Why the large specimen retains a cf. identification

text.zh: 作者将 MN 6594-V 鉴定为 Tropeognathus cf. T. mesembrinus。颅部相似支持与本种比较，cf. 则表示鉴定仍不确定。头冠差异可能来自成长或个体变异，但论文没有排除其他解释。原正模主要为头部材料，无法提供这件标本的肢骨比例。
text.en: The authors identify MN 6594-V as Tropeognathus cf. T. mesembrinus. The cranial resemblance supports comparison with the species, while cf. signals that the identification is not certain. Crest differences could reflect growth or individual variation, but the study does not exclude other explanations. The holotype is mainly skull material, so it cannot supply limb proportions for this specimen.

title.zh: 结核保存没有恢复确切采集点
title.en: Concretion preservation does not recover the exact collecting site

text.zh: MN 6594-V 的头颅、下颌、脊柱、肩带、胸骨、骨盆及翼部部分骨骼保存在结核中，后肢仅有一根股骨。标本早年由当地居民采集，确切地点未知。结核特征指向 Romualdo 组，作者提出 Santana do Cariri 一带可能是来源。方解石脉、风化和挤压使骨骼错位或变形，吻端也缺失。可能来源不等于精确地点，更不是完整且未变形的骨架。
text.en: MN 6594-V preserves parts of the skull and jaw, spine, shoulder girdle, sternum, pelvis and wings in concretions; only one femur represents the hindlimbs. It was collected earlier by local residents, and its exact site is unknown. Nodule features point to the Romualdo Formation, with the Santana do Cariri area proposed as a likely source. Calcite veins, weathering and compression displaced or deformed bones, and the tip of the snout is missing. A probable source is not a precise locality or a complete, undistorted skeleton.

title.zh: 头冠与牙槽保留形态，功能仍是解释
title.en: Crests and alveoli preserve form while function remains interpretive

text.zh: 比较特征包括前上颌骨冠倾角差异、低而钝的额顶骨冠、枕部方向和腭部隆起。研究把骨面沟槽解释为血管印痕，并讨论其可能的散热作用；血管与体温调节行为都没有直接保存。头部破损也使开孔和牙列不完整，因此可见齿槽不能给出完整牙数或食谱。
text.en: The comparison considers a differently inclined premaxillary crest, a low blunt frontoparietal crest, occipital orientation and a palatal ridge. The study interprets surface grooves as vascular impressions and discusses cooling as a possible function; neither the vessels nor thermoregulatory behaviour are directly preserved. Damage also leaves openings and tooth rows incomplete, so visible tooth sockets do not give a complete tooth count or diet.

title.zh: 身体保存揭示支撑，也留下缺失骨段
title.en: The preserved body records support and missing segments

text.zh: 作者描述十二枚背椎，其中五枚椎体融合成背椎联合体，但部分神经棘仍分离；五枚骶椎与髂骨连接，肩胛—乌喙骨和腕骨系列也已融合。肱骨与前臂骨干不完整，翼掌骨只存近端，骨盆亦残缺。这些结构可用于比较关节和躯干支撑，却不能拼成完整测量的翼骨链或普遍的成长顺序。
text.en: The authors describe twelve dorsal vertebrae. Five centra are fused into a notarium, although some neural spines remain separate; five sacral vertebrae join the ilium, and the scapula–coracoid and carpal series are fused. Humerus and forearm shafts are incomplete, only the near end of the wing metacarpal remains, and the pelvis is partial. These features support comparisons of joints and trunk support, not a fully measured wing or a universal growth sequence.

title.zh: 局部组织学支持接近生长终点
title.en: Sampled histology supports growth approaching cessation

text.zh: 组织学样本取自第一翼指节远端，方解石遮住切片中的部分结构。作者描述外周基础系统、平行环周骨组织和生长标记，并据此推断个体已停止或接近停止生长；部分轴向骨骼仍未融合。一个局部切片不能提供连续的全身成长记录、确切年龄或本种最大成体尺寸。
text.en: Histology comes from the distal end of the first wing phalanx, and calcite obscures some of the section. The authors describe an external fundamental system, parallel circumferential tissue and growth marks, and infer that growth had stopped or was nearly complete. Some axial bones remain unfused. One local sample cannot provide a continuous growth record, an exact age or the species’ maximum adult size.

title.zh: 8.70 米翼展包含比较补全
title.en: The 8.70 m wingspan includes comparative reconstruction

text.zh: 研究根据保存骨端尺寸和其他翼龙的比例补估缺失骨段，再组合翼骨、腕部与肩带长度。论文给出平均约 8.70 m 的“最大翼展”和约 8.26 m 的“正常翼展”；后者使用作者提出的 5% 关节弯曲缩减。二者都是针对标本的模型估值，不是从完整翼尖直接测量，也不是全种最大值。结果受比较对象影响，5% 不是所有翼龙通用的规则。
text.en: The study estimates missing bone lengths from preserved bone ends and proportions in other pterosaurs, then combines wing, wrist and shoulder-girdle measurements. It reports a mean “maximized wingspan” of about 8.70 m and a “normal wingspan” of about 8.26 m, the latter applying a proposed 5% reduction for joint flexion. These are modelled values for the specimen, not spans measured between intact wingtips or a species maximum. Comparator choices affect the result; 5% is not a universal pterosaur rule.

title.zh: 其他大翼骨仍是科级未定材料
title.en: Other large wing bones retain family-level uncertainty

text.zh: 同一研究还讨论 MCT 1838-R（孤立肱骨远端）和 MPSC R 1395（部分左翼）。二者仍鉴定为 Anhangueridae 未定，不能仅因体型大就归为 Tropeognathus mesembrinus。MPSC 标本未融合的翼指伸肌突参与作者对未成熟状态的讨论。这些材料不能拼成理想成体，也不能扩展本种体型范围。
text.en: The same study discusses MCT 1838-R, an isolated distal humerus, and MPSC R 1395, a partial left wing. Both remain indeterminate Anhangueridae rather than becoming Tropeognathus mesembrinus because of their size. An unfused extensor process in the MPSC wing informs the authors’ discussion of immaturity. These pieces cannot be combined into an ideal adult or used to extend this species’ size range.

title.zh: “冈瓦纳最大”保留 2013 年比较范围
title.en: The Gondwana size claim retains its 2013 comparison scope

text.zh: 论文题名中的“冈瓦纳最大飞行爬行动物”只适用于 2013 年论文的材料和比较背景。作者把超过 7.4 m 作为“巨型”的操作性界线，并明确承认界线带有任意性；它不是生物分类群，也不是当前已独立核验的纪录。少数大型发现不能说明种群数量或沿海栖地偏好。
text.en: The 2013 title’s claim of the largest flying reptile from Gondwana belongs to that paper’s material and comparisons. Its “giant” threshold of more than 7.4 m is an explicitly arbitrary working cut-off, not a biological group or a current independently checked record. A few large finds do not reveal population abundance or a coastal habitat preference.

title.zh: 从具名出现转向比较标本
title.en: From named occurrences to comparative specimens

text.zh: 相邻的 PBDB 导读介绍另一条证据路径：一处具名采集地、其年代范围及数据库引文。MN 6594-V 的鉴定带有不确定的 cf.，且确切地点未知，应与该记录分开阅读。可返回 Tropeognathus 查看属级入口和来源链接。本页的比较估值依赖补配骨骼与参照标本。
text.en: The adjacent PBDB guide covers a different evidence route: one named collection, its age bracket and its database citation. MN 6594-V has an uncertain “cf.” identification and no exact locality, so keep it separate from that record. See Tropeognathus for the parent page and source links. Comparative estimates here depend on reconstructed bones and chosen reference specimens.

"Although the deposit itself is generally considered to be of late Cretaceous, Cenomanian age, its macrofossil assemblage is thought to be derived largely from the underlying early Cretaceous, Albian, Gault Formation, on the basis of derived ammonites associated with the vertebrate fossils. The age of the derived vertebrates is now considered to be no older than the Callihoplites auritus ammonite subzone and most likely no younger than upper Stoliczkaia dispar Zone, and they are thus of late Albian age." PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
In recent stratigraphic schemes (e.g. Martill 2007) the Santana Formation and the "Romualdo Member" are essentially synonyms
Santana Formation suggested to be early Albian in age by Heimhofer & Hochuli (2010) on the basis of palynomorphs
Cerqueira et al. 2021:The Romualdo Formation was recently considered as Aptian in age, based on palynomorph, foraminifera and ostracod data (Arai and Assine 2020; Melo et al. 2020).

evidenceSummary:
The skull and jaw are nearly complete, but the rest of the body is not associated and the crest tip is missing. The plant identity and the proposed throat-pouch, ingestion, and death scenario remain interpretations; hyoid anatomy does not preserve a complete tongue or behavior. The reported commercial provenance and one database collection do not establish precise find coordinates or a full species range.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. title.zh: 正模是一件带下颌的头骨
title.en: The type is a skull with a mandible

text.zh: 2003 年命名论文指定 SMNK PAL 3828 为正模，标本藏于德国 Karlsruhe 的 Staatliches Museum für Naturkunde。它是石灰岩板上的近完整头骨与下颌；许多骨骼仍相接，牙齿留在齿槽中，但没有相连的身体骨架可供测量完整比例。化石标本与下方的数据库出现记录是不同单位，不能当作种群数量。
text.en: The 2003 naming paper designates SMNK PAL 3828 as the holotype, held at the Staatliches Museum für Naturkunde Karlsruhe in Germany. It is a nearly complete skull and lower jaw on a limestone slab; many bones remain articulated and teeth sit in their sockets. This specimen does not include an associated body skeleton with complete proportions. The fossil and the database occurrence below are different units, not population counts.

title.zh: 压扁与石材切割限制头冠复原
title.en: Compression and stone cutting limit crest reconstruction

text.zh: 头骨侧向受压并有裂隙，舌骨向右旋转。后部头冠的基部保存下来，但末端在送往博物馆制备之前已于石料场被切除。残存基部显示这里有头冠，却不能还原其完整轮廓或大小；头冠全长、面积、软组织边缘和空气动力学作用都未保存。
text.en: The skull is laterally compressed and fractured, and the hyoid bones are rotated to the right. The base of a crest behind the skull is preserved, but the distal part was cut away at the stone yard before museum preparation. The surviving base shows that a crest was present, but not its full outline or size. It does not preserve the crest's complete length, area, soft-tissue edge, or aerodynamic function.

title.zh: 产地来自商业来源，地层另有支持
title.en: Reported commercial provenance has separate stratigraphic support

text.zh: 原始描述称化石经商业渠道取得，报告来源为巴西 Ceará 的 Nova Olinda 附近采石场。作者以石灰岩基质和岩板上的小型 Dastilbe 鱼类支持其属于 Crato Formation 的 Nova Olinda Member，并保留 Aptian 年代解释。作者没有在现场逐层发掘记录。数据库的采集地名称与年代范围不能提供精确坐标或单件化石的年龄。
text.en: The original description says the fossil came through a commercial source, with quarries near Nova Olinda in Ceará, Brazil, reported as its origin. The authors use the limestone and a small Dastilbe fish on the slab to support assignment to the Nova Olinda Member of the Crato Formation and retain an Aptian age interpretation. The site was not documented by the authors through excavation layer by layer. The database collection name and age bracket do not supply exact coordinates or an individual fossil's age.

title.zh: 后方向头冠与牙齿同时存在
title.en: A posterior crest occurs together with teeth

text.zh: 原始描述指出头骨后方有一枚向后延伸、侧向扁平的头冠；吻部上缘圆弧状，没有吻部上方的头冠。颌前端的牙齿较大且弯曲，后方的牙齿较小。这些牙齿使它与 Pteranodon 只是部分外形相似，不能据此称为无齿翼龙。作者还比较泪骨向眼眶内突出的结构和其他头骨开孔。单凭这些特征不能确定性别、食性、飞行方式或完整亲缘树。
text.en: The description notes a crest behind the skull that points backward and is flattened from side to side. The upper surface of the snout is rounded and lacks a crest above the snout; larger, curved teeth occur toward the front of the jaws and smaller ones farther back. That dentition makes resemblance to Pteranodon only a partial shape comparison, not an identification as a toothless pterosaur. The authors also compare a projection of the lacrimal bone into the eye socket and other skull openings. These features alone do not establish sex, diet, flight mode, or a complete family tree.

title.zh: 颌间叶片没有被鉴定为 Yucca
title.en: The leaf between the jaws is not identified as Yucca

text.zh: 一片细长、渐尖且有粗大平行纤维的叶子位于两支下颌之间，叶片下端受损并散开。原作者将它与现生 Cordyline、Yucca 和 Agave 的叶子作比较，同时指出这种化石形态尚未正式描述。相似性不是植物分类鉴定，也不能证明 Ludodactylus 经常吃叶子或完整还原古代植物群落。
text.en: A long, tapering leaf with coarse parallel fibers lies between the two lower-jaw branches. Its lower end is damaged and frayed. The original authors compare it with leaves of living Cordyline, Yucca, and Agave, while noting that the fossil form had not been formally described. Similarity is not a botanical identification and does not show that Ludodactylus routinely ate leaves or reveal the full ancient plant community.

title.zh: 误吞与死亡经过保留为解释
title.en: Accidental ingestion and the death sequence remain interpretations

text.zh: 作者提出叶片可能被误当成猎物，卡在软组织或可能存在的喉囊中；他们把叶片散开解释为尝试移除时造成的损伤。作者以鹈鹕夹住异物作类比，并讨论无法进食、衰弱或感染等可能后果。叶片的位置和损伤是观察所得，但误吞、喉囊、饥饿和败血症并未直接保存在化石中；这段推测不能当作已确认死因。
text.en: The authors suggest the leaf may have been mistaken for prey and lodged in soft tissue or a possible throat pouch; they interpret the fraying as damage from attempts to remove it. They compare this idea with debris trapped by pelicans and discuss possible consequences such as being unable to feed, weakness, or infection. The leaf's position and damage are observations, but ingestion, a pouch, starvation, and sepsis are not directly preserved. The proposed sequence is not a confirmed cause of death.

title.zh: 舌骨比较支持功能推断，不是保存的舌头
title.en: Hyoid comparisons inform function without preserving a tongue

text.zh: Li、Zhou 与 Clarke 于 2018 年发表的研究，将 Ludodactylus 列为角鳃骨较长的翼龙例子。补充表 S1 指向同一正模 SMNK PAL 3828 及 Frey 等人在 2003 年的描述。作者通过现生动物的骨骼、肌肉和功能比较讨论舌部运动假说；现生鸟类和鳄类的 CT 图像不是本化石保存下来的肌肉。舌骨形态可以约束解释，但不能显示完整舌长、活动范围、吞咽行为或特定猎物。
text.en: A 2018 study by Li, Zhou, and Clarke includes Ludodactylus among pterosaurs with elongated ceratobranchial bones. Its supplementary table S1 refers to the same holotype, SMNK PAL 3828, and the 2003 description by Frey and colleagues. Comparisons of bones, muscles, and function in living animals inform hypotheses about tongue movement. CT images of living birds and crocodilians are not preserved muscles in this fossil. The hyoids constrain interpretation but do not reveal full tongue length, movement range, swallowing behavior, or specific prey.

头骨与下颌近乎完整，但没有相连的身体骨架，头冠末端也已缺失。叶片植物身份以及喉囊、误吞和死因叙述仍属解释；舌骨不能保存完整舌头或行为。报告的商业来源和一个数据库采集记录不能确定精确发现坐标或物种完整分布。

readerLimitations.en:
The skull and jaw are nearly complete, but the rest of the body is not associated and the crest tip is missing. The plant identity and the proposed throat-pouch, ingestion, and death scenario remain interpretations; hyoid anatomy does not preserve a complete tongue or behavior. The reported commercial provenance and one database collection do not establish precise find coordinates or a full species range.

Remanie fauna - reworked from late Albian into early Cenomanian deposits. Faunal assemblage is late Albian in age (age used here). "Although the deposit itself is generally considered to be of late Cretaceous, Cenomanian age, its macrofossil assemblage is thought to be derived largely from the underlying early Cretaceous, Albian, Gault Formation, on the basis of derived ammonites associated with the vertebrate fossils. An early Cenomanian age for deposition of the Cambridge Greensand is based on an apparently autochthonous foraminiferan assemblage, but Morter and Wood (1983) could not rule out the possibility of a very late Albian age due to the presence of the bivalve Aucinella. The age of the derived vertebrates is now considered to be no older than the Callihoplites auritus ammonite subzone and most likely no younger than upper Stoliczkaia dispar Zone, and they are thus of late Albian age." (Martill & Unwin 2011, Cretaceous Research, 10.1016/j.cretres.2011.09.003).

unknown and unspecified localities from the Romualdo Member of the Chapada do Araripe (= Araripe Basin), S Ceará, NE Brazil

"Near Santana do Cariri, Ceara State"; exact site(s) not recorded (mostly private collectors), but all materials believed to come from outcrops close to this city

Near the town of Hjoûla located 35 km NNE of Beirut and 10 km inland from Jbail, Lebanon

The Microtuban altivolans specimen was purchased by the SMNK from a fossil dealer with local contacts and thus the exact provenance of the specimen is uncertain and worthy of discussion. The SMNK was initially told that the pterosaur originated from a quarry at Hâqel, although doubts were raised during discussions with another local dealer. We were later informed that this fossil had probably not been removed from the quarry of Hâqel but was likely from the nearby locality of Hjoûla (Roy Nohra, personal communication). As Hjoûla is only ~4 km south of Hâqel it is conceivable that the fossil dealers and middle men were uncertain as to the specimen’s exact provenance. The sediments of Hâqel, however, contain a moderate amount of bioclasts and are noticeably whiter in colouration than those of Hjoûla, which are more micritic. A comparison of the grey limestone slab with other specimens housed at the SMNK leads us to propose the Early Cenomanian locality of Hjoûla as the true provenance of this specimen. This conclusion could be further confirmed by a thin section or petrographic analysis, but these were beyond the scope of this investigation.

Those rules organize the database; they do not settle the identification of an individual fossil or every taxonomic dispute, and a same-name COL entry is not merged as the same taxonomic concept. Collection site, age, depositional setting and preservation are separate kinds of information. Together they do not give a complete range, exact origin or extinction, species-wide habitat, population size or the preservation state of every specimen. This is a guide to selected records, not a full account of the species biology.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh:
本页的出现记录落在一个采集地：采集记录 Daxishan, Linglongta（Liaoning），地区代码 CN，地层名称 Tiaojishan；数据库年代范围 168.2–152.21 Ma，早端地质时段 Late Bathonian、晚端时段 Early Kimmeridgian。 地点与地层名保留来源写法。一处记录是出现证据，不是完整分布，也不能说明其他地方没有本种。

PBDB 出现记录补充:

- 出现记录 occ:920390；PBDB 采集记录 col:92421。 地点字段 cnm=Daxishan, Linglongta；地点分区字段 cc2=CN，stp=Liaoning，cny=Jianchang。 记录年代界：eag 168.2 Ma; lag 152.21 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Late Bathonian，oli=Early Kimmeridgian。 地层字段 sfm=Tiaojishan，sls=Linglongta，slb=13，slo=bottom to top。 记录署名 Lü and Fucha 2010；PBDB 引文编号 ref:35167。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Wang et al. (2009) referred to this locality as from the Daohugou Formation (?Late Jurassic-Early Cretaceous), while Lü et al. (2009) suggested that it is the Tiaojishan Formation (Middle Jurassic).

"The Tiaojishan Formation is generally regarded as Middle (Zhang & Zheng 1991; Liu et al. 2006; Cheng & Li 2007) to Upper Jurassic (Chang et al. 2009) (Late Bathonian-Early Kimmeridgian) in age, although it may date to the early Middle Jurassic (Aalenian) in Jianchang County (Davis et al. 2001). The unit has been dated using radiometric techniques at 169-152 Mya by Liu et al. (2006) and 165-156 Mya by Zhang et al. (2008)." (Lü et al. 2010: supplement)

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Daxishan fossil site, Longlongta town, Jianchang county; section extends from 40° 51' 45" N, 119° 59' 59" E (240 m asl) to 40° 52' 20" N, 119° 59' 03" E (309m asl).
text.en:
The selected PBDB occurrence is anchored in one collection: Collection Daxishan, Linglongta (Liaoning), region code CN, stratum name Tiaojishan; database age bracket 168.2–152.21 Ma, early interval Late Bathonian and late interval Early Kimmeridgian. Read the locality and stratum as source labels. One recorded place is a positive occurrence, not a complete range or evidence that the animal was absent elsewhere.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh:

text.en:

These are collection-level depositional and preservation labels. They help describe the fossil context, but do not determine the living animal’s diet or habitat, and do not mean every specimen preserves every listed feature. Empty source fields remain empty.

"Although the deposit itself is generally considered to be of late Cretaceous, Cenomanian age, its macrofossil assemblage is thought to be derived largely from the underlying early Cretaceous, Albian, Gault Formation, on the basis of derived ammonites associated with the vertebrate fossils. The age of the derived vertebrates is now considered to be no older than the Callihoplites auritus ammonite subzone and most likely no younger than upper Stoliczkaia dispar Zone, and they are thus of late Albian age." - 出现记录 occ:826860；PBDB 采集记录 col:67611。 地点字段 cnm=Baicaigou, Toutai；地点分区字段 cc2=CN，stp=Liaoning，cny=Yixian。 记录年代界：eag 125.77 Ma; lag 119.57 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Late Barremian，oli=Early Aptian。 地层字段 sfm=Yixian。 记录署名 Andres and Ji 2006；PBDB 引文编号 ref:28404。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
middle part of formation, originally assigned to Yixian Fm., comparable to Dawangzhangzi Bed. "middle part" of formation.
The Yixian Formation can be subdivided into five units, in ascending order, Lujiatun unit, Lower Lava, Jianshangou unit, Upper Lava, Dawangzhangzi unit, Jingangshan unit, and Huanghuashan unit. Most of the Jehol fossils from the Yixian Formation are preserved in four beds, that is, the Lujiatun bed (recalculated age is 124.0 ± 1.0/1.3 Ma, He et al., 2006), the Jianshangou bed (125.43 ± 0.50/0.88 Ma, Swisher et al., 1999), the Dawangzhangzi bed, and Jinggangshan bed (~122 Ma, Smith et al., 1995).U-Pb dating suggests that the Huangbanjigou section ranges from 124.9 ± 1.7 Ma to 122.8 ± 1.6 Ma (Yang et al., 2007). Chang et al. (2017) obtained Ar/Ar ages of 125.8 ± 1.0 Ma and 126.0 ± 0.8 Ma from the Lujiatun Unit, the lowest part of the Yixian Formation, below the lacustrine shales.
He et al. (2004) reported a 40Ar/39Ar age of 120.3 ± 0.7 Ma for a tuff layer in the lower part of the Jiufotang Formation, and Chang et al. (2009) obtained a 40Ar/39Ar age of 122.1 ± 0.3 Ma for a tuff layer from the lowermost part of the Jiufotang Formation. Yu et al. (2021) dated an ash bed just above the Yixian/Jiufotang formation boundary to 122.0 ± 0.9 Ma and three tuff beds from the Xiaotaizi section  to 118.9 ± 0.8 Ma, 118.8 ± 0.6 Ma, and 118.6 ± 1.1 Ma. These ages suggest that the Jiufotang Formation in Jianchang Basin was deposited at ca. 122.0–118.9 Ma.
Olierrok et al. (2019) used a selection of U-Pb and 40Ar-39Ar geochronology to place the Barremian–Aptian boundary (the base of the Chron M0r) between 123.8 and 121.8 Ma. The GTS 2020 uses an age of 121.4 Ma for the base of the Aptian, and multiproxy orbital tuning gives an age of 120.2 Ma for the Barremian-Aptian boundary (Leandro et al., 2022). Therefore, the Yixian Formation should be entirely Late Barremian, with the Jiufotang Formation deposited in the Early Aptian (or latest Barremian at its base).

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Baicaigou (= Baitaigou), Toutai, approx. 11 km N of Yizhou, Jinzhou region, western Liaoning; Jinzhou city, Yixian county
text.en:
Collection Baicaigou, Toutai (Liaoning), region code CN, stratum name Yixian; database age bracket 125.77–119.57 Ma, early interval Late Barremian and late interval Early Aptian. Together they do not give a complete range, exact origin or extinction, species-wide habitat, population size or the preservation state of every specimen. PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
"The palynological assemblage recovered from the matrix surrounding SMU 76476 contains two taxa (Tanyosphaeridium salpinx and Catastomocystis spinosa) that have last occurrences in the Turonian and two taxa (Dinogymnium acuminatum and Dinogymnium euclaense) that have first occurrences in the Coniacian. Pre-Coniacian reports (Londeix et al., 1996; Zippi, personal commun., 2009) of both D. acuminatum and D. euclaense initially suggested a likely Turonian age for SMU 76476, but the fissile, dark gray shales of the Turonian Eagle Ford Group north of Dallas are inconsistent with the matrix lithology. The limestone matrix surrounding SMU 76476 is consistent with the chalk deposits of the lower part of the Austin Group (Fig. 1), so T. salpinx and C. spinosa are interpreted as reworked from the underlying Eagle Ford Group. Given the presence of reworked Turonian taxa in the matrix, SMU 76476 must be derived from the basal Atco Formation within the Austin Group."

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
"SMU 76476...was donated to the Shuler Museum without detailed information regarding provenance. The specimen was collected northwest of Dallas, from southwestern Collin County, southeastern Denton County, or northern Dallas County." Coordinates based on junction between these three counties. But "the locality is probably SMU Loc. 468 is southwestern Collin County."

"The palynological assemblage recovered from the matrix surrounding SMU 76476 contains two taxa (Tanyosphaeridium salpinx and Catastomocystis spinosa) that have last occurrences in the Turonian and two taxa (Dinogymnium acuminatum and Dinogymnium euclaense) that have first occurrences in the Coniacian. Given the presence of reworked Turonian taxa in the matrix, SMU 76476 must be derived from the basal Atco Formation within the Austin Group."

uppermost Zorzino Limestone (Calcare di Zorzino); uppermost Alaunian on the basis of palynomorphs; most specimens collected from a single 15 cm thick bed 20-30 m below the overlying Argilliti di Riva di Solta

material from a sequence of 3 levels, each bearing bones. Unclear which fossils are from which layers. Uppermost part of the Zorzino Limestones (Calcare di Zorzino) of latest Alaunian age (dated by palynomorphs)

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Endenna cave, in the Bergamo Prealps, Bergamasco, Italy. Coordinates for Bergamo.

Older information: "possible dates [range] from Middle Jurassic to Early Cretaceous. However, published radioisotopic [both 40Ar/39Ar and zircon U-Pb] dating results span... 152 to 168 Myr" = Bathonian to Kimmeridgian (Zhang et al. 2008). Also referred to as Haifanggou Formation

"Several recent isotope datings, using both 40 Ar/39Ar and SHRIMP U-Pb methods, have indicated that the age of the (underlying) ignimbrite is between the late Middle Jurassic and early Late Jurassic, or 159-164 Ma. Age is therefore constrained to Callovian-Barremian

readerLimitations.zh:
本页整理 2026-10-02 的 PBDB 翼龙出现记录，属于选定记录导读，不是完整物种专论。条目沿用数据库接受名与父级路径，并纳入没有不确定鉴定限定词的可用种级记录。PBDB 对旧名称的链接不能裁决标本鉴定或全部分类争议，也不等于与 COL 同名概念合并。采集地点、地层年代、沉积环境和采集层级保存方式是不同字段；它们本身不能确立完整分布、真实起源或灭绝时间、固定生态、生物数量或每件标本的保存状态。

readerLimitations.en:
This page summarizes selected pterosaur occurrences in a PBDB snapshot dated 2026-10-02; it is not a complete species monograph. The records use the database accepted name and parent path and include usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. A PBDB link to an older name does not settle specimen identification or all taxonomic disputes, and it does not merge the record with a same-named COL concept. Collection locality, stratigraphic interval, depositional setting, and collection-level preservation mode are distinct fields. They do not by themselves establish a complete range, true origin or extinction time, fixed ecology, abundance, or the preservation of every specimen.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 1 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata

text.zh:
采集地记录：Cene, Seriana Valley（Lombardia），地区代码 IT，地层名称 Zorzino Limestone；年代范围 215.38–211.18 Ma，较早地质时段 Alaunian。Ma 表示百万年前；这些是数据库目前列出的采集记录，不能据此还原物种的完整分布。

PBDB 出现记录补充:

- 出现记录 occ:846846；PBDB 采集记录 col:59639。 地点字段 cnm=Cene, Seriana Valley；地点分区字段 cc2=IT，stp=Lombardia，cny=Bergamo。 记录年代界：eag 215.38 Ma; lag 211.18 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Alaunian。 地层字段 sfm=Zorzino Limestone。 记录署名 Wild 1978；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32009。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
uppermost Zorzino Limestone (Calcare di Zorzino); uppermost Alaunian on the basis of palynomorphs; most specimens collected from a single 15 cm thick bed 20-30 m below the overlying Argilliti di Riva di Solta

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
quarry on the slope of Monte Bo, close to the small town of Cene, Seriana Valley, Bergamo. Coordinates are for Cene.
text.en:
Recorded collection: Cene, Seriana Valley (Lombardia); region code IT; stratum Zorzino Limestone; age bracket 215.38–211.18 Ma, older interval Alaunian. Ma means millions of years ago. These are the collection records represented in this sample, not a complete map of the species range.

text.en:

These are collection-level labels and assemblage summaries, not descriptions of every fossil. A collection setting alone cannot establish the species’ diet or habitat or show how every specimen was preserved.

Where the source row supplies them, its identification, material, abundance, and coordinate/model fields are transcribed below without turning a collection-level note into a claim about every fossil.

- occ:846846: PBDB original-identification field idn=Peteinosaurus zambelli n. gen. n. sp.; PBDB taxon-name field tna=Peteinosaurus zambelli; material note ocm=MCSNB 2886 (holotype), partial skeleton. MCSNB 3496, partial skeleton; abundance fields abv=2, abu=specimens; PBDB locality-coordinate fields lng=9.817000, lat=45.783001; paleocoordinate/model fields pm1=gplates, pln=28.02, pla=22.45.

None alone establishes a complete range, exact origin or extinction, abundance, habitat, diet or the condition of every specimen. The selected record does not provide a complete anatomical or behavioral account.

title.zh: 正模由三块相连骨板组成
title.en: Three adjoining blocks preserve the holotype

text.zh: 正模 NHMUK PV R37110 保存在三块相邻围岩中，含肩带、翼和后肢材料。七枚椎骨中有两枚无法可靠识别。缺失骨骼即使出现在复原中，也仍是复原部分，不是标本里保存的化石。
text.en: The holotype NHMUK PV R37110 lies in three adjoining blocks and preserves shoulder, wing and hindlimb material. Of the seven vertebrae, two cannot be identified with confidence. Any reconstructed missing bones remain reconstructions, not fossils in the blocks.

title.zh: 扫描显露仍包在围岩中的骨骼
title.en: Scanning reveals bones still embedded in matrix

text.zh: 微型 CT 使作者能够分割仍埋在围岩中的骨骼。数字处理让这些隐藏结构可见，但不能补出从未保存的解剖部位。
text.en: Micro-CT lets researchers segment bones still embedded in the rock. Digital preparation makes those hidden parts visible; it cannot restore anatomy that was never preserved.

title.zh: 诊断集中于胸带与骨盆
title.en: Diagnosis focuses on shoulder and pelvis

text.zh: Ceoptera 的鉴别依据包括乌喙骨上的波状骨翼，以及髂骨后部被低嵴分隔的凹陷。这些结构用于诊断所描述的材料，不能据此判断食性。
text.en: Ceoptera is diagnosed by a wavy flange on the coracoid and a depression at the back of the ilium divided by a low ridge. These anatomical features distinguish the described material; they do not reveal its diet.

title.zh: 达尔文翼龙类结果仍有支持边界
title.en: Darwinopteran placement retains support limits

text.zh: 系统分析支持达尔文翼龙类为单系，但支持度中低，Ceoptera 附近的关系也缺乏分辨率。目录中的父级路径用于编排名称，并非新的系统发育分析。
text.en: The study’s analysis supports a monophyletic Darwinoptera, but with moderate-to-low support and poor resolution around Ceoptera. The catalogue’s parent path organizes the name; it is not a new phylogenetic analysis.

overview: The holotype, NMS G.2021.6.1–4, comes from the Upper Lonfearn Member of the Lealt Shale Formation on Scotland’s Isle of Skye. The 2025 study describes one associated skeleton divided among a main slab, a skull block, a ventral counterslab and a separate wing-phalanx block. It preserves delicate palate, hyoid and braincase bones, a complete neck series and a particularly clear right hand. The back vertebrae and ribs are scattered; the pelvis, tail and hindlimbs are poorly preserved. Hard limestone still hides many surfaces, even where the bones retain three-dimensional form.

evidenceSummary:
The anatomical account here summarizes selected sections of the 2025 study rather than a complete monograph. It does not cover every structure or original image, nor the full 2022 description, including its wingspan regressions and histology. Muscle use, feeding and climbing are interpretations drawn from bones, teeth and comparisons; they are not direct records of behavior. This material also does not establish Dearc’s life history or settle its placement among pterosaurs.

title.en: One skeleton preserved across four blocks

text.zh: Dearc sgiathanach 正模 NMS G.2021.6.1–4 出自苏格兰斯凯岛 Lealt Shale Formation 的 Upper Lonfearn Member。2025 年研究描述的同一关联骨架分在主骨板、头骨块、腹面对应板和单独的翼指节块中。腭部、舌骨和脑颅骨等细小结构仍可辨认，颈椎完整，右手保存尤其清楚。背椎与肋骨已散开，骨盆、尾部和后肢保存较差；硬石灰岩还遮挡不少骨面，即使骨骼仍有三维形态，也无法观察身体每处。
text.en: The holotype, NMS G.2021.6.1–4, comes from the Upper Lonfearn Member of the Lealt Shale Formation on Scotland’s Isle of Skye. The 2025 study describes one associated skeleton divided among a main slab, a skull block, a ventral counterslab and a separate wing-phalanx block. It preserves delicate palate, hyoid and braincase bones, a complete neck series and a particularly clear right hand. The back vertebrae and ribs are scattered; the pelvis, tail and hindlimbs are poorly preserved. Hard limestone still hides many surfaces, even where the bones retain three-dimensional form.

title.zh: CT 可见空腔，肌肉位置仍需推断
title.en: CT reveals cavities; muscles must be inferred

text.zh: 作者对分离的头骨块进行微 CT 扫描，再手动勾画内部空间。吻部骨骼与围岩对比清楚，头骨后段对比度较低、边界更难描出；脑腔和内耳空腔则较清楚。肌肉位置来自另一种推断：作者比较骨嵴、凹陷和表面纹理与现生鳄类、鸟类的对应关系。CT 可显示空腔，但肌肉布置仍是复原，化石没有保留活动肌肉，也未直接记录飞行。
text.en: Micro-CT scans of the detached skull block reveal internal spaces that were then outlined by hand. Bone and surrounding rock contrast clearly in the snout but less clearly at the rear of the skull, so those boundaries are harder to trace; the brain and inner-ear cavities are more distinct. Muscle positions come from a separate step: the authors compare ridges, hollows and surface textures with crocodilians and birds. The cavities are visible in the scan, but the muscle arrangement is a reconstruction, not preserved tissue or a record of flight.

title.zh: 牙齿磨损留下不止一种食性可能
title.en: Tooth wear leaves more than one feeding possibility

text.zh: Dearc 前端牙齿较长、向后弯曲，后部牙齿短直，横截面近似棱柱。前牙受侵蚀较重，部分仅存牙根或中段；几颗后牙可见牙冠缺损、釉质裂纹和剥落。作者将其与 Dorygnathus 等翼龙比较，提出它可能处理较硬的猎物；前牙交错也可能有助于抓鱼。但骨架没有胃内容物或猎物遗骸，这些牙齿不能确定它只吃鱼，也不能给出各类食物的比例。
text.en: Dearc has longer, recurved teeth at the front of the jaws and shorter, straight, prism-shaped teeth behind them. Erosion has removed much of some front teeth, leaving roots or middle sections; several rear crowns are chipped, cracked or flaked. By comparing the teeth with Dorygnathus and other pterosaurs, the authors suggest Dearc could handle relatively hard prey. They also propose that the overlapping front teeth may have helped seize fish. No meal is preserved with the skeleton, so neither idea fixes its diet or the share of fish it ate.

title.zh: 胸骨与上臂嵴有助辨认 Dearc
title.en: The sternum and upper-arm crests help identify Dearc

text.zh: 2025 年研究提出两项可区分 Dearc 的特征：三角胸肌嵴向肩端逐渐变宽，并高于尺侧嵴；胸骨前缘向前突出。胸骨薄而宽，后部可能尚未完全骨化。其他翼龙的胸骨保存较差，能作的比较有限。左右肱骨露出的方向不同，且有局部压扁和裂缝；曲度差异不足以证明活体左右不对称。骨嵴有助分类并可与肌肉附着位置比较，却不能直接测出肌肉大小或拍翼力量。
text.en: The 2025 study identifies two proposed distinguishing features: a deltopectoral crest that widens toward the shoulder and rises above the ulnar crest, and a sternum whose front edge projects forward. The sternum is broad and thin; its rear may not have finished ossifying. Few other pterosaur sterna are well enough preserved for a strong comparison. The two upper arms are exposed differently and show local flattening and fractures, so their differing curves do not establish asymmetry in life. These bone shapes help with identification and attachment comparisons, but do not measure muscle size or wing power.

title.zh: 骨面标记提示一种可能的飞行肌肉模式
title.en: Bone landmarks suggest a possible flight-muscle pattern

text.zh: 作者把扩大的三角胸肌嵴与胸肌附着联系起来，并把上臂其他痕迹与背阔肌、喙肱肌的附着点相比。据此，他们提出 Dearc 飞行时可能较多以内收、前伸上臂为动作。Dearc 与 Rhamphorhynchus 的区别提示，相近体型翼龙的拍翼方式未必相同。这仍是待检验的假说：肩带与手部骨骼不完整，体型影响、共同祖先和趋同演化也难区分；未来的肌骨模型可以检验这种解释。
text.en: The authors link the enlarged deltopectoral crest to the pectoralis muscle and compare other marks on the upper arm with attachment sites for latissimus dorsi and coracobrachialis. From this pattern they propose that Dearc may have drawn its upper arm inward and forward during flight. Differences from Rhamphorhynchus suggest that similarly sized pterosaurs need not have moved their wings in the same way. This remains a working hypothesis: the shoulder girdle and hand bones are incomplete, and body size, shared ancestry and convergent evolution are hard to separate. A future muscle-and-skeleton model could test the proposal.

title.zh: 弯曲的手爪或有助抓握
title.en: Curved hand claws may have helped with grasping

text.zh: 右手第一至第三指完整，支持翼面的第四指只保存部分。指端爪骨有发达的屈肌附着面和相关籽骨。作者把其二维曲度与攀爬、栖枝鸟类比较，提出抓握或攀爬的可能，也不排除辅助捕食。爪骨只是外覆角质爪的骨芯，鸟类的使用方式也不是 Dearc 的行为记录；它是否常攀爬、攀爬什么表面或用爪捕食，都没有直接证据。论文给出的爪长数字与后文“第三爪最长”的说法不一致，因此本页不排列爪长。
text.en: The right hand preserves digits I–III; only part of the elongated fourth, wing-supporting digit remains. The terminal claw bones have strong flexor attachment areas and associated sesamoid bones. Their curvature, compared in two dimensions with that of climbing and perching birds, leads the authors to suggest a role in grasping or climbing, perhaps with an additional role in catching prey. A claw bone is only the bony core of a keratin-covered claw, and bird comparisons cannot show what Dearc did. How often it climbed, what it might have climbed on, and whether its claws caught prey remain unknown. Because the study’s reported lengths conflict with its later ranking of the third claw as longest, this page does not rank them by size.

title.zh: 论文提出了不同的科级位置
title.en: The published family placements differ

text.zh: 2025 年论文采用 2022 年描述提出的 Angustinaripterini 分组；同时提到另一项纳入 Skiphosoura 的分析将 Dearc 放在更接近 Monofenestrata 的位置。较长颈椎等特征，可能来自不同身体模块以不同速度演化，也可能是体型相关的趋同。“过渡型”并不能证明 Dearc 是其他翼龙的直接祖先。PBDB 接受名层级用于数据库资料编排；科级亲缘方案仍分别归于各自研究。
text.en: The 2025 paper uses the Angustinaripterini grouping introduced in the 2022 description. It also notes a different analysis, which includes Skiphosoura, placing Dearc nearer to Monofenestrata. Its relatively long neck and other traits could reflect different body regions evolving at different rates or convergence linked to size. Calling Dearc “transitional” does not make it a demonstrated ancestor. The database’s accepted-name hierarchy is a record-keeping path; these competing family-level placements remain attributed to their respective studies.

evidenceSummary:
This page summarizes PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02 for one name in a fixed set of 276 pterosaur entries. Included rows have a matching current name, a recorded parent path to Pterosauria and a species-level occurrence without an uncertain-identification qualifier. Those rules organize the database; they do not settle the identification of an individual fossil or every taxonomic dispute, and a same-name COL entry is not merged as the same taxonomic concept. Collection site, age, depositional setting and preservation are separate kinds of information. Together they do not give a complete range, exact origin or extinction, species-wide habitat, population size or the preservation state of every specimen. This is a guide to selected records, not a full account of the species biology.

title.en: Which fossil records this name represents
title.zh: 这个名称对应哪些化石记录

text.zh:
在所选 PBDB 翼龙记录中，Rhamphorhynchus muensteri 列在数据库父级 Rhamphorhynchus 之下。本组资料含 14 条种级出现记录，来自 11 个采集记录，并关联 4 个引文编号。出现记录、采集记录和引文数分别统计不同对象，不能据此判断化石或个体多寡。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
Rhamphorhynchus muensteri 在 PBDB 快照中对应分类条目 txn:95812。这份存档导读包含 14 条选取的出现记录，关联 11 个不同的 PBDB 采集记录编号和 4 个不同的 PBDB 引文编号。出现记录与采集记录是不同单位；这两个数量都不等于标本数或个体数。此页聚焦一个具体问题：这些记录各自连到哪些地点、年代界、材料说明和引文？
text.en:
Rhamphorhynchus muensteri appears under the database parent Rhamphorhynchus in the selected PBDB pterosaur records. The set contains 14 occurrence records, drawn from 11 collections and linked to 4 reference identifiers. These counts describe database records, collection groups and citations; they do not measure the number of fossils or animals.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Rhamphorhynchus muensteri is listed in the PBDB snapshot under taxon txn:95812. This archived guide contains 14 selected occurrence rows, linked to 11 distinct PBDB collection IDs and 4 distinct PBDB reference IDs. An occurrence row and a collection record are different units; neither count is a specimen or individual count. The reading question here is concrete: which recorded localities, age bounds, material notes, and citations are attached to these rows?

title.en: Begin with named collections and strata
title.zh: 从具名采集地和地层开始

text.zh:
所选出现记录指向以下采集地：
- Solnhofen (Uppsala Collection)（Bavaria）（地区代码 DE），地层名为 Solnhofen；年代范围为 149.2–145.06 Ma，早端为 Early Tithonian。
- Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection)（Bayern）（地区代码 DE），地层名为 Solnhofener Plattenkalk；年代范围为 149.2–145.06 Ma，早端为 Early Tithonian。
- Compsognathus type, Kapfelberg (BSP)（Bayern）（地区代码 DE），地层名为 Painten；年代范围为 152.21–149.2 Ma，早端为 Late Kimmeridgian。
这些是已记录的发现地点，不是物种完整分布图；名称和年代范围按来源保留。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
存档导读包含 14 条出现记录。此页突出显示至多三条：先列出承载最大 eag／最小 lag 年代界的记录，若有空位再列一条来源响应中的记录。完整来源行仍保存在档案中；下方不是全部记录清单。

- 出现记录 occ:849634；PBDB 采集记录 col:57682。 地点字段 cnm=Compsognathus type, Kapfelberg (BSP)；地点分区字段 cc2=DE，stp=Bayern。 记录年代界：eag 152.21 Ma; lag 149.2 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Late Kimmeridgian。 地层字段 sfm=Painten。 记录署名 Wellnhofer 1975；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32121。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Reisdorf & Wuttke: "Because of its uncertain origin, neither its biostratigraphical age nor its lithostratigraphic classification is considered certain (Fig. 2). If it originated in Jachenhausen, then it can be considered to be from the Painten Formation (Zandt Member; cf. Zeiss 1977), and thus of an assumed Early Tithonian age (Rueppellianus Zone, Riedense or Early Rueppellianus Subzone) (G. Schweigert, personal communication 2011). On the other hand, if it came from the Kelheim area, then it is either from the lithostratigraphic equivalent of the uppermost Kimmeridgian of the Kapfelberg locality, or from the Lower Tithonian plattenkalks of the Goldberg locality (cf. Röper 2005a; Schweigert 2007). Since Kapfelberg has delivered a great quantity of reptile finds, it is the more probable locality (cf. Abel 1922; Kemp 2001). Whatever the case, both of these Plattenkalk deposits are considered part of the Painten Formation (G. Schweigert, personal communication 2011)."

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Exact location is uncertain due to conflicting descritptions and all that can be said is it is perhaps somwhere in the Riedenburg-Kelheim area, though Reisdorf & Wuttke (2012) consider Kapfelberg more likely

- 出现记录 occ:849631；PBDB 采集记录 col:29012。 地点字段 cnm=Solnhofen (Uppsala Collection)；地点分区字段 cc2=DE，stp=Bavaria。 记录年代界：eag 149.2 Ma; lag 145.06 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Early Tithonian。 地层字段 sfm=Solnhofen。 记录署名 Wellnhofer 1975；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32121。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Lithographic limestone

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
Quarries in the Eichstatt/Schernfeld/Solnhofen area

- 出现记录 occ:849633；PBDB 采集记录 col:84365。 地点字段 cnm=Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection)；地点分区字段 cc2=DE，stp=Bayern。 记录年代界：eag 149.2 Ma; lag 145.06 Ma；PBDB 年代区间字段 oei=Early Tithonian。 地层字段 sfm=Solnhofener Plattenkalk。 记录署名 Wellnhofer 1975；PBDB 引文编号 ref:32121。

PBDB 存档字段 scm 原文（未翻译或解释）：
STRATIGRAPHIC RELATIONS: From several beds within the Solnhofener Plattenkalk, including Malm 2b, and the Hybonoticeras hybonotum biozone.  AGE: Lower Tithonian.

PBDB 存档字段 ggc 原文（未翻译或解释）：
SPECIFIC LOCATION: Eichstätt, Bavaria, Germany. LAT/LONG: estimated based on Eichstätt, Germany
text.en:
The selected occurrence rows point to these collection records:
- At Solnhofen (Uppsala Collection) (Bavaria), region code DE, the recorded age bracket is 149.2–145.06 Ma; the named stratum is Solnhofen; the early end is labeled Early Tithonian.
- At Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection) (Bayern), region code DE, the recorded age bracket is 149.2–145.06 Ma; the named stratum is Solnhofener Plattenkalk; the early end is labeled Early Tithonian.
- At Compsognathus type, Kapfelberg (BSP) (Bayern), region code DE, the recorded age bracket is 152.21–149.2 Ma; the named stratum is Painten; the early end is labeled Late Kimmeridgian.
They identify documented fossil localities, not the complete geographic range of the species. The record names and age bounds follow the source.

title.en: Age bounds of these records
title.zh: 这些记录的年代边界

text.zh:
所选记录的年代外界为 152.21–145.06 Ma；Ma 指百万年前。这个区间合并了所选记录中最早的早端与最晚的晚端，并不表示期间每个时段都有化石，也不是对物种起源、灭绝或个体寿命的直接测定。各采集地仍保留自己的区间；本页不会把它改成精确标本年龄，也不改写来源中的测年解释。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
在这组 PBDB 记录中，最大记录 eag=152.21 Ma，见 occ:849634；最小记录 lag=145.06 Ma，见 occ:849631。这些数值是具名数据库记录的年代界，不代表两者之间存在连续记录，也不是该物种的起源、灭绝或个体寿命日期。每条记录各自的 eag 与 lag 值见上文。
text.en:
The selected records have an outer age interval of 152.21–145.06 Ma; Ma means millions of years ago. This span combines the oldest early bound with the youngest late bound among the chosen records. It does not show continuous presence through every intervening time or directly date the species origin, extinction or an individual lifespan. Each collection keeps its own bracket; this summary does not narrow it to a specimen age or revise the source dating interpretation.

PBDB occurrence record excerpt:
Across these selected PBDB rows, the largest recorded eag=152.21 Ma in occ:849634; the smallest recorded lag=145.06 Ma in occ:849631. These values are age bounds on named database records, not a continuous record between them and not dates of the species' origin, extinction, or lifespan. Each row keeps its own eag and lag values above.

title.en: Read preservation setting separately from living habitat
title.zh: 保存环境与生活环境分开阅读

text.zh:
采集记录列出了以下环境与保存方式：
- Solnhofen (Uppsala Collection)：环境标签为潟湖或受限浅潮下沉积环境（lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal）；保存标签为实体化石、压印保存（body,adpression）。
- Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection)：环境标签为潟湖或受限浅潮下沉积环境（lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal）；保存标签为mold/impression、压印保存、软组织（mold/impression,adpression,soft parts）。
- Compsognathus type, Kapfelberg (BSP)：环境标签为潟湖或受限浅潮下沉积环境（lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal）；保存标签为实体化石、mold/impression、压印保存、replaced with calcite（body,mold/impression,adpression,replaced with calcite）。
环境标签描述沉积背景，不能单独证明动物的生活栖地或食性；保存标签针对集合，也不一定适用于其中每件化石。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页区分出现记录编号、采集记录编号和材料说明。PBDB 采集记录编号不是单件标本编号。来源行提供的鉴定、材料、丰度及坐标／模型字段照录如下；采集层级的说明不被扩展成对每件化石的断言。

- occ:849634：PBDB 原鉴定字段 idn=Rhamphorhynchus longicaudus；PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Rhamphorhynchus muensteri；材料说明字段 ocm="Exemplar 6"；丰度字段 abv=1，abu=specimens；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=11.983056，lat=49.024723；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=24.49，pla=32.5。
- occ:849631：PBDB 原鉴定字段 idn=Pterodactylus longicaudus；PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Rhamphorhynchus muensteri；材料说明字段 ocm=Pal Museum Uppsala 150；丰度字段 abv=1，abu=specimens；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=11.170000，lat=48.900002；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=23.89，pla=32.08。
- occ:849633：PBDB 原鉴定字段 idn=Rhamphorhynchus longicaudus；PBDB 分类名称字段 tna=Rhamphorhynchus muensteri；材料说明字段 ocm=BSPG 1964 XXIV 123 (cast), BSPG 1877 X 1, 1889 XI 1, 1960 I 470, 1938 I 503, Teyler-Museum 6930, MB 101 XVIII, 3967 (exemplars 4 & 19), Burgermeister-Museum BMM 7/SMNS 56301；丰度字段 abv=9，abu=specimens；PBDB 地点坐标字段 lng=11.375278，lat=48.909168；古坐标／模型字段 pm1=gplates，pln=24.05，pla=32.11。
text.en:
The collection records carry these setting and preservation tags:
- Solnhofen (Uppsala Collection): lagoon or restricted shallow-subtidal setting (lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal); body fossil, compression impression (body,adpression).
- Eichstätt, Solnhofen (MfN collection): lagoon or restricted shallow-subtidal setting (lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal); mold or impression, compression impression, soft tissues (mold/impression,adpression,soft parts).
- Compsognathus type, Kapfelberg (BSP): lagoon or restricted shallow-subtidal setting (lagoonal/restricted shallow subtidal); body fossil, mold or impression, compression impression, calcite replacement (body,mold/impression,adpression,replaced with calcite).
The setting is the depositional context, not proof of the animal’s living habitat or diet. Preservation tags describe a collection and need not apply to every fossil within it.

readerLimitations.zh:
本页整理的是 PBDB 截至 2026-10-02 的出现记录，属于固定 276 项翼龙名录之一。纳入记录要求当前名称相符、记录的父级路径可追到 Pterosauria，且有不带不确定鉴定限定的种级出现记录。这些规则便于整理数据库，并不裁决单件化石鉴定或所有分类争议；COL 中的同名条目也未被合并为同一个分类概念。采集地、年代、沉积环境与保存方式是不同信息，不能共同推出完整分布、精确起灭时间、物种整体栖地、种群规模或每件标本的保存状态。本页导读选定记录，不是完整的物种生物学专论。

PBDB 出现记录补充:
此页导读的是 2026-10-02 快照中的 14 条 PBDB 选取出现记录，不是物种专论。地点和年代区间描述的是数据库记录，不能据此推出完整地理分布、连续存在的时间范围、生态、行为或种群大小。采集记录编号、出现记录编号、标本说明及来源明确给出的丰度单位彼此区分。地点坐标字段与古坐标／模型字段仍按不同来源字段保留。所列引文署名不代表已完成全文审读。
readerLimitations.en:
This page summarizes PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02 for one name in a fixed set of 276 pterosaur entries. Included rows have a matching current name, a recorded parent path to Pterosauria and a species-level occurrence without an uncertain-identification qualifier. Those rules organize the database; they do not settle the identification of an individual fossil or every taxonomic dispute, and a same-name COL entry is not merged as the same taxonomic concept. Collection site, age, depositional setting and preservation are separate kinds of information. Together they do not give a complete range, exact origin or extinction, species-wide habitat, population size or the preservation state of every specimen. This is a guide to selected records, not a full account of the species biology.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 14 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

Zhou et al (2013): "The Daohugou site in the Tiaojishan Formation of Inner Mongolia, China; the locality was directly dated to be 165–164 million years (Myr) old".

Older information: "possible dates [range] from Middle Jurassic to Early Cretaceous. However, published radioisotopic [both 40Ar/39Ar and zircon U-Pb] dating results span... 152 to 168 Myr" = Bathonian to Kimmeridgian (Zhang et al. 2008). Also referred to as Haifanggou Formation

"Several recent isotope datings, using both 40 Ar/39Ar and SHRIMP U-Pb methods, have indicated that the age of the (underlying) ignimbrite is between the late Middle Jurassic and early Late Jurassic, or 159-164 Ma. Age is therefore constrained to Callovian-Barremian

readerLimitations.zh:
本页整理的是 PBDB 截至 2026-10-02 的出现记录，属于固定 276 项翼龙名录之一。纳入记录要求当前名称相符、记录的父级路径可追到 Pterosauria，且有不带不确定鉴定限定的种级出现记录。这些规则便于整理数据库，并不裁决单件化石鉴定或所有分类争议；COL 中的同名条目也未被合并为同一个分类概念。采集地、年代、沉积环境与保存方式是不同信息，不能共同推出完整分布、精确起灭时间、物种整体栖地、种群规模或每件标本的保存状态。本页导读选定记录，不是完整的物种生物学专论。

readerLimitations.en:
This page summarizes PBDB occurrence records dated 2026-10-02 for one name in a fixed set of 276 pterosaur entries. Included rows have a matching current name, a recorded parent path to Pterosauria and a species-level occurrence without an uncertain-identification qualifier. Those rules organize the database; they do not settle the identification of an individual fossil or every taxonomic dispute, and a same-name COL entry is not merged as the same taxonomic concept. Collection site, age, depositional setting and preservation are separate kinds of information. Together they do not give a complete range, exact origin or extinction, species-wide habitat, population size or the preservation state of every specimen. This is a guide to selected records, not a full account of the species biology.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 2 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

readerLimitations.zh:
本页整理 2026-10-02 的 PBDB 翼龙出现记录，属于选定记录导读，不是完整物种专论。条目沿用数据库接受名与父级路径，并纳入没有不确定鉴定限定词的可用种级记录。PBDB 对旧名称的链接不能裁决标本鉴定或全部分类争议，也不等于与 COL 同名概念合并。采集地点、地层年代、沉积环境和采集层级保存方式是不同字段；它们本身不能确立完整分布、真实起源或灭绝时间、固定生态、生物数量或每件标本的保存状态。

readerLimitations.en:
This page summarizes selected pterosaur occurrences in a PBDB snapshot dated 2026-10-02; it is not a complete species monograph. The records use the database accepted name and parent path and include usable species-level occurrences without uncertain-identification qualifiers. A PBDB link to an older name does not settle specimen identification or all taxonomic disputes, and it does not merge the record with a same-named COL concept. Collection locality, stratigraphic interval, depositional setting, and collection-level preservation mode are distinct fields. They do not by themselves establish a complete range, true origin or extinction time, fixed ecology, abundance, or the preservation of every specimen.

PBDB occurrence record limitations:
This is a guide to 35 selected PBDB occurrence rows in a snapshot dated 2026-10-02, not a species monograph. A locality and an age interval describe their database records; they do not establish a complete geographic range, continuous presence through time, ecology, behavior, or population size. Collection IDs, occurrence IDs, specimen notes, and any reported abundance units remain separate. Locality-coordinate fields and paleocoordinate/model fields are retained as distinct source fields. The listed reference attributions have not been treated as a full-text review.

The oolite lies in separated patches on the same plane, which were probably connected; the intervals between them are occupied by sand which may be supposed to have been left after the decomposition of the oolite.
